detail.abstract:
This thesis presents the formal doctrine of conversion for high-stakes engagements. It posits that the conventional Sales model is a structurally flawed Game of Scale [1] tactic. Its reliance on low-status, supplicant behaviors [1] (e.g., objection handling [2]) and misaligned incentive structures (e.g., commissions) makes it a primary catalyst of the Principal-Agent Problem [3]. This conflict creates an unbridgeable trust deficit that activates and fails within the Market for Lemons described in Thesis 2 [1].
This paper will provide a definitive rebuttal, proving that the Mohgix Architecture of Conviction is the superior Game of Stakes [1] system. By operationalizing the Alan Weiss Doctrine [5], this architecture solves the Market for Lemons by establishing a Posture of the Peer [1] and eliminates the Principal-Agent Problem by deploying Value-Based Fees [5]. This system is the only one designed to architect conviction, eliminate conflict, and command capital with integrity.

detail.abstract:
French abstract:
Malgré l’augmentation du nombre de médecins, des investissements importants et de multiples changements structurels, les réformes des soins primaires au Québec au cours des deux dernières décennies ont entraîné des améliorations limitées de l’accès. Près d’un quart des Québécois n’ont toujours pas de médecin de famille, et les urgences demeurent fortement sollicitées par des cas qui pourraient être pris en charge en soins primaires.

Des politiques coercitives telles que les régimes régionaux de dotation médicale, le travail hospitalier obligatoire et des lois récentes comme les projets de loi 83 et 2 ont rendu la médecine familiale moins attrayante, éloignant les nouveaux diplômés et réduisant le temps clinique que les médecins de famille consacrent aux soins primaires complets.

Les équipes de soins de santé, introduites par l’entremise des groupes de médecine de famille, n’ont pas atteint tout leur potentiel en raison d’incitatifs mal harmonisés, d’un partage limité des tâches et d’un modèle de rémunération à l’acte. Par conséquent, la capacité des médecins est sous-utilisée, et les professionnels non médecins restent insuffisamment intégrés.

L’amélioration durable nécessite une réforme structurelle coordonnée : passer à des modèles de paiement par capitation ajustés en fonction du risque, imposer l’inscription des patients avec une responsabilité claire, intégrer pleinement le personnel infirmier praticien et les pharmaciens dans les équipes de soins, et établir des systèmes solides de mesure du rendement avec des rapports publics transparents.

English abstract: 
Despite increased physician supply, substantial investment, and multiple structural changes, Quebec’s primary care reforms over the past two decades have yielded limited improvements in access. Over one-quarter of Quebecers still lack a regular provider, and emergency rooms remain heavily burdened by primary-care-treatable cases. 

Coercive policies such as regional medical staffing plans, mandatory hospital work, and recent legislation like Bills 83 and 2 have made family medicine less attractive, driving new graduates away and reducing the clinical time family doctors spend on comprehensive primary care. 

Team-based care, introduced through family medicine groups, has not reached its potential due to misaligned incentives, limited task-sharing, and a fee-for-service payment model. As a result, physician capacity is underused and non-physician professionals remain insufficiently integrated. 

Sustainable improvement requires coordinated, structural reform. This includes transitioning to risk-adjusted capitation payment models, fully integrating nurse practitioners and pharmacists into care teams, mandating patient enrollment with clear accountability, and establishing robust performance measurement systems with transparent public reporting.

AI.tldr: 尽管增加了医生数量、投入了大量资金并进行了多次结构性改革，但魁北克过去二十年的初级保健改革在改善就医机会方面成效有限。强制性的政策使家庭医学吸引力下降，团队护理模式因激励措施不协调而未能发挥潜力。可持续的改进需要转向风险调整的按人头付费模式、强制患者登记、充分整合非医生专业人员，并建立透明的绩效衡量系统。
AI.research_question: 为什么魁北克过去二十年的初级保健改革在改善就医机会方面成效有限？如何实现可持续的初级保健系统改进？
AI.motivation: 尽管增加了医生数量、投入了大量资金并进行了多次结构性改革，但魁北克仍有超过四分之一的居民没有固定的医疗服务提供者，急诊室仍然承担了大量本应在初级保健中处理的病例。这表明现有的改革措施未能有效解决初级保健系统的根本问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于卫生系统改革理论、激励理论（激励协调）和团队护理理论。特别关注政策设计对医疗专业人员行为的影响，以及支付模式（按服务收费 vs 按人头付费）对系统绩效的影响。
AI.method: 该研究似乎是基于政策分析和系统评估的方法，通过对魁北克初级保健改革的历史回顾、政策文件分析以及系统绩效数据的评估来得出结论。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）强制性政策（如区域医疗人员配置计划、强制医院工作）使家庭医学吸引力下降，导致新毕业生流失；2）通过家庭医学团体引入的团队护理因激励措施不协调、任务分担有限和按服务收费模式而未能发挥潜力；3）医生能力未充分利用，非医生专业人员整合不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 该研究对卫生系统改革理论做出贡献，强调了激励协调在团队护理中的重要性，以及支付模式对系统绩效的关键影响。它提供了关于强制性政策可能产生意外负面后果的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究提出了具体的改革建议：1）转向风险调整的按人头付费模式；2）强制患者登记并明确责任；3）充分整合执业护士和药剂师到护理团队；4）建立强大的绩效衡量系统并进行透明的公开报告。这些建议为政策制定者提供了可行的改革路径。

detail.abstract:
• Virtual care has rapidly expanded across Canada, improving convenience and access for many but also creating a fragmented governance landscape. Provinces differ widely in how they regulate, fund and integrate virtual care, making cross-border delivery complex and leaving major gaps in continuity of care for patients navigating their journey through the health system.
  • Despite efforts to align public systems with modern care delivery, large loopholes in how “insured services” are defined by provinces in practice have enabled significant growth of private, for-profit virtual care. These services operate both within and across provinces, raising concerns about equity, data fragmentation and uneven access based on patient resources or employer benefits.
  • As virtual care becomes a permanent feature of the healthcare system, provinces must strengthen regulatory frameworks, protect continuity of care from fragmentation, and clarify the scope of insured services. Choices made now will determine whether virtual care reduces access gaps and enhances integration or contributes to greater inequity and system fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 加拿大虚拟医疗快速发展，但各省监管、资金和整合方式差异巨大，导致跨境服务复杂、患者连续性护理存在重大缺口。私人营利性虚拟医疗利用"受保服务"定义漏洞快速增长，引发公平性、数据碎片化和资源依赖型访问不均等问题。需加强监管框架，明确受保服务范围，确保虚拟医疗减少而非加剧医疗不平等。
AI.research_question: 加拿大各省虚拟医疗监管框架的差异如何影响医疗服务的连续性、公平性和系统整合？私人营利性虚拟医疗的快速增长对医疗系统的公平性和数据整合构成哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 虚拟医疗在加拿大快速扩张，虽然提高了便利性和可及性，但各省监管、资金和整合方式的巨大差异导致了碎片化的治理格局。跨境服务交付复杂，患者在医疗系统旅程中的连续性护理存在重大缺口。同时，"受保服务"定义漏洞使私人营利性虚拟医疗快速增长，引发公平性、数据碎片化和资源依赖型访问不均等担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗治理理论、监管碎片化理论、医疗公平性理论、连续性护理理论、公私混合医疗系统理论、数字医疗整合框架
AI.method: 政策分析、比较案例分析（各省监管框架）、文献综述、利益相关者分析、监管漏洞识别、系统整合评估
AI.findings: 1. 各省虚拟医疗监管、资金和整合方式存在显著差异，导致跨境服务复杂化；2. "受保服务"定义漏洞被私人营利性虚拟医疗利用，实现快速增长；3. 私人服务在省内和省际运营，引发公平性担忧；4. 数据碎片化和资源依赖型访问不均等问题加剧；5. 连续性护理因系统碎片化而受到损害。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了虚拟医疗监管碎片化理论；2. 提出了数字医疗时代连续性护理的新框架；3. 完善了公私混合医疗系统中的公平性理论；4. 构建了跨辖区虚拟医疗治理的分析模型；5. 深化了"受保服务"定义在数字医疗环境中的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为各省加强虚拟医疗监管框架提供具体建议；2. 提出保护连续性护理免受碎片化影响的策略；3. 明确受保服务范围的具体操作指南；4. 设计减少访问差距和增强系统整合的政策工具；5. 提供防止虚拟医疗加剧不平等的治理方案。

title: Assessing the Influence of the Urban Ecosystem Services on Urban Quality of Life: A Comprehensive Study of Khulna City, Bangladesh
affiliations: Lund University, Khulna University and Khulna University

detail.title: Assessing the Influence of the Urban Ecosystem Services on Urban Quality of Life: A Comprehensive Study of Khulna City, Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization in developing countries, particularly in cities like Khulna, Bangladesh, is exerting significant pressure on urban ecosystems and hindering improvements in urban quality of life (UQoL). Despite the city’s valuable natural resources, residents face low livelihood and well-being indicators, highlighting the need to better understand the link between ecosystem services (ES) and UQoL. This study classified Khulna into six urban ecosystem categories and used a combination of household surveys and focus group discussions (FGDs) to collect primary data. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) prioritized indicators of ES supply and UQoL demand, while Kendall’s coefficient of concordance measured agreement, and gap analysis quantified discrepancies between available and expected UQoL. The study found that unplanned residential areas (URA) possess stronger provisioning and regulating services compared with other residential zones, while cultural services, particularly social relationships comprising 45–73% of criteria weight (Cw) across all areas. Physical, social, and psychological health (PH, SH, and PsH) services were oversupplied by the ecosystems in most areas, yet economic health requirements remain deficient in slum residential areas (SRA) and a latent undervaluation of existing services has emerged in the most non-residential areas. In the study UQoL rankings revealed low agreement (Kendall’s W = 0.011, χ² = 0.2), signifying that residents are more attuned to deficiencies than to the benefits they receive. This study exposes the resolve between ES supply and perceived UQoL demand exhibiting the lack of awareness with context-specific planning undermines the potential of urban ecosystems to improve residents’ well-being. It recommends targeted green–blue infrastructure, and community awareness programs to bridge this diversion and enhance livelihood quality in Khulna City and comparable rapidly urbanizing cities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了孟加拉国库尔纳市生态系统服务与城市生活质量的关系，发现非规划住宅区拥有更强的供给和调节服务，但居民对生态系统服务的认知不足，导致供需错配，建议通过绿色-蓝色基础设施和社区意识项目改善。
AI.research_question: 快速城市化背景下，生态系统服务如何影响城市生活质量？特别是在库尔纳这样的发展中城市，生态系统服务供给与居民生活质量需求之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家快速城市化对城市生态系统造成压力，阻碍城市生活质量提升。尽管库尔纳拥有宝贵的自然资源，但居民生计和福祉指标仍然较低，需要更好地理解生态系统服务与城市生活质量之间的联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务理论、城市生活质量框架、供给-需求分析框架、差距分析理论
AI.method: 1. 将库尔纳市分为六类城市生态系统；2. 使用家庭调查和焦点小组讨论收集原始数据；3. 采用层次分析法优先排序生态系统服务供给和生活质量需求指标；4. 使用肯德尔和谐系数测量一致性；5. 通过差距分析量化可用与预期生活质量之间的差异
AI.findings: 1. 非规划住宅区比其他住宅区拥有更强的供给和调节服务；2. 文化服务（特别是社会关系）在所有区域中占标准权重的45-73%；3. 大多数区域的生态系统过度供应了物理、社会和心理健康服务；4. 贫民窟住宅区的经济健康需求仍然不足；5. 非住宅区存在对现有服务的潜在低估；6. 生活质量排名一致性低，表明居民更关注缺陷而非获得的利益
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了发展中城市生态系统服务供给与感知生活质量需求之间的错配；2. 提出了城市生态系统服务与生活质量关系的分析框架；3. 强调了居民认知在生态系统服务价值实现中的关键作用；4. 为快速城市化背景下城市生态系统管理提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议针对性的绿色-蓝色基础设施规划；2. 推荐社区意识提升项目；3. 为库尔纳市及类似快速城市化城市提供改善生计质量的具体策略；4. 帮助城市规划者更好地理解居民需求与生态系统服务供给的关系

title: New Wine in Old Wineskins Unintended Financial Dominance and Central Banking Myopia
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics, Bocconi University - Department of Economics (ECO), Trinity College (Dublin) - Department of Economics and King’s Business School, King’s College London

detail.title: New Wine in Old Wineskins Unintended Financial Dominance and Central Banking Myopia
detail.abstract: This paper provides a positive analysis of the links between macroeconomic fundamentals, unintended financial dominance, and central banking myopia. When current levels of public and private leverage depend on past monetary and supervisory policies, the risk of financial dominance is itself shaped by past policy choices, with expectations acting as the intertemporal transmission mechanism. Expectations incorporate the perceived likelihood of future financial dominance through two channels: a de jure capture bias and a de facto accommodation bias. In this setting, central banking myopia becomes an endogenous outcome of the regime, and financial dominance is unintended. The theoretical framework is used to interpret post-Global Financial Crisis reforms in central bank design as manifestations of stronger capture bias, and the widespread use of unconventional monetary policies as evidence of stronger accommodation bias.

title: Protecting Electoral Integrity and Democracy: Addressing the Threat of Malign Foreign Influence and Interference in the Philippines' 2025 Midterm Elections
affiliations: Ateneo de Manila University - Ateneo School of Government, Far Eastern University, University of the Philippines Diliman,  and Ateneo de Manila University - Ateneo School of Government

detail.title: Protecting Electoral Integrity and Democracy: Addressing the Threat of Malign Foreign Influence and Interference in the Philippines' 2025 Midterm Elections
detail.abstract: As geopolitical tensions in the Indo-Pacific intensify, the Philippines faces mounting challenges both from external coercion at sea and from malign foreign influence and interference targeting its democratic institutions. These operations manifest through multiple entry points, including the co-optation of local officials, organized crime, espionage, and election interference. This study examines the interplay between national and subnational governance in addressing these threats, using the 2025 Philippine midterm elections as case analysis. It highlights the constitutional tension between the President’s centralized authority over foreign policy and national security, and the constitutional autonomy of local governments. This tension creates opportunities for malign foreign actors to exploit subnational spaces through sister-city partnerships, economic incentives, and digital influence campaigns. Drawing on open-source data, key informant interviews, and spatial mapping, the study identifies geographic patterns of vulnerability. It analyzes the structural weaknesses that are susceptible to foreign interference in national and local institutions. The findings reveal that while national frameworks exist, uneven implementation at the subnational level heightens susceptibility to external manipulation. The study proposes two policy directions: enhancing subnational resilience through stronger oversight and stakeholder collaboration, and reinforcing electoral safeguards through legislative reform and the designation of a Counter Foreign Interference Coordinator under the office of the National Security Adviser. Addressing malign foreign influence and interference demands synchronized action across governance levels and a whole-of-society approach to safeguarding Philippine democracy.

It will prove that the advisory market for high-stakes leadership is a catastrophic market failure, defined by two core economic theories: George Akerlof's Market for Lemons and the Principal-Agent Problem. title: A Comparative Technical and Economic Analysis of Railway Track Superstructures: Ballasted, Ballastless, and Frame Sleeper Systems

authors.first_name: Wan Muhammad Asif Bin Wan Mohd

detail.title: A Comparative Technical and Economic Analysis of Railway Track Superstructures: Ballasted, Ballastless, and Frame Sleeper Systems
detail.abstract: The selection of an appropriate railway track superstructure is a critical decision in modern infrastructure planning, with profound implications for operational performance, long-term economic viability, and network availability. This report presents a comprehensive comparative analysis of the three principal track superstructure designs: traditional ballasted track, advanced ballastless (slab) track, and the emerging hybrid frame sleeper system. The study's methodology is a qualitative review of existing academic literature and technical reports, synthesizing data on design principles, construction, maintenance requirements, geometric stability, service life, and economic models. Key findings reveal a fundamental trade-off: ballasted track offers a lower initial capital expenditure but incurs high life cycle costs due to a perpetual cycle of maintenance required to correct geometric instability. Conversely, ballastless track demands a significantly higher upfront investment but delivers superior geometric stability, a substantially longer service life, and minimal maintenance, making it the economically and technically superior solution for high-speed and high-density corridors. The report concludes that there is no single universal solution; the optimal choice is contingent upon a strategic assessment of specific operational demands, geological conditions, and longterm financial objectives.

It will provide the definitive proof that the modern consultant is a structurally bankrupt model, operating as a faithless agent within a commoditized Game of Scale. This model is not merely flawed; it is the primary vector for the Principal-Agent Problem [2] in the advisory market. Its foundational time-for-money incentive structure is inherently misaligned with the client's (Principal's) core objectives, creating a toxic and untrustworthy relationship.
The consultant model is hereby proven to be the causal agent of the Strategic Void™—a systemic market failure formally identified as a Market for Lemons. The catastrophic, multi-trillion-dollar liability resulting from this failure is quantified in Mohgix doctrine as the Clarity Tax™.
The Doctrine of Strategic Counsel is codified as the only viable solution. Strategic Counsel is defined as a Game of Stakes Peer [5] who is doctrinally-bound to solve the market's two core failures. Counsel solves the Principal-Agent Problem through a system of Value-Based Fees [5] that ensures perfect incentive alignment. Counsel solves the Market for Lemons (asymmetrical information) through the Posture of the Peer [5], which functions as an unfalsifiable, costly signal of quality. This is the ascension from a transactional agent to a relational principal, achieved through absolute integrity.

title: Legal Alignment for Safe and Ethical AI
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Oxford Martin School, University of Pennsylvania Law School, Institute for Law & AI, Stanford University, , Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, Harvard Law School, Independent, University of Toronto, , Princeton University - Program in Law & Public Policy, Carnegie Mellon University, Australian National University (ANU), Stanford University,  and Harvard Law School

detail.title: Legal Alignment for Safe and Ethical AI
detail.abstract: Alignment of artificial intelligence (AI) encompasses the normative problem of specifying how AI systems should act and the technical problem of ensuring AI systems comply with those specifications. To date, AI alignment has generally overlooked an important source of knowledge and practice for grappling with these problems: law. In this paper, we aim to fill this gap by exploring how legal rules, principles, and methods can be leveraged to address problems of alignment and inform the design of AI systems that operate safely and ethically. This emerging field — legal alignment — focuses on three research directions: (1) designing AI systems to comply with the content of legal rules developed through legitimate institutions and processes, (2) adapting methods from legal interpretation to guide how AI systems reason and make decisions, and (3) harnessing legal concepts as a structural blueprint for confronting challenges of reliability, trust, and cooperation in AI systems. These research directions present new conceptual, empirical, and institutional questions, which include examining the specific set of laws that particular AI systems should follow, creating evaluations to assess their legal compliance in real-world settings, and developing governance frameworks to support the implementation of legal alignment in practice. Tackling these questions requires expertise across law, computer science, and other disciplines, offering these communities the opportunity to collaborate in designing AI for the better.

AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，提出法律对齐的三个研究方向及相关研究问题，涉及跨学科（法律、计算机科学等）方法。
AI.findings: 提出了法律对齐作为新兴研究领域，明确了三个具体研究方向，并识别了相关的概念、实证和制度性问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将法律框架引入AI对齐研究，建立了法律对齐的理论基础和研究方向，填补了现有研究的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统设计提供了具体的法律合规路径，提出了评估AI法律合规性的方法，以及支持法律对齐实施的治理框架。

detail.abstract:
This thesis presents the capstone synthesis of the Cinematic Strategy doctrine, formally codifying it as a new and distinct Field of Study. It argues that the contemporary high-stakes advisory market is a catastrophic Market for 'Lemons' (Akerlof), defined by the Principal-Agent Problem and dominated by faithless agents (consultants) . This systemic failure produces a multi-trillion-dollar liability, the Clarity Tax™ .
We posit that Cinematic Strategy is the only holistic antidote. It is the first field to integrate:
1. A Pi-Shaped (π) Practitioner , the Cinematic Strategist, who reunites the estranged academic disciplines of Business [2] and Humanities [6].
2. A Neuro-Scientific Methodology that treats narrative as a biological event, engineering conviction via neural coupling (Hasson) [14] and oxytocin (Zak) [15].
3. A Crucible-Forged Pedagogy that uses Costly Signaling to filter for Principals over Agents.
4. A Game of Stakes Professional Model that solves the market's economic failures through the Weiss Doctrine .
This synthesis proves Cinematic Strategy is a Category of One , providing the only framework for capturing Psychological Arbitrage and achieving Strategic Sovereignty

title: Why Supply Chains Need AI, More than Ever?

detail.title: Why Supply Chains Need AI, More than Ever?
detail.abstract: Supply chains have never been simple. From sourcing raw materials to delivering finished goods to consumers, the processes involve many stages, actors, and dependencies often across countries, time zones, and regulatory environments. In a world with volatile demand, unpredictable disruptions (e.g. natural disasters, pandemics, geopolitical events), and increasing customer expectations (faster delivery, better traceability), traditional supply chain approaches are struggling to keep up. This is where AI enters not as a futuristic luxury but as a strategic necessity. By processing large, complex data sets, learning from patterns, and making predictions or decisions more quickly than humans, AI promises to transform supply chain management from reactive and manual to proactive, dynamic, and resilient. In doing so, AI changes not only how supply chains operate operationally, but also how managers think about uncertainty, risk, and opportunity. In this essay, I examine the multifaceted impacts of AI on supply chains: what it's good at, where it struggles, real world applications, and the human/organizational challenges that accompany it.

title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Supply Chain Resilience in Bangladesh Garment and E-Commerce Sectors

detail.title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Supply Chain Resilience in Bangladesh Garment and E-Commerce Sectors
detail.abstract: Bringing artificial intelligence into supply chain management opens up big changes for places like Bangladesh. This country focuses a lot on its garment industry and the growing e-commerce side. The paper looks at different ways AI affects supply chain management. It checks how tools like predictive analytics, machine learning, and computer vision make things more efficient, sustainable, and tough against problems. These problems include weak infrastructure and worldwide issues that shake things up. The study uses ideas from other sources to break down the good parts. Those include better guessing of demand, smarter inventory handling, and lower costs. It also covers roadblocks like not enough skilled people, expensive setups, and bad data quality. The main results show AI use is still new, sitting at about 32 percent in garment companies. Still, it could cut down on yearly waste that costs billions. This happens through real-time tracking and fair ways of working. In e-commerce, AI cuts stock shortages by up to 20 percent on sites like Daraz. The bigger picture points to the need for rules that push training and better setups. This would close the gap in digital access and help steady growth in Bangladesh export-focused economy. In the end, smart use of AI could lift Bangladesh standing worldwide. But it needs handling of moral worries and shifts in jobs for fair results.

title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This assignment explains how Artificial Intelligence is affecting supply chain management in Bangladesh. It describes how AI helps companies work better by improving demand forecasting, inventory control, quality checks, transportation and overall decision making. The paper also discusses how different industries in Bangladesh, such as garments, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, logistics and retail, are starting to use AI in their daily operations. Although AI brings many benefits, such as saving time, reducing costs and improving accuracy, there are also challenges. These include high costs, lack of skilled workers, poor infrastructure, cybersecurity risks and resistance from employees. The assignment also suggests ways Bangladesh can successfully adopt AI, such as improving training, upgrading technology and creating strong policies. Overall, the findings show that AI can greatly improve Bangladesh’s supply chain systems and support the country’s future economic growth if it is used properly.

title: Sovereign Default Risk, & Central Banks' Gold Reserves

detail.title: Sovereign Default Risk, & Central Banks' Gold Reserves

declarations.funderStatement: Not funded by anyone

detail.abstract: This study investigates how sovereign default risk, measured by the Emerging Market Bond (EMBI) Index, affects the composition of central bank reserves, with a particular focus on gold holdings. Using a panel of 52 countries from 1997 to 2020, the study employs dynamic panel GMM, local projections, and instrumental-variable Tobit estimators to examine the response of the gold share of central bank reserves to changes in sovereign default risk. Leveraging a newly constructed dataset on country-level reserve currency composition, the analysis disentangles portfolio reallocation toward gold from valuation-driven changes in gold shares. The results show that a surge in sovereign default risk is associated with a significant reallocation of reserves toward gold, consistent with a precautionary reserve management rationale. Local projection estimates indicate that the increase in gold share following a default risk shock persists for up to two years. The effect is stronger in countries with fixed exchange rate regimes and in those with lower central bank independence. Additionally, the analysis documents that higher U.S. dollar and special drawing right (SDR) debt composition is associated with an increase in the gold share of central bank reserves, highlighting the role of currency mismatches in shaping reserve allocation decisions.

AI.tldr: 主权违约风险上升时，央行会显著增加黄金储备占比，这反映了预防性储备管理逻辑。该效应在固定汇率制国家和央行独立性较低的国家更强，且持续约两年时间。
AI.research_question: 主权违约风险如何影响央行储备构成，特别是黄金持有量？
AI.motivation: 理解央行在面对主权违约风险时的储备管理策略，特别是黄金作为避险资产的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防性储备管理理论，关注主权风险下的资产配置决策。
AI.method: 使用52个国家1997-2020年的面板数据，采用动态面板GMM、局部投影和工具变量Tobit估计方法，分析主权违约风险对央行黄金储备占比的影响。
AI.findings: 主权违约风险上升会导致央行显著增加黄金储备占比；该效应在固定汇率制国家和央行独立性较低的国家更强；效应持续约两年；美元和SDR债务占比越高，黄金储备占比也越高。
AI.theory_contributions: 为预防性储备管理理论提供实证支持，揭示了主权风险下央行资产配置的动态调整机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行储备管理提供决策参考，帮助理解不同制度环境下应对主权风险的策略差异。

detail.title: A Study on Marketing Strategies and Service Promotion at Empire Kia

detail.abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of marketing strategies and service promotion practices adopted by Empire Kia, an authorized Kia dealership operating in the competitive Indian automotive retail market. The research focuses on understanding customer behavior, lead generation effectiveness, sales funnel performance, and service-related communication. Primary data was collected through direct customer interactions, observation of over 100 inquiries, and dealership records during a 40-day internship period. The findings reveal that Empire Kia benefits from a strong brand image, high demand for SUV models such as Seltos and Sonet, and efficient in-showroom selling practices. However, gaps were observed in digital lead conversion, finance communication clarity, and the absence of an integrated CRM system. The study concludes that digital transformation, streamlined processes, and improved service communication can significantly enhance customer satisfaction and sales performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度Empire Kia经销商的市场营销策略和服务推广实践，发现其在品牌形象和实体销售方面表现良好，但在数字线索转化、财务沟通和CRM系统整合方面存在不足。
AI.research_question: Empire Kia在竞争激烈的印度汽车零售市场中采用的市场营销策略和服务推广实践效果如何？
AI.motivation: 了解汽车经销商在竞争激烈的印度市场中如何有效实施营销策略和服务推广，以提升销售业绩和客户满意度。

title: Architect not Strategist™: A Structural Analysis of the 'Principal-Agent Problem' in the High-Stakes Advisory Market

detail.title: Architect not Strategist™: A Structural Analysis of the 'Principal-Agent Problem' in the High-Stakes Advisory Market

detail.abstract:
This paper presents the foundational doctrine of the Architect not Strategist. It argues that the modern strategist is the primary agent of a catastrophic market failure—a Market for Lemons [1] as defined by George Akerlof [2]—which is defined by the misaligned incentives of the Principal-Agent Problem [5]. This failure, driven by the flawed Game of Scale paradigm, manifests as the Strategic Void™ [8] and the multi-trillion-dollar Clarity Tax™ [8].
We posit that the Architect is the only logical and ethical antidote. The Architect is a Game of Stakes practitioner who, by adopting the Assertive Expert posture [9] and deploying Value-Based Fees [9] (the Weiss Doctrine), realigns all incentives, absorbs all strategic risk, and trades not in plans (liabilities) but in outcomes (assets). This doctrine is the definitive codification of our Category of One.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"架构师而非战略家"的基础理论，认为现代战略家是市场失灵的主要推手，而架构师通过价值导向的收费模式和风险承担，能够重新调整激励并创造实际成果。
AI.research_question: 如何解决由现代战略家造成的市场失灵问题？架构师作为替代方案如何重新调整激励结构并创造实际价值？
AI.motivation: 现代战略家导致了灾难性的市场失灵（柠檬市场），这种失灵源于委托代理问题中的激励错位，表现为战略真空和巨大的清晰度税成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乔治·阿克洛夫的柠檬市场理论、委托代理问题、规模游戏范式、赌注游戏范式、自信专家姿态理论。
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，通过对比战略家与架构师的不同范式，提出基于价值收费的韦斯主义原则。
AI.findings: 架构师通过采用自信专家姿态和价值导向收费模式，能够重新调整所有激励、吸收所有战略风险，并将产出从计划（负债）转变为成果（资产）。

title: The New American System: Modern Moral Governance and the Ten Pillars

detail.title: The New American System: Modern Moral Governance and the Ten Pillars

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is the 2nd version, the first was littered with scaffolding errors

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a unified model for understanding the behavior of American political, cultural, and institutional systems in the 21st century. It argues that a new governing architecture—a system defined by narrative supremacy, identity-based moral authority, incentive distortion, emotional governance, selective enforcement, and institutional insulation—has emerged across media, academia, bureaucracy, technology platforms, and political leadership.

To evaluate this model, the paper conducts eleven cross-domain “program autopsies” spanning welfare and family structure, education, the War on Poverty, housing, crime and justice reform, DEI regimes, immigration, election administration, energy and environmental policy, technology and information control, and foreign-policy doctrine. Across all eleven domains, the same structural sequence appears: expansive moralized initiatives, stagnant or deteriorating empirical outcomes, and subsequent narrative reinterpretation rather than policy correction.

The analysis concludes that these patterns are not partisan anomalies but structural adaptations to an information environment in which institutional survival depends on shaping perception more than improving performance. The epilogue situates these findings in a broader civilizational transition from American assimilation to narrative assimilation, offering an integrative explanation for the system’s emergence and persistence.

The aim of this paper is diagnostic rather than partisan. It provides a falsifiable, cross-domain framework for analyzing institutional behavior in an era of narrative governance and offers conceptual tools for future empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理解21世纪美国政治、文化和制度行为的统一模型，认为一种新的治理架构已经出现，其特征是叙事霸权、基于身份的道德权威、激励扭曲、情感治理、选择性执行和制度隔离。通过对11个跨领域政策进行"项目尸检"，发现相同的结构性模式：扩张性道德化倡议、停滞或恶化的实证结果、以及后续的叙事重新解释而非政策修正。
AI.research_question: 21世纪美国政治、文化和制度体系的行为模式是什么？是否存在一个统一的模型来解释这些跨领域的制度行为？
AI.motivation: 理解当代美国制度体系为何表现出特定的行为模式，特别是在多个政策领域都出现相似的结构性失败模式，需要建立一个跨领域的分析框架来解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 叙事治理理论、制度适应理论、信息环境理论。核心概念包括：叙事霸权、基于身份的道德权威、激励扭曲、情感治理、选择性执行、制度隔离。
AI.method: 采用11个跨领域的"项目尸检"方法，涵盖福利与家庭结构、教育、反贫困战争、住房、犯罪与司法改革、DEI制度、移民、选举管理、能源与环境政策、技术与信息控制、外交政策等领域。
AI.findings: 在所有11个政策领域都发现了相同的结构性序列：扩张性道德化倡议→停滞或恶化的实证结果→叙事重新解释而非政策修正。这些模式不是党派异常，而是对信息环境的结构性适应，其中制度生存更依赖于塑造感知而非改善绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可证伪的跨领域分析框架，用于分析叙事治理时代的制度行为；发展了从美国同化到叙事同化的文明转型理论；提供了理解制度适应信息环境的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了诊断性的分析工具而非党派立场；为未来实证测试提供了概念框架；帮助理解制度行为模式及其持久性机制。

title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping global supply chains by improving forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, quality consistency, and decision-making speed. For Bangladesh—whose economy is heavily dependent on the Ready-Made Garments (RMG) sector—the integration of AI represents a critical opportunity to strengthen competitiveness and meet rising expectations from global buyers. This paper investigates the current state of AI adoption in Bangladeshi supply chains, highlights key applications such as demand forecasting, computer-vision-based quality inspection, predictive maintenance, logistics optimization, sustainability analytics, and supplier evaluation, and assesses the associated economic and social impacts. Drawing from industry reports and recent trends, the study finds that although large RMG firms are increasingly investing in automation and analytics, overall adoption remains at an early stage due to skill shortages, weak digital infrastructure, fragmented supplier networks, and high capital requirements. The paper further outlines the risks of workforce displacement and data governance challenges. Finally, it proposes a policy and business roadmap focusing on skills development, SME financing, interoperable data standards, ethical AI governance, and inclusive automation strategies. The findings contribute to the growing literature on AI-enabled supply chains in developing economies and offer evidence-based recommendations for accelerating Bangladesh’s transition toward resilient, technology-driven manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究人工智能在孟加拉国供应链中的采用现状，重点关注成衣制造业，分析AI应用的经济社会影响，并提出政策建议以加速技术转型。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在孟加拉国供应链中的采用现状如何？AI应用对孟加拉国经济和社会有哪些影响？如何加速孟加拉国向技术驱动型制造业转型？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国经济严重依赖成衣制造业，AI技术为提升其全球竞争力提供了关键机遇。研究AI在孟加拉国供应链中的采用情况对于该国保持在全球市场的地位至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术采用理论、供应链管理理论和数字转型理论，分析发展中国家AI技术扩散的影响因素和路径。
AI.method: 采用文献分析和行业报告研究方法，结合当前趋势分析，评估AI在孟加拉国供应链中的应用现状和挑战。
AI.findings: 大型成衣企业正增加对自动化和分析技术的投资，但整体采用仍处于早期阶段。主要障碍包括技能短缺、数字基础设施薄弱、供应商网络分散和高资本需求。AI应用带来劳动力替代风险和数据治理挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了发展中国家AI赋能供应链的研究文献，提供了技术采用障碍和促进因素的理论框架，拓展了数字转型理论在制造业中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了针对性的政策建议：技能发展、中小企业融资、互操作性数据标准、伦理AI治理和包容性自动化策略，为孟加拉国向弹性、技术驱动的制造业转型提供路线图。

title: Ternary Moral Logic (TML) and the Future of AI Governance: A Technical Analysis for NVIDIA

detail.title: Ternary Moral Logic (TML) and the Future of AI Governance: A Technical Analysis for NVIDIA
detail.abstract: This report provides a deep technical analysis of how Ternary Moral Logic (TML) can be integrated into NVIDIA's AI hardware and software ecosystem and evaluates the viability of a future triadic processor architecture. TML offers a paradigm for embedding ethical governance directly into AI systems through its eight foundational pillars, including the "Sacred Pause," "Moral Trace Logs," and "Hybrid Shield." The analysis concludes that NVIDIA can and should adopt TML, first as a software-based runtime governance architecture and, in the longer term, as a guiding principle for future hardware design.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了如何将三元道德逻辑（TML）集成到NVIDIA的AI硬件和软件生态系统中，并评估了三元处理器架构的可行性。结论是NVIDIA应该采用TML，先作为软件运行时治理架构，长期作为硬件设计指导原则。
AI.research_question: 如何将三元道德逻辑（TML）集成到NVIDIA的AI硬件和软件生态系统中？未来三元处理器架构的可行性如何？
AI.motivation: AI系统需要嵌入伦理治理机制，TML提供了通过八个基础支柱（包括"神圣暂停"、"道德痕迹日志"和"混合盾牌"）将伦理治理直接嵌入AI系统的范式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元道德逻辑（TML）理论框架，包括八个基础支柱：神圣暂停、道德痕迹日志、混合盾牌等。
AI.method: 深度技术分析，评估TML在NVIDIA生态系统中的集成可行性和未来硬件架构的可行性。
AI.findings: NVIDIA能够且应该采用TML，首先作为软件基础的运行时治理架构，长期作为未来硬件设计的指导原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将TML伦理治理范式集成到AI硬件和软件生态系统中的理论框架，为AI伦理治理提供了具体的技术实现路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NVIDIA提供了具体的实施路线图：先软件集成后硬件设计，为AI系统的伦理治理提供了可操作的技术方案。

title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming supply chain systems across the world, and Bangladesh is no exception. As the country grows in manufacturing, logistics, retail, agriculture, and export-based industries, the integration of AI offers new possibilities for efficiency, cost reduction, forecasting accuracy, and strategic decision making. This paper examines the impact of AI on supply chain management in Bangladesh by exploring the current adoption trends, challenges, and opportunities. It analyzes how AI technologies—such as machine learning, predictive analytics, automation, robotics, Internet of Things (IoT), and intelligent logistics systems—are reshaping traditional supply chain functions. Using a qualitative case-based approach, the study identifies key areas where AI is being implemented and evaluates its effectiveness in improving demand forecasting, inventory control, transportation management, warehouse operations, and supplier coordination. The findings suggest that while AI adoption in Bangladesh’s supply chains is still at a developing stage, the potential benefits are substantial. However, challenges such as technological skill gaps, infrastructure limitations, financial constraints, and resistance to change hinder widespread implementation. The paper concludes by offering recommendations for policymakers, industries, and supply chain stakeholders to accelerate AI-enabled transformation. The study contributes to existing literature by providing a comprehensive analysis of AI’s strategic role in the Bangladeshi supply chain environment and highlighting pathways for future improvement.

This paper investigates the current state of AI adoption in Bangladeshi supply chains, highlights key applications such as demand forecasting, computer-vision-based quality inspection, predictive maintenance, logistics optimization, sustainability analytics, and supplier evaluation, and assesses the associated economic and social impacts. Drawing from industry reports and recent trends, the study finds that although large RMG firms are increasingly investing in automation and analytics, overall adoption remains at an early stage due to skill shortages, weak digital infrastructure, fragmented supplier networks, and high capital requirements. The paper further outlines the risks of workforce displacement and data governance challenges. Finally, it proposes a policy and business roadmap focusing on skills development, SME financing, interoperable data standards, ethical AI governance, and inclusive automation strategies. The findings contribute to the growing literature on AI-enabled supply chains in developing economies and offer evidence-based recommendations for accelerating Bangladesh’s transition toward resilient, technology-driven manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI在孟加拉国供应链中的采用现状，重点关注成衣行业，分析了AI应用的经济社会影响，并提出了政策建议以加速技术转型。
AI.research_question: AI在孟加拉国供应链中的采用现状如何？AI应用对孟加拉国经济和社会有哪些影响？如何加速孟加拉国向技术驱动型制造业转型？

AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、供应链管理理论、发展中国家技术转型理论、AI伦理与治理框架。
AI.method: 基于行业报告和最新趋势的分析研究，采用文献综述和案例分析方法。

title: A Hybrid Supplier Evaluation Model Combining AHP–TOPSIS with Unsupervised Learning Techniques

detail.title: A Hybrid Supplier Evaluation Model Combining AHP–TOPSIS with Unsupervised Learning Techniques

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the development, analysis, or reporting of this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or any ethically sensitive information. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: The growing complexity of global supply networks has made supplier evaluation a strategic priority for firms seeking to manage risk, improve quality, and secure reliable sourcing. While several quantitative and qualitative models exist, many organizations still struggle to integrate subjective managerial judgments with objective performance data in a consistent and transparent manner. This study proposes a hybrid evaluation framework that combines the strengths of Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP), Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS), and unsupervised learning techniques. AHP is used to derive criteria weights based on expert input, while TOPSIS provides a structured approach to ranking suppliers through distance-based performance assessment. To complement these methods, clustering algorithms are employed to segment suppliers into meaningful groups such as strategic, preferred, or at-risk categories. The model is implemented using SQL for data extraction and Python for analytical computation, allowing for automation and reproducibility. Results from a simulated dataset demonstrate that the integrated approach offers clearer differentiation among suppliers and provides decision-makers with actionable insights that are often overlooked in traditional scoring systems. The study highlights the potential of data-driven hybrid models to enhance supplier management practices in modern supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个结合AHP、TOPSIS和无监督学习的混合供应商评估框架，旨在将主观管理判断与客观绩效数据整合，为供应链管理提供更清晰、可操作的决策支持。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够一致且透明地整合主观管理判断与客观绩效数据的供应商评估框架？
AI.motivation: 全球供应链网络日益复杂，供应商评估成为企业风险管理、质量改进和可靠采购的战略重点。然而，许多组织在将主观管理判断与客观绩效数据一致且透明地整合方面仍面临困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合层次分析法(AHP)、理想解相似度排序法(TOPSIS)和无监督学习技术。AHP用于基于专家输入确定标准权重，TOPSIS提供基于距离的绩效评估来排序供应商，聚类算法用于将供应商分为战略、优先或风险等有意义的类别。
AI.method: 采用混合评估框架，使用SQL进行数据提取，Python进行分析计算。通过模拟数据集验证模型，实现自动化和可重复性。
AI.findings: 模拟数据集结果显示，集成方法能更清晰地区分供应商，为决策者提供传统评分系统常被忽视的可操作见解。该方法在供应商之间提供了更好的区分度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合主观判断(AHP)和客观评估(TOPSIS)的混合评估框架，并引入无监督学习进行供应商细分，丰富了供应商评估的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个可自动化、可重复的供应商评估系统，使用SQL和Python实现，为现代供应链管理提供数据驱动的决策支持工具，帮助企业更好地分类和管理供应商。

detail.title: Mixed Frequency Data in a Heterogenous Sticky Price Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: NHH Dept. of Business and Management Science Discussion Paper No. 2025/26
publicationDetails.journalName: Norwegian School of Economics, Department of Business & Management Science Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a model to estimate price-adjustment behavior when prices are observed more frequently than key explanatory variables such as wage costs. We propose a mixedfrequency stochastic (S, s)-model that accommodates infrequently observed costs and allows for plant-, product-, and season-specific heterogeneity. The model is estimated using a likelihood-based nonlinear state-space approach, enabling estimation as if all variables were observed at the same frequency. Applied to monthly price survey data matched with plant-level annual cost data for manufacturing producers, the model yields precise estimates of both cost pass-through and price-inaction thresholds, and reduces the blurring of intermittent price changes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个混合频率随机(S,s)模型，用于在价格观测频率高于关键解释变量（如工资成本）时估计价格调整行为。该模型能够处理不频繁观测的成本数据，并允许工厂、产品和季节异质性。
AI.research_question: 当价格观测频率高于关键解释变量（如成本）时，如何准确估计价格调整行为？
AI.motivation: 实际经济数据中经常出现价格观测频率高于成本等关键解释变量的情况，这给传统价格调整模型带来挑战，需要开发能够处理混合频率数据的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机(S,s)模型框架，扩展为混合频率版本，包含价格不行动阈值和成本传递机制。
AI.method: 基于似然的非线性状态空间方法，使模型能够处理不同频率的观测数据，如同所有变量都在同一频率下观测。
AI.findings: 模型能够精确估计成本传递率和价格不行动阈值，减少间歇性价格变化的模糊性。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了混合频率随机(S,s)模型理论，为处理不同频率观测数据提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 应用于制造业月度价格调查数据与工厂级年度成本数据的匹配分析，为政策制定者和企业提供了更准确的价格调整行为估计工具。

title: Inside Out : Turning Personality Insight Into Career Clarity

detail.title: Inside Out : Turning Personality Insight Into Career Clarity
detail.abstract: This assignment explores the role of personality in career development through the lens of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). It begins by introducing the concept of personality and the MBTI framework, which categorizes individuals into 16 types based on four dichotomies: Extraversion/Introversion, Sensing/Intuition, Thinking/Feeling, and Judging/Perceiving. The personal MBTI assessment reveals the author’s type as ISTJ-A (Assertive Logistician), characterized by introversion, observant behaviour, logical decision-making, and a preference for structure. The analysis further examines the strengths and weaknesses associated with this type and identifies suitable career fields such as accounting, teaching, and management. The assignment concludes by aligning the author’s career interests with the ISTJ-A profile, emphasizing the importance of personality-awareness in achieving professional satisfaction and success.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过MBTI人格类型分析探讨人格在职业发展中的作用，作者基于自身ISTJ-A人格类型分析其职业适配性。
AI.research_question: 人格特质（特别是MBTI类型）如何影响职业发展和职业选择？
AI.motivation: 理解人格与职业发展的关系，帮助个人基于人格特质做出更合适的职业选择，提高职业满意度和成功率。
AI.theoretical_framework: Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI)人格理论框架，基于四个二分维度：外向/内向、感觉/直觉、思考/情感、判断/感知，形成16种人格类型。
AI.method: 个人MBTI评估和自我分析，作者通过MBTI测试确定自身为ISTJ-A类型，并分析该类型的特征、优势、劣势及职业适配性。
AI.findings: ISTJ-A类型（果断型物流师）具有内向、观察力强、逻辑决策、偏好结构等特点，适合会计、教学、管理等职业领域；人格意识对职业满意度有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将MBTI人格理论应用于职业发展领域，展示了人格类型与职业适配性的具体联系，为基于人格的职业指导提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ISTJ-A类型个体提供了具体的职业建议，强调人格自我认知对职业规划的重要性，帮助读者理解如何利用人格特质实现职业成功。

title: Integrated Model-Based Systems Engineering and Two-Stage Optimization to Assess Cybersecurity Risks in Aircraft Supply Chains

detail.title: Integrated Model-Based Systems Engineering and Two-Stage Optimization to Assess Cybersecurity Risks in Aircraft Supply Chains
detail.abstract: As cybersecurity threats grow in complexity and frequency, protecting aircraft supply chains has become a pressing priority. In this work, we propose an integrated model-based systems engineering and optimization approach that captures all necessary information, including structure, behavior, requirements, and relevant parameters related to the acquisition process and supply chain. The approach also enables optimal supplier selection to reduce costs, maximize profits, and fulfill customer requirements under both deterministic and two-stage stochastic settings. Furthermore, it accounts for cybersecurity risks, such as data breaches, data corruption, IoT device compromise, and network intrusions, by modeling various attack scenarios and their consequences, allowing the manufacturer to make informed decisions under diverse conditions. Numerical tests demonstrate the model’s effectiveness, with the rate of requirement fulfillment under the attack scenarios showing a 50\% improvement over a deterministic approach. To be optimally equipped even for low-probability high-cost attack scenarios, we incorporate the risk measure Conditional Value-at-Risk. The resulting supplier selection process led to savings in the average expected cost across all attack scenarios, and a reduction in the maximum possible loss when these attacks are realized. The robustness of the proposed approach is demonstrated by its consistent performance across a range of scenarios and risk preferences, establishing it as a reliable tool for strengthening cybersecurity in aircraft supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成模型驱动的系统工程与优化方法，用于飞机供应链的网络安全防护。该方法通过建模供应链结构、行为、需求和参数，在确定性和两阶段随机设置下优化供应商选择，同时考虑数据泄露、数据损坏、物联网设备入侵等多种网络攻击场景。数值测试显示，该方法在攻击场景下的需求满足率比确定性方法提高50%，并通过条件风险价值（CVaR）降低平均预期成本和最大可能损失。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个集成模型驱动的系统工程与优化方法，在考虑网络安全风险的条件下，优化飞机供应链的供应商选择，以降低成本、最大化利润并满足客户需求？
AI.motivation: 随着网络安全威胁日益复杂和频繁，保护飞机供应链已成为紧迫优先事项。传统方法难以全面考虑供应链结构、行为、需求参数以及各种网络攻击场景，需要开发更全面的方法来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 模型驱动的系统工程（MBSE）框架
2. 优化理论（确定性和两阶段随机优化）
3. 风险管理理论（条件风险价值CVaR）
4. 供应链网络安全风险建模理论
AI.method:
1. 集成模型驱动的系统工程方法，捕捉供应链结构、行为、需求和参数
2. 确定性和两阶段随机优化模型
3. 网络攻击场景建模（数据泄露、数据损坏、物联网设备入侵、网络入侵）
4. 条件风险价值（CVaR）纳入低概率高成本攻击场景
5. 数值测试验证方法有效性
AI.findings:
1. 在攻击场景下，需求满足率比确定性方法提高50%
2. 通过CVaR纳入，降低了所有攻击场景的平均预期成本
3. 减少了攻击实现时的最大可能损失
4. 方法在不同场景和风险偏好下表现一致，具有鲁棒性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了集成MBSE与优化的飞机供应链网络安全防护理论框架
2. 发展了考虑网络攻击场景的两阶段随机优化模型
3. 将CVaR风险度量纳入供应链网络安全决策
4. 建立了供应链网络安全风险的系统工程建模方法
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为飞机制造商提供了可靠的供应商选择工具
2. 帮助企业在网络攻击下做出明智决策
3. 降低供应链网络安全风险带来的成本和损失
4. 提高飞机供应链的整体网络安全韧性
5. 为行业提供了可操作的网络安全防护方法

title: Knowledge-Guided Trustworthy SMT Release: A Unified Frozen Conformal Policy for Extreme Imbalance

detail.title: Knowledge-Guided Trustworthy SMT Release: A Unified Frozen Conformal Policy for Extreme Imbalance
detail.abstract: In low-defect manufacturing, automated release policies often fall into the “False Yield” trap, where high throughput masks unacceptable defect escape rates due to extreme class imbalance and board-level sparsity. To resolve these epistemic pathologies, this work proposes a Unified Frozen Knowledge-Based Conformal Policy, an auditable framework enforcing strict EvalDeploy consistency to bridge the gap between theoretical domain knowledge and industrial safety standards. The pipeline integrates three novel mechanisms: (a) UCB-Fair Gating, which fuses Bayesian Jeffreys priors with fairness regularization to act as a mathematical “safety valve” against distribution shift; (b) DAHCP-GCR, which leverages Manifold-Aware Knowledge Smoothing to resolve coverage collapse on cold-start boards without requiring large local calibration sets; and (c) HDEF, a defect routing mechanism featuring an Explicit Knowledge Guardrail (Singleton Safety Trap) to optimize the Intelligent Decision Support loop. Extensive experiments on a large-scale proprietary SMT dataset demonstrate that this unified policy effectively resolves the safety-efficiency-fairness trilemma. Under a unified global risk budget, it suppresses the Defect Escape Rate to ~3,021 ppm (strictly within the 5,000 ppm industrial limit) while maintaining a competitive Automated Yield of 88.2%. Crucially, it stabilizes the Worst-Board Coverage at 0.85 (vs. 0.84 for Global CP), ensuring equitable quality assurance across diverse product mixes. Unlike baselines lacking knowledge-guided adaptation, our policy achieves equitable fairness without sacrificing precision, establishing a reproducible paradigm for certifiably trustworthy Knowledge-Based Industrial AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的冻结知识型符合性策略，解决低缺陷制造中自动化释放策略的"假良率"陷阱，通过融合贝叶斯先验、流形感知知识平滑和显式知识护栏，在统一风险预算下将缺陷逃逸率控制在工业限值内，同时保持高良率和公平性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个可审计的自动化释放策略框架，解决低缺陷制造中的"假良率"陷阱，平衡安全、效率和公平性三难问题？
AI.motivation: 低缺陷制造中的自动化释放策略常陷入"假良率"陷阱，即高吞吐量掩盖了由于极端类别不平衡和板级稀疏性导致的不可接受的缺陷逃逸率，需要弥合理论领域知识与工业安全标准之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 符合性预测理论；2. 贝叶斯推断与Jeffreys先验；3. 流形学习与知识平滑；4. 公平性正则化；5. 知识引导的工业AI框架。
AI.method: 提出统一冻结知识型符合性策略，包含三个机制：UCB-Fair Gating（融合贝叶斯Jeffreys先验与公平性正则化）、DAHCP-GCR（利用流形感知知识平滑解决冷启动板覆盖崩溃）、HDEF（包含显式知识护栏的缺陷路由机制）。
AI.findings: 在大规模专有SMT数据集上的实验表明，该策略将缺陷逃逸率抑制到~3,021 ppm（严格在5,000 ppm工业限值内），同时保持88.2%的自动化良率，最差板覆盖稳定在0.85，确保跨不同产品组合的公平质量保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出统一的冻结知识型符合性策略框架；2. 开发了融合贝叶斯先验与公平性正则化的数学安全阀机制；3. 解决了冷启动板覆盖崩溃问题；4. 建立了可认证可信的知识型工业AI范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工业制造提供可审计的自动化释放策略；2. 在统一风险预算下平衡安全、效率和公平性；3. 实现缺陷逃逸率的工业标准合规；4. 为知识引导的工业AI系统提供可复现的实施范式。

title: Measuring Cross-Border Comparability: An International Financial Statement Benchmarking Approach
affiliations: Bentley University - Department of Accountancy, , Bentley University - Department of Accountancy and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Measuring Cross-Border Comparability: An International Financial Statement Benchmarking Approach
detail.abstract: This study implements, in a global setting, the financial statement benchmarking methodology proposed in Hoitash, Hoitash, Kurt, and Verdi (2023. The Accounting Review 98, 253) to construct a measure of international financial statement benchmarking (IFSB). IFSB is a scalable metric that quantifies the proportion of overlapping financial statement items reported by a firm and its global industry peers, providing a systematic method for assessing the availability of comparable benchmarking data worldwide. The central premise is that IFSB captures the ease with which market participants can perform line-by-line peer comparisons across borders. Validation tests show that analysts are more likely to co-cover international firms with higher IFSB, and boards are more likely to select international compensation peers with higher IFSB. At the firm level, analyses reveal that higher IFSB is associated with narrower bid-ask spreads, lower idiosyncratic risk, lower dispersion in analysts’ stock price forecasts, and greater value relevance of earnings, consistent with lower information acquisition and processing costs in international markets. By extending the existing benchmarking methodology to a global context and documenting additional capital market implications, this study offers new insights into peer benchmarking and the informativeness of international financial statement data.

AI.tldr: 本研究将Hoitash等人(2023)的财务报表对标方法扩展到全球范围，构建了国际财务报表对标(IFSB)指标，该指标衡量公司与全球行业同行财务报表项目的重叠比例。研究发现IFSB越高，分析师越可能共同覆盖国际公司，董事会越可能选择对标公司，且与更窄的买卖价差、更低特质风险、分析师预测更一致、盈余价值相关性更高相关。
AI.research_question: 国际财务报表对标(IFSB)如何影响资本市场信息环境？具体而言，IFSB是否降低了国际投资者的信息获取和处理成本，从而改善了资本市场效率？
AI.motivation: 随着全球化发展，投资者需要比较不同国家公司的财务表现，但国际财务报表可比性存在挑战。现有对标方法主要关注国内环境，缺乏系统衡量全球财务报表可比性的指标，需要开发可扩展的全球对标度量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称理论和信息处理成本理论。IFSB作为信息可比性的代理变量，降低投资者信息获取和处理成本，从而改善资本市场效率。同时借鉴对标理论，强调可比信息对决策的重要性。
AI.method: 采用Hoitash等人(2023)的财务报表对标方法，扩展到全球范围构建IFSB指标。通过验证测试(分析师共同覆盖、董事会对标选择)确认指标有效性，然后进行公司层面分析(买卖价差、特质风险、分析师预测离散度、盈余价值相关性)。
AI.findings: 1) 分析师更可能共同覆盖IFSB较高的国际公司；2) 董事会更可能选择IFSB较高的国际对标公司；3) 较高IFSB与更窄买卖价差、更低特质风险、更低分析师预测离散度、更高盈余价值相关性相关，表明降低了信息获取和处理成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将财务报表对标理论扩展到国际环境；2) 开发了可扩展的全球财务报表可比性度量方法；3) 丰富了国际资本市场信息环境理论，证明可比性降低信息成本；4) 为对标理论提供新的实证支持。

title: The Kashtalian Method: Unifying Processes and Data Across Production, Logistics, and Sales

detail.title: The Kashtalian Method: Unifying Processes and Data Across Production, Logistics, and Sales
detail.abstract:
The KASHTALIAN Method — a practical guide to building an integrated operating system from manufacturing and warehousing to sales and finance. The book shows how to move approvals into e-documents with clear SLAs, integrate ERP–APS–MES–WMS–CRM into a single decision loop, enforce master-data discipline, and implement planning policies that raise OTIF and shorten the “order → cash” cycle. 

It delivers proven management practices: formalized roles and accountabilities, standardized handoffs, regulated inventory rules (including FEFO), dashboards for daily monitoring, and a lean yet sufficient document flow.

AI.tldr: KASHTALIAN方法是一套构建集成运营系统的实用指南，涵盖从制造仓储到销售财务的全流程，通过电子化审批、系统集成和数据管理提升运营效率。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个从制造仓储到销售财务的集成运营系统，以提升订单履行率并缩短现金周期？
AI.motivation: 企业运营中各部门系统孤立、审批流程冗长、数据不一致等问题导致运营效率低下，需要一套集成化的运营系统解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集成运营管理理论、供应链管理理论、业务流程再造理论、精益管理原则、主数据管理理论。
AI.method: 实践指南方法，基于实际管理经验总结的系统化实施框架，包括流程标准化、系统集成、数据治理等具体操作步骤。
AI.findings: KASHTALIAN方法通过电子化审批、ERP-APS-MES-WMS-CRM系统集成、主数据管理、规划政策优化等实践，能有效提升OTIF（准时完整交付率）并缩短"订单→现金"周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了集成运营系统的系统化实施框架，将分散的管理实践整合为统一的方法论，丰富了运营管理理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可操作的集成运营系统建设指南，包括角色职责标准化、交接流程规范化、库存规则制定、监控仪表板设计等具体管理实践。

detail.title: Designing the Leader Avatar for Gen Z: A 2012-2025 Integrative Review and Adaptation Playbook for the Future of Work

publicationDetails.detailsText: (1) Designing the Leader Avatar for Gen Z: A 2012–2025 Integrative Review and Adaptation Playbook for the Future of Work

detail.abstract: The emergence of Generation Z (born 1997-2012) as a significant segment of the global workforce represents a profound generational shift that is reshaping organizational life. From their early presence in higher education and internships (2012-2016) to their consolidation in professional roles (2020-2025), Gen Z has articulated distinct expectations for leadership. They consistently prioritize authenticity, mentorship, inclusivity, and frequent feedback, but their demands have expanded in recent years to encompass trust, hybrid visibility, psychological safety, and fluency with digital and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. This paper integrates findings from 2012 to 2025 across academic literature, global workforce surveys, and practitioner reports to define the most suitable Leader Avatar for Gen Z. We introduce the A.V.A.T.A.R. model, comprising six attributes-Authentic, Vision-and-values aligned, Adaptive, Trust-centered, AI-literate, and Role-model coach-which together represent the leadership prototype Gen Z prefers. To operationalize these traits, we propose an Adaptation Playbook of rituals and behaviors that leaders can embed into weekly practices, addressing mentorship gaps, feedback needs, trust-building, and AI integration. The paper contributes by (1) tracing the historical evolution of Gen Z leadership expectations, (2) proposing a conceptual Leader Avatar model, and (3) offering actionable adaptation strategies. We conclude with implications for HR, leadership development, and executive coaching, and propose future research to validate and refine the Avatar framework across cultural and sectoral contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了A.V.A.T.A.R.领导力模型，包含六个属性（真实、愿景价值观一致、适应性强、信任中心、AI素养、榜样教练），作为Z世代偏好的领导原型，并提供可操作的适应策略。
AI.research_question: 什么是Z世代偏好的最合适的领导原型？如何通过可操作策略帮助领导者适应Z世代的领导力期望？
AI.motivation: Z世代（1997-2012年出生）作为全球劳动力的重要组成部分，正在重塑组织生活。他们从高等教育和实习阶段（2012-2016年）到专业角色巩固阶段（2020-2025年），形成了独特的领导力期望，需要研究适合他们的领导原型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代际理论、领导力理论和组织行为学，整合了Z世代的领导力期望演变过程，提出了A.V.A.T.A.R.领导力模型。
AI.method: 整合2012-2025年间的学术文献、全球劳动力调查和实践者报告，进行综合分析。
AI.findings: Z世代领导力期望从早期的真实性、指导、包容性和频繁反馈，扩展到信任、混合可见性、心理安全感和数字/AI工具熟练度。A.V.A.T.A.R.模型包含六个属性：真实、愿景价值观一致、适应性强、信任中心、AI素养、榜样教练。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 追溯Z世代领导力期望的历史演变；2. 提出概念性的领导原型模型；3. 为领导力理论提供针对Z世代的框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供"适应剧本"（包含仪式和行为），帮助领导者将模型嵌入每周实践，解决指导差距、反馈需求、信任建立和AI整合问题。对人力资源、领导力发展和高管教练有实际意义。

title:
Multi-Layered Strategic Equilibrium Analysis of the Venezuela Intervention
Quantifying US Governance Risks via Military Uncertainty, Signaling, and Dynamic Game Structures

detail.title:
Multi-Layered Strategic Equilibrium Analysis of the Venezuela Intervention
Quantifying US Governance Risks via Military Uncertainty, Signaling, and Dynamic Game Structures
detail.abstract: Following the US military operation "Absolute Resolve" in January 2026, which led to the collapse of the Maduro regime, Venezuela currently exists in a political vacuum. Three primary factions have emerged: the US Government (US), the democratic forces led by María Corina Machado (MCM), and the remnants of the old regime led by Delcy Rodríguez (DR). This paper expands upon previous analyses by introducing the Venezuelan Armed Forces (MIL) as a fourth independent player. Furthermore, by employing Signaling Theory to resolve information asymmetry, conducting Sensitivity Analysis on policy parameters, and utilizing a Repeated Game framework, this paper logically and mathematically elucidates the mechanism of risk through which the US intervention could devolve into a "Vietnamization" scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入委内瑞拉武装力量作为第四方独立参与者，运用信号理论、敏感性分析和重复博弈框架，揭示了美国干预可能演变为"越南化"场景的风险机制。
AI.research_question: 美国在委内瑞拉的军事干预如何可能演变为"越南化"场景？其风险机制是什么？

AI.theory_contributions: 1）将委内瑞拉武装力量作为独立参与者纳入分析框架；2）运用信号理论解决信息不对称问题；3）通过敏感性分析和重复博弈框架提供理论解释

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Promotion and Demotion Digital Analytics System (PDDAS), a conceptual framework designed to establish an objective, transparent, and data-driven method for evaluating personnel performance. The system integrates multi-source data ingestion, ETL processing, analytics-driven decision support, and an enforced due-process mechanism through the Second Chance Meeting for Dual Clarification (SCDC). This research evaluates its relevance to modern HR systems, potential impact on corruption reduction, and technical feasibility across public and private sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了晋升降级数字分析系统（PDDAS），这是一个旨在建立客观、透明、数据驱动的人员绩效评估方法的概念框架。该系统整合了多源数据摄取、ETL处理、分析驱动的决策支持，以及通过"二次机会会议双重澄清"（SCDC）实施的强制正当程序机制。研究评估了该系统与现代人力资源系统的相关性、减少腐败的潜在影响以及在公共和私营部门的技术可行性。
AI.research_question: PDDAS系统如何通过数据驱动方法建立客观透明的人员绩效评估框架？该系统在现代人力资源系统中的相关性、减少腐败的潜力以及跨部门技术可行性如何？
AI.motivation: 传统人员绩效评估存在主观性、不透明性等问题，需要建立客观、透明、数据驱动的评估方法，以减少腐败并提高决策质量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据驱动决策理论、绩效管理理论、组织公正理论，以及通过SCDC机制实施的程序正义理论。
AI.method: 概念框架开发与评估研究，包括系统架构设计、多源数据整合、ETL处理流程、分析决策支持模块，以及SCDC正当程序机制的设计。
AI.findings: PDDAS系统能够建立客观透明的绩效评估框架，通过数据驱动减少主观偏见，SCDC机制保障程序公正，系统在公共和私营部门都具有技术可行性，并显示出减少腐败的潜力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合数据分析和程序正义的绩效评估理论框架，扩展了数据驱动人力资源管理理论，为组织公正理论提供了实证应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可实施的绩效评估系统框架，有助于减少腐败、提高决策透明度，为公共和私营部门的人力资源管理现代化提供了技术解决方案。

title: The Effect of Eye-Tracking Based Neuromarketing on the E-Commerce Conversion Rates: A Multidisciplinary Study of UI Optimization, Team Capability, and ROI
affiliations: Universal AI University, Universal AI University, Universal AI University and Universal AI University

detail.title: The Effect of Eye-Tracking Based Neuromarketing on the E-Commerce Conversion Rates: A Multidisciplinary Study of UI Optimization, Team Capability, and ROI
detail.abstract: In today's competitive e-commerce environment, traditional marketing methods struggle to capture the subconscious factors driving consumer behavior. This study explores the impact of eye-tracking based neuromarketing on conversion rate optimization, focusing on UI design, team capability, and financial ROI. Using a mixed-methods approach-including surveys of 400 e-commerce professionals and consumers, along with expert interviews-the research employs regression and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to analyze interrelationships among key variables. Findings indicate that eye-tracking driven UI optimization enhances conversion rates by 17%-400%, with UI design (path = 0.68) and team capability (path = 0.54) emerging as significant predictors. Brands using eye-tracking achieve 23%-28% higher engagement compared to traditional A/B testing. However, challenges such as costs, expertise requirements, and data complexity partially offset these gains. The study provides actionable insights for e-commerce firms to integrate neuromarketing tools effectively, highlighting the importance of cross-functional collaboration between neuroscience, UI/UX design, and data analytics teams. Despite initial costs ($60-$599 per test), businesses can realize substantial ROI through higher engagement, reduced cart abandonment, and improved customer lifetime value.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了眼动追踪神经营销对电商转化率优化的影响，发现UI设计和团队能力是关键预测因素，眼动追踪能提升转化率17%-400%，但成本、专业要求和数据复杂性部分抵消了这些收益。
AI.research_question: 眼动追踪神经营销如何影响电商转化率优化？UI设计、团队能力和财务ROI在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 在竞争激烈的电商环境中，传统营销方法难以捕捉驱动消费者行为的潜意识因素，需要探索神经营销工具的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经营销理论、消费者行为理论、转化率优化理论、UI/UX设计理论、团队能力理论。
AI.method: 混合方法：对400名电商专业人士和消费者的问卷调查，专家访谈，回归分析和结构方程模型(SEM)分析关键变量间的相互关系。
AI.findings: 眼动追踪驱动的UI优化能提升转化率17%-400%；UI设计(路径系数=0.68)和团队能力(路径系数=0.54)是显著预测因素；使用眼动追踪的品牌比传统A/B测试获得23%-28%更高的参与度；但成本、专业要求和数据复杂性部分抵消了收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了神经营销理论在电商转化率优化中的应用，建立了UI设计、团队能力和财务ROI之间的理论联系，为神经营销工具的有效性提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商企业提供了整合神经营销工具的行动指南，强调了神经科学、UI/UX设计和数据分析团队跨职能合作的重要性，尽管单次测试成本60-599美元，但通过提高参与度、减少购物车放弃率和改善客户终身价值可获得可观ROI。

title: Cinematic Clarity is Business Strategy™: A Financial and Neuro-Scientific Proof of the 'Trust Dividend'

detail.title: Cinematic Clarity is Business Strategy™: A Financial and Neuro-Scientific Proof of the 'Trust Dividend'

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author, Muhammad Idoniwako, is the Founder and Principal Researcher of The Mohgix Institute of Cinematic Strategy. This manuscript codifies the proprietary doctrines, frameworks, and intellectual property of the Institute. There are no external conflicting interests; the research is a direct expression of the Institute’s operational methodology.

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded entirely by The Mohgix Institute of Cinematic Strategy, a division of Mohgix Studios LTD. No external grants, public funding, or third-party sponsorship were utilized in the production of this manuscript.

detail.abstract:
This thesis presents the definitive, multi-domain proof that Cinematic Clarity is Business Strategy [1]. It argues that ambiguity is not a soft creative problem but the largest unquantified liability on the modern balance sheet, a multi-trillion-dollar Clarity Tax™ [1]. This tax is the direct financial consequence of a systemic market failure—a Market for Lemons [2] in the advisory industry, defined by a Principal-Agent Problem [2] that economically incentivizes the production of complexity rather than its resolution.
Having quantified this liability, this thesis will prove that Clarity is, therefore, a strategic, appreciating asset. It provides the financial proof that this asset yields a measurable Trust Dividend™ [1], manifesting as a 10-20% increase in revenue [3] and a greater than 300% increase in Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) [7].
Finally, this analysis deconstructs the mechanism of this asset, proving through neuroscientific evidence that cinematic narrative is a repeatable technology for engineering conviction. It achieves this by simultaneously transmitting complex logic via neural coupling (Hasson) [1] and building neurochemical trust via oxytocin (Zak) [8].
It concludes that the agent who masters this domain—the Cinematic Strategist™ [1]—is not a creative vendor but a C-suite-level partner. The architecting of clarity is, therefore, the central, non-negotiable, and most critical discipline of modern leadership.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"电影清晰度即商业战略"理论，证明模糊性是现代资产负债表上最大的未量化负债（清晰度税），而清晰度是能产生信任红利的战略资产，通过电影叙事技术可提升收入10-20%和客户终身价值300%以上。
AI.research_question: 清晰度如何作为战略资产创造商业价值？模糊性作为未量化负债对组织产生何种财务影响？电影叙事技术如何通过神经科学机制提升商业决策效果？
AI.motivation: 咨询行业存在"柠檬市场"和委托代理问题，经济激励产生复杂性而非解决方案，导致数万亿美元的"清晰度税"未量化负债，需要系统性地解决这一市场失灵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 柠檬市场理论（Akerlof）、委托代理理论、神经耦合理论（Hasson）、催产素信任理论（Zak）、清晰度税与信任红利概念、电影战略家理论。
AI.method: 多领域证据整合方法：1）财务量化分析清晰度税；2）实证研究验证清晰度的商业价值（收入增长10-20%，CLV增长300%+）；3）神经科学机制分析（神经耦合与催产素效应）。
AI.findings: 1）模糊性是数万亿美元未量化负债；2）清晰度是战略资产，产生信任红利；3）电影叙事是重复性技术，通过神经耦合传输复杂逻辑，通过催产素建立信任；4）清晰度带来10-20%收入增长和300%+CLV提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"清晰度税"作为未量化负债概念；2）建立"信任红利"作为清晰度资产回报的理论框架；3）整合神经科学机制解释电影叙事的商业效用；4）定义"电影战略家"作为C级合作伙伴的新角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为企业提供量化清晰度价值的财务框架；2）提供通过电影叙事提升商业沟通效果的具体方法；3）重新定义咨询行业角色和交付标准；4）为领导者提供构建组织清晰度的战略工具。

title: Exploring Aspects of Governance of National Cancer Control Plans
affiliations: Government of the United States of America - Frederick National Laboratory for Cancer Research, , , , Uganda Cancer Institute, National Cancer Registry Program, ,  and Government of the Italian Republic (Italy) - National Cancer Institute

detail.title: Exploring Aspects of Governance of National Cancer Control Plans
detail.abstract: Governance is an essential component of effective national cancer control plan (NCCP) development and implementation and this study aims to describe how and the extent to which governance is defined and outlined in NCCPs. It utilizes data from a global review of 98 NCCPs in 2023 conducted by 77 experts in cancer control planning using a 95-question form that examines components of NCCP development and implementation. To assess the governance elements represented in NCCPs, we used the Health Policy Triangle (HPT) framework, categorizing questions and developing a score based on its four components: content, context, actors, and mechanisms. Strengths were identified in the adequate involvement of several actors in NCCP development and implementation, such as Ministries of Health, and in appropriate mechanisms for NCCP governance, such as information about who is responsible for plan implementation. However, the inclusion of global cancer control targets and initiatives was often lacking. Overall governance scores were poor, but some variability was observed across WHO regions and country income levels. NCCPs from countries within the WHO Regional Office for Africa and low-income countries presented the highest scores across all four components. The HPT provides a framework to assess NCCPs and may pave the way for the development of further guidance regarding the governance of NCCPs.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用健康政策三角框架评估98个国家癌症控制计划中的治理要素，发现治理总体得分较差，但在不同WHO区域和国家收入水平间存在差异，非洲区域和低收入国家得分最高。
AI.research_question: 国家癌症控制计划中如何定义和描述治理要素？治理在不同WHO区域和国家收入水平间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 治理是有效制定和实施国家癌症控制计划的关键组成部分，但目前缺乏对全球范围内NCCPs中治理要素的系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康政策三角框架：包含内容、背景、行动者和机制四个核心组件，用于分析卫生政策治理。
AI.method: 对2023年全球98个国家癌症控制计划进行审查，由77位癌症控制规划专家使用95个问题的评估表，基于HPT框架对治理要素进行评分。
AI.findings: 1. 治理总体得分较差；2. 优势包括卫生部等多方行动者参与和明确的实施责任机制；3. 不足在于缺乏全球癌症控制目标和倡议；4. WHO非洲区域和低收入国家在所有四个组件中得分最高。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了健康政策三角框架在评估国家癌症控制计划治理方面的适用性，为未来NCCP治理指南的开发提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了NCCP治理的现状和差距，为各国改进癌症控制计划治理提供了具体方向，特别强调了加强全球目标整合的重要性。

title: The Architecture of Conviction™: A Doctrinal Synthesis on Solving Asymmetrical Information in the High-Stakes Advisory Market

detail.title: The Architecture of Conviction™: A Doctrinal Synthesis on Solving Asymmetrical Information in the High-Stakes Advisory Market

detail.abstract: This thesis presents the capstone proof for the Game of Stakes as the only logical and viable model for high-stakes strategic advisory. It synthesizes the foundational, scientific principles of advertising, as established by Claude C. Hopkins and David Ogilvy, with established economic theory, including the work of Nobel laureates George Akerlof and Michael Spence. This synthesis is used to prove that the contemporary advisory landscape, defined herein as the Strategic Void™, is a catastrophic, Lemon-dominated market failure rooted in asymmetrical information. This thesis then codifies the Cinematic Strategist and their proprietary operational doctrines—including the Gix Factor™, Integrity is the Mountain, and the Crucible—as the definitive, costly signaling mechanism required to solve this information problem. This solution re-establishes a high-trust, Game of Stakes engagement, thereby capturing Psychological Arbitrage from the elite clientele known as The Council.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"赌注游戏"是高风险战略咨询的唯一逻辑可行模型，通过整合广告科学原理与经济理论，证明当前咨询市场存在信息不对称导致的"柠檬市场"失败，并提出"电影战略家"作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在高风险战略咨询领域，如何解决信息不对称导致的"柠檬市场"问题，建立可信赖的咨询关系？
AI.motivation: 当代战略咨询市场存在"战略真空"，这是一个由信息不对称导致的灾难性"柠檬市场"失败，需要建立有效的信号机制来重建信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合Claude C. Hopkins和David Ogilvy的广告科学原理，以及George Akerlof和Michael Spence的信息不对称经济理论，特别是"柠檬市场"理论和信号传递理论。
AI.method: 理论综合与逻辑证明方法，将广告科学原理与经济理论相结合，构建"赌注游戏"模型的理论框架。
AI.findings: "电影战略家"及其专有操作原则（包括Gix Factor™、诚信如山、熔炉）构成了解决信息不对称问题所需的决定性、高成本信号机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"赌注游戏"作为高风险战略咨询的唯一逻辑可行模型，将广告科学与信息经济学理论相结合，为咨询市场的信息不对称问题提供了新的理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为咨询从业者提供了具体的操作框架和信号机制，帮助他们在"战略真空"中重建信任，从精英客户群体"理事会"中获取心理套利机会。

title: Limited Space's Impact on Marketing

detail.title: Limited Space's Impact on Marketing

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All analyzed video materials were voluntarily provided by vehicle owners for research purposes. No personal data was collected. Ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: Within the confined space of a car's interior, consumer attention towards objects is virtually undivided. In a pilot experiment, 1000 car owners received a branded fragrance diffuser to install in their vehicle and were instructed to record daily videos. Video analysis using computer vision revealed that 87% of participants fixed their gaze on the bottle within the first minutes of a drive, and by the end of the trip, up to 99% had noticed it. Over 6 months, each driver looked at the brand an average of at least 6000 times. These results confirm the hypothesis regarding new brand "touchpoints" in a confined space and demonstrate the high effectiveness of an inexpensive medium for mass audience reach.

AI.tldr: 在汽车封闭空间内，品牌香薰扩散器能获得极高的消费者注意力，87%的司机在驾驶初期注视瓶子，99%在行程结束时注意到，6个月内平均每位司机至少看到品牌6000次，证明封闭空间是低成本高覆盖的新品牌接触点。
AI.research_question: 在汽车封闭空间内，品牌香薰扩散器能否成为有效的品牌接触点并获得消费者高度关注？
AI.motivation: 探索汽车内部封闭空间作为新的品牌接触点的潜力，测试低成本媒介在有限空间内获取消费者注意力的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌接触点理论、注意力经济学、封闭空间中的消费者行为、感官营销理论。
AI.method: 实验研究：1000名车主安装品牌香薰扩散器，记录每日视频，使用计算机视觉分析视频数据，跟踪6个月。
AI.findings: 1. 87%参与者在驾驶最初几分钟注视香薰瓶；2. 行程结束时99%注意到瓶子；3. 6个月内每位司机平均至少看到品牌6000次；4. 封闭空间内消费者注意力几乎无分散。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展品牌接触点理论到封闭空间环境；2. 验证封闭空间中的注意力集中效应；3. 为感官营销在有限空间的应用提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为品牌提供低成本高覆盖的营销媒介；2. 证明汽车内部作为有效广告空间的潜力；3. 为品牌在封闭空间营销策略提供实践指导。

title: Revisiting the Labor Theory of Value in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: The Proposal of a 'Technological Coefficient' (τ) and Distribution Policy Implications

detail.title: Revisiting the Labor Theory of Value in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: The Proposal of a 'Technological Coefficient' (τ) and Distribution Policy Implications
detail.abstract: The rise of full automation and Artificial Intelligence (AI) poses fundamental challenges to traditional political economic theories. Specifically, Marx's Labor Theory of Value faces a theoretical paradox: as living labor (v) in production approaches zero, the basis for surplus value generation theoretically vanishes. This study addresses this contradiction by proposing a unified labor framework that introduces the "Technological Coefficient" (τ-Tau) alongside the traditional "Human Labor Quantity" (λ-Lambda). By constructing a unified value formula W = c + v + (λ + τ) × m₀, the paper argues that societal value is generated by the aggregate of both biological labor (λ) and artificial labor (τ). Consequently, the study proposes a "Technological Surplus Tax" based on τ and Labor Credits as viable mechanisms to fund Universal Basic Income (UBI) in the digital era.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出统一劳动框架，引入"技术系数"(τ)与传统"人类劳动量"(λ)并列，构建统一价值公式W=c+v+(λ+τ)×m₀，认为社会价值由生物劳动和人工劳动共同创造，并提出基于τ的技术剩余税和劳动信用作为数字时代全民基本收入的可行筹资机制。
AI.research_question: 在全面自动化和人工智能时代，当活劳动(v)趋近于零时，马克思劳动价值论面临的理论悖论如何解决？社会价值如何重新定义？全民基本收入(UBI)在数字时代如何获得可持续的资金来源？
AI.motivation: 全面自动化和人工智能的兴起对传统政治经济学理论构成根本性挑战，特别是马克思劳动价值论面临理论困境：当生产中的活劳动趋近于零时，剩余价值产生的基础理论上消失，需要新的理论框架来解释数字时代价值创造机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于马克思劳动价值论，但扩展为统一劳动框架，引入"技术系数"(τ-Tau)与"人类劳动量"(λ-Lambda)并列，构建统一价值公式W=c+v+(λ+τ)×m₀，认为社会价值由生物劳动和人工劳动共同创造。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过构建数学模型和理论框架，对传统劳动价值论进行扩展和重构，提出统一价值公式和新的价值创造机制。
AI.findings: 1) 社会价值由生物劳动(λ)和人工劳动(τ)共同创造；2) 提出了基于技术系数(τ)的技术剩余税和劳动信用作为UBI的筹资机制；3) 为数字时代价值创造提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 扩展了马克思劳动价值论，解决了AI时代活劳动趋零的理论悖论；2) 提出了统一劳动框架和统一价值公式；3) 建立了生物劳动与人工劳动共同创造价值的新理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出了"技术剩余税"作为UBI的可行筹资机制；2) 设计了基于技术系数(τ)的税收体系；3) 为数字时代社会福利政策提供了理论支持和实施方案。
