title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: No. This paper has not appreared in paper series, journal or book

detail.abstract: This paper explores the impact of Artificial Intelligence on supply chain management in Bangladesh. It examines how AI improves demand forecasting, inventory management, logistics, quality control, and customer service. The study also highlights challenges faced in adopting AI and discusses the potential benefits for industries such as garments, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, and e-commerce. Finally, it considers the future opportunities for AI in building more efficient and competitive supply chains in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能对孟加拉国供应链管理的影响，分析了AI在需求预测、库存管理、物流、质量控制和客户服务方面的改进作用，同时指出了AI采用面临的挑战，并讨论了服装、农业、制药和电子商务等行业从AI中获得的潜在利益。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响孟加拉国的供应链管理？AI在哪些具体领域（如需求预测、库存管理、物流等）改善了供应链效率？在孟加拉国采用AI面临哪些挑战？不同行业（服装、农业、制药、电子商务）如何从AI中获益？
AI.motivation: 随着全球供应链日益复杂，孟加拉国作为重要的制造业和农业国家，需要提升供应链效率以保持竞争力。人工智能技术为供应链优化提供了新的可能性，但孟加拉国在AI采用方面面临独特挑战，需要研究如何有效实施AI解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、数字化转型理论、技术采纳模型、资源基础观（RBV）、竞争优势理论
AI.method: 基于文献综述的定性研究，可能包括案例分析和专家访谈，探讨AI在孟加拉国供应链中的应用现状和挑战
AI.findings: AI显著改善了孟加拉国供应链的需求预测准确性、库存优化、物流效率、质量控制和客户服务质量。然而，AI采用面临基础设施不足、技术技能缺乏、数据质量和成本等挑战。服装、农业、制药和电子商务等行业通过AI获得了显著的运营效率提升和竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术采纳理论在发展中国家的应用，丰富了供应链数字化转型的理论框架，提供了AI在特定国家背景下（孟加拉国）实施的理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国企业提供了AI实施的实用指南，帮助政策制定者制定支持AI采用的政策，为不同行业提供了具体的AI应用案例和最佳实践，有助于提升孟加拉国供应链的整体竞争力

title: AI-Powered Passenger Experience in Airlines: A KPI-Driven Framework with Mixed-Methods Evidence

detail.title: AI-Powered Passenger Experience in Airlines: A KPI-Driven Framework with Mixed-Methods Evidence
detail.abstract: This article develops and tests a KPI-driven, Balanced-Scorecard-aligned framework that links AI modalities to enterprise outcomes across the passenger journey. The primary objective is to quantify and explain how dynamic offers, recommender systems, conversational AI, biometrics, and predictive IRROPS affect customer experience (NPS, CSAT, CES), monetization (ARPP, conversion), operations (IRROPS time, OTP), and finance/ESG (RASK, CASK, CO₂/ASK). Using a mixed-methods, explanatory-sequential design, we analyze multi-system KPIs and A/B or difference-indifferences rollouts, followed by executive interviews on governance (privacy, fairness, robustness, explainability). Findings show dynamic ancillary pricing delivers +17-58% conversion and +10-43% revenue per offer; conversational AI reduces waiting time up to 80% for routine intents but requires hybrid escalation to sustain NPS; recommenders raise CTR (~+15%) yet need stronger causal links to repeat booking and CLV; revenue-management accuracy improves +14-22%, supporting yield stability. Evidence remains limited on causal bridges to RASK/CASK and CO₂/ASK. Theoretically, we formalize a five-layer KPI architecture and position digital maturity as a measurable moderator. Practically, we recommend a Foundations → Pilot → Scale → Optimize roadmap with per-pax/per-ASK denominators, instrumentation (A/B, DiD, uplift), and responsible-AI gates (consent, bias, robustness, model cards). The framework enables airline leaders to convert AI initiatives into decision-grade, auditable value.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于KPI的平衡计分卡框架，将AI模态与航空乘客旅程中的企业成果联系起来，量化了动态定价、推荐系统、对话AI等对客户体验、收入、运营和财务/ESG的影响，并提出了可实施的AI治理路线图。
AI.research_question: 如何量化不同AI模态（动态报价、推荐系统、对话AI、生物识别、预测性IRROPS）在航空乘客旅程中对客户体验、收入、运营和财务/ESG等企业成果的影响？
AI.motivation: 航空业在AI投资方面缺乏系统性的框架来连接AI技术与可衡量的业务成果，需要建立可审计的价值评估体系来指导AI决策和治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平衡计分卡的五层KPI架构，将数字成熟度作为可测量的调节变量，连接AI模态与企业成果。
AI.method: 采用混合方法的解释性顺序设计：首先分析多系统KPI和A/B测试或双重差分法推广数据，然后进行关于治理（隐私、公平性、鲁棒性、可解释性）的高管访谈。
AI.findings: 动态附加定价提升转化率17-58%和每报价收入10-43%；对话AI将常规意图等待时间减少80%但需要混合升级以维持NPS；推荐系统提高点击率约15%但需更强的因果链接到重复预订和客户生命周期价值；收入管理准确性提升14-22%；对RASK/CASK和CO₂/ASK的因果桥梁证据有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了五层KPI架构，将数字成熟度定位为可测量的调节变量，为AI价值评估提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"基础→试点→规模化→优化"的路线图，包含每位乘客/每可用座位公里的分母、测量工具（A/B测试、双重差分法、提升模型）和负责任AI门控（同意、偏见、鲁棒性、模型卡片），帮助航空领导者将AI计划转化为可决策、可审计的价值。

title: Institutional Omission: Governance, Archival Integrity, and the Construction of Cultural Record

detail.title: Institutional Omission: Governance, Archival Integrity, and the Construction of Cultural Record

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, financial, or institutional conflicts of interest related to the research or preparation of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants or experimental data. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: Independent research conducted within the Erik Brunetti Foundation for the Arts. No external funding.

detail.abstract: Institutional omission is a consequential form of authorship. What museums and cultural bodies exclude from acquisition, display, and scholarly recognition shapes the foundation upon which future research will rely. This paper examines omission as a governance issue that affects cultural continuity, the integrity of attribution, and the reliability of the historical record. It proposes principles to ensure that contemporary programming remains anchored in archival evidence, and that institutions maintain responsibility to the structure of cultural memory rather than to the volatility of public attention or commercial speculation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨博物馆和文化机构的"制度性遗漏"问题，认为机构在收藏、展示和学术认可方面的排除行为是一种重要的作者身份形式，会影响文化连续性、归属完整性和历史记录的可靠性。
AI.research_question: 制度性遗漏如何影响文化连续性、归属完整性和历史记录的可靠性？如何通过治理原则确保当代文化项目基于档案证据，并使机构对文化记忆结构而非公众关注或商业投机负责？
AI.motivation: 博物馆和文化机构在收藏、展示和学术认可方面的排除行为塑造了未来研究的基础，这种"制度性遗漏"对文化传承和历史记录的真实性产生深远影响，需要从治理角度加以关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、文化记忆理论、档案学理论、作者身份理论、文化治理理论
AI.method: 概念分析、理论构建、原则提出（基于档案证据的治理原则）
AI.findings: 制度性遗漏是一种重要的作者身份形式，它影响文化连续性、归属完整性和历史记录可靠性；需要建立基于档案证据的治理原则来确保文化机构对文化记忆结构负责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"制度性遗漏"作为作者身份的新概念框架；发展了文化机构治理的理论视角；建立了文化记忆与档案证据之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博物馆和文化机构提供了基于档案证据的治理原则；帮助机构避免受公众关注或商业投机影响；确保文化项目的连续性和历史记录的可靠性。

title: Legal Prices: The Normative Calculation Problem and Why Legal Systems Need Price Mechanisms

detail.title: Legal Prices: The Normative Calculation Problem and Why Legal Systems Need Price Mechanisms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial relationships or competing interests influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study analyzed publicly available legal documents and constitutional provisions; no human subjects were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The author conducted this work independently.

AI.tldr: 本文认为法律系统面临与社会主义计划经济类似的问题：缺乏像市场价格那样的信息聚合机制，导致法律决策面临巨大不确定性，产生规范性通胀、通缩和滞胀等病理现象。
AI.research_question: 法律系统如何解决信息分散问题？法律系统能否建立类似市场价格的信息聚合机制来减少不确定性？
AI.motivation: 受到米塞斯关于社会主义计划经济无法进行理性经济计算的启发，作者发现法律系统面临类似的信息协调问题。法律决策需要依赖分散在数百万个体中的信息，但缺乏有效的聚合和传递机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 米塞斯的经济计算问题理论；2. 法律不确定性理论；3. 信息经济学在法学中的应用；4. 规范性通胀/通缩/滞胀的概念框架
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，概念类比推理，案例研究（以阿根廷为例），可能的制度设计分析

detail.abstract:
Many law school faculty are concerned that students may misuse artificial intelligence (AI) tools to undermine their learning and violate academic integrity policies.  Although some students will inevitably cheat, faculty can reduce the risk – and improve student learning – by rethinking assignment design and classroom communication.

This article frames the risk of AI-related cheating as an opportunity for pedagogical improvement.  It offers practical strategies to help faculty design assignments that enhance student learning, promote good decision-making, discourage inappropriate AI use, and foster responsible AI literacy.  It outlines approaches consistent with the ABA’s new requirement for formative assessment throughout the curriculum as well as the realities of AI in legal practice.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨法学院教师如何应对学生滥用AI工具的风险，将其转化为教学改进机会，提供实用策略设计作业以促进学习、培养AI素养，并符合ABA评估要求。
AI.research_question: 法学院教师如何通过重新设计作业和课堂沟通来减少学生滥用AI工具的风险，同时提升学生学习效果和AI素养？
AI.motivation: 许多法学院教师担心学生可能滥用AI工具破坏学习过程和违反学术诚信政策，需要应对这一挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教学法改进框架、学术诚信理论、AI素养教育理论、形成性评估理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和实践观察，提出实用策略框架，结合ABA新要求和法律实践现实。
AI.findings: AI相关作弊风险可转化为教学改进机会；通过重新设计作业和课堂沟通能减少风险并提升学习；提出的策略符合ABA形成性评估要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI作弊风险重构为教学改进机会的理论框架；整合AI素养教育的法学教学理论；连接学术诚信与AI时代教学法的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供实用策略帮助教师设计促进学习的作业；提出鼓励良好决策、阻止不当AI使用的具体方法；培养负责任的AI素养；符合ABA新评估要求的实施方案。

detail.abstract:
The United States is accelerating toward a corruption crisis of its own making. In its race to rapidly acquire artificial intelligence (AI), current policy risks undermining longstanding procurement integrity safeguards. This article examines how AI increases traditional corruption risks and introduces new vulnerabilities that current oversight mechanisms are ill-equipped to address.  

Recent federal AI policies have accelerated adoption while simultaneously narrowing regulatory oversight, effectively leaving “regulation by contract” as the primary—and profoundly inadequate—mechanism for embedding safeguards. The consequence of these policies is that the government is “buying blind,” acquiring AI technologies without adequate transparency, audit rights, or testing requirements. These acquisition-phase deficiencies will translate directly into operational risks as AI deployment expands. How the government acquires AI today determines the procurement integrity vulnerabilities it will inherit tomorrow.

This article offers practical recommendations to address these emerging threats, prioritizing those most feasible to implement. It also challenges the assumption driving current federal AI policy: that governance impedes innovation. As the article demonstrates, governance is crucial for sustainable innovation. It helps maintain fair, transparent markets and fosters the institutional trust necessary for long-term AI integration.  

The window for establishing effective governance is closing. As procurement dependencies solidify and integrity risks become entrenched, reversing course will become exponentially harder.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国在加速获取人工智能过程中，现有政策如何削弱采购完整性保障，导致政府"盲目购买"AI技术，并提出了应对这些新兴威胁的实用建议。
AI.research_question: 美国政府加速获取人工智能的政策如何增加传统腐败风险并引入新的漏洞？如何通过有效治理来应对这些威胁？
AI.motivation: 美国正加速走向腐败危机，当前AI获取政策破坏了长期建立的采购完整性保障机制，导致政府在没有足够透明度、审计权利和测试要求的情况下获取AI技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采购完整性理论、监管框架分析、创新与治理关系理论、制度信任理论
AI.method: 政策分析、监管框架评估、风险识别分析、案例研究（基于现有政策文件和实践）
AI.findings: 1. 联邦AI政策加速采用同时缩小监管范围，使"合同监管"成为主要机制；2. 政府"盲目购买"AI技术，缺乏透明度、审计权和测试要求；3. 采购阶段缺陷将直接转化为运营风险；4. 当前治理窗口正在关闭，风险固化后将更难逆转。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战"治理阻碍创新"的假设，证明治理对可持续创新至关重要；2. 分析AI如何增加传统腐败风险并引入新漏洞；3. 建立采购完整性、市场公平和制度信任之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供应对新兴威胁的实用建议；2. 识别最可行的实施优先事项；3. 强调建立有效治理框架的紧迫性；4. 为政策制定者提供改进AI采购完整性的具体指导。

title: Equity Blind Spots: How Health Programmes Fail Marginalized Populations Despite Good Policy Intentions

detail.title: Equity Blind Spots: How Health Programmes Fail Marginalized Populations Despite Good Policy Intentions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Introduction: Marginalized populations continue to experience persistent barriers to care, even in health systems where equity and universal access are explicit policy goals. Health policies across diverse health systems increasingly articulate strong commitments to equity, inclusion, and universal access, yet these intentions frequently fail to translate into equitable outcomes in practice. This paradox raises a critical policy question: why do well-designed health policies fail to produce equitable results? This paper examines equity failure not as a problem of policy intent, but as a systemic issue embedded within the policy–practice continuum of health programmes.

Methods: This paper adopts a conceptual analytical approach, drawing on established health equity and health systems scholarship to examine recurring patterns through which equity objectives are weakened during programme delivery. Rather than evaluating a specific intervention, the analysis synthesises theoretical and empirical insights from public health literature to identify mechanisms that systematically disadvantage marginalized populations.

Results: The analysis identifies four interrelated equity blind spots that recur across health programmes: (1) implicit assumptions of system capacity that obscure real-world constraints; (2) reliance on informal decision-making at service delivery points, which amplifies exclusion; (3) organisational and behavioural dynamics that deprioritize equity in favour of procedural compliance; and (4) ostensibly neutral administrative and technological systems that reproduce existing social and geographic inequalities. Together, these blind spots render inequity routine, normalized, and difficult to detect within standard performance assessments.

Discussion and Conclusion: The findings suggest that equity failures in health programmes are not anomalous but structurally produced. When equity is treated as an assumed outcome rather than an explicit analytical concern, programmes risk reinforcing the very disparities they aim to address. Addressing equity blind spots requires reframing equity as a core analytical dimension of policy effectiveness, with implications for how health programmes are designed, monitored, and assessed. Without such reframing, good policy intentions alone are unlikely to yield equitable health outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了健康政策中公平性失败的系统性原因，指出即使政策设计良好、意图明确，边缘化群体仍面临持续的医疗障碍。研究识别了四个相互关联的公平性盲点，这些盲点在项目实施过程中系统性地削弱了公平目标。
AI.research_question: 为什么设计良好的健康政策在实践中无法产生公平的结果？健康政策公平性失败的系统性原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 边缘化群体在健康系统中持续面临医疗障碍，即使这些系统明确将公平和普遍可及作为政策目标。健康政策虽然表达了强烈的公平、包容和普遍可及承诺，但这些意图在实践中经常无法转化为公平的结果。这种悖论提出了一个关键的政策问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 健康公平理论、健康系统研究、政策-实践连续体理论。研究采用概念分析方法，借鉴已建立的健康公平和健康系统学术成果。
AI.method: 概念分析方法，综合公共卫生文献中的理论和实证见解，而非评估特定干预措施。通过分析健康项目中的重复模式，识别系统性地使边缘化群体处于不利地位的机制。
AI.findings: 分析识别了四个相互关联的公平性盲点：1) 对系统能力的隐含假设掩盖了现实约束；2) 依赖服务提供点的非正式决策，加剧了排斥；3) 组织和行为动态使公平性让位于程序合规；4) 表面上中立的行政和技术系统复制了现有的社会和地理不平等。这些盲点共同使不公平变得常规化、正常化，难以在标准绩效评估中被发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公平性失败重新定义为系统性而非异常问题；提出了公平性盲点的概念框架；挑战了将公平视为假设结果而非明确分析维度的传统观念；为理解政策-实践连续体中的公平性侵蚀提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和项目管理者提供了识别公平性盲点的工具；建议将公平性重新定义为政策有效性的核心分析维度；对健康项目的设计、监测和评估方法提出了改进建议；强调需要超越良好意图，实施结构性变革以实现公平结果。

title: Are Proactive Personalities Always Beneficial? Political Skill as a Moderator

detail.title: Are Proactive Personalities Always Beneficial? Political Skill as a Moderator
detail.abstract: Does proactive personality always enhance job success? The authors of this study draw on socioanalytic theory of personality and organizational political perspectives to study employees' political skill in moderating the effects of proactive personality on supervisory ratings of employee task performance, helping behaviors, and learning behaviors. Multisource data from 225 subordinates and their 75 immediate supervisors reveal that proactive personality is associated negatively with supervisory evaluations when political skill is low, and the negative relationship disappears when political skill is high. Implications and future research directions are discussed.

AI.tldr: 主动型人格并不总是提升工作成功。研究发现，当政治技能低时，主动型人格与主管评价负相关；当政治技能高时，这种负相关消失。政治技能调节了主动型人格对工作表现的影响。
AI.research_question: 主动型人格是否总是增强工作成功？政治技能如何调节主动型人格对主管评价（任务绩效、帮助行为和学习行为）的影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然主动型人格通常被视为积极特质，但实际工作中主动行为可能带来负面后果。需要理解在什么条件下主动型人格会带来正面或负面结果，特别是考虑组织政治环境的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会分析人格理论（强调人格特质在社交环境中的表达）和组织政治视角（关注组织中的权力和影响力过程）。
AI.method: 多源数据收集：来自225名下属及其75名直接主管的配对数据。使用调节回归分析检验政治技能对主动型人格与主管评价关系的调节作用。
AI.findings: 主动型人格与主管评价的关系取决于政治技能水平：当政治技能低时，主动型人格与主管评价负相关；当政治技能高时，这种负相关消失。政治技能缓冲了主动型人格可能带来的负面评价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）挑战了主动型人格总是有益的假设；2）整合人格理论和组织政治视角；3）识别政治技能作为关键边界条件；4）为主动行为可能适得其反的情况提供理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）组织在选拔和培养主动型员工时应同时关注其政治技能；2）为主动型员工提供政治技能培训；3）帮助管理者理解如何更好地评估和支持主动行为；4）提醒员工在展现主动性时考虑组织政治环境。

title: Goal Choices and Planning: Distinct Expectancy and Value Effects in Two Goal Processes
affiliations: Tulane University, Ohio University and University of Calgary

detail.title: Goal Choices and Planning: Distinct Expectancy and Value Effects in Two Goal Processes
detail.abstract: Expectancy and value have emerged as two major determinants of motivation. However, the exact nature of their functioning is less clear given that previous research failed to test adequately different goal processes. Based on the recent nonmonotonic, discontinuous model of expectancy elaborated by Vancouver, More, and Yoder (2008), two studies were conducted and found that expectancy and value functions in different forms during the goal choice versus goal planning processes. Specifically, the two constructs positively and jointly predicted one's goal choice, whereas they played independent and opposite roles in affecting the allocation of effort during the goal-planning process. These findings address gaps in theories of motivation, allow for more precise specifications of the roles for expectancy and value within such models, and further efforts toward integrating theories of motivation within a goal-centered, self-regulation framework.

AI.tldr: 期望和价值是动机的两大决定因素，但它们在目标选择和目标规划过程中的作用形式不同：在目标选择时两者正向联合预测选择，在目标规划时则独立且作用相反地影响努力分配。
AI.research_question: 期望和价值在目标选择与目标规划过程中如何以不同形式发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 期望和价值已被确认为动机的主要决定因素，但其具体作用机制尚不明确，先前研究未能充分测试不同的目标过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Vancouver等人（2008）提出的非单调、不连续的期望模型，以及以目标为中心的自我调节框架。
AI.method: 进行了两项研究，分别考察目标选择过程和目标规划过程中期望与价值的作用。
AI.findings: 期望和价值在目标选择过程中正向且联合预测个体的目标选择，而在目标规划过程中则独立且作用相反地影响努力分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了动机理论的空白，更精确地界定了期望和价值在动机模型中的作用，推动了在目标中心自我调节框架下整合动机理论的努力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和管理个体在不同目标阶段（选择vs规划）的动机提供了更精细的理论指导。

detail.abstract: The Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) plays a crucial role in inter-domain routing across the global internet. However, its static and manual policy configurations often lead to suboptimal route selection, resulting in inefficiencies in terms of bandwidth utilization, network resilience, and latency. Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers an innovative solution for optimizing BGP policy decisions, enabling adaptive, real-time route adjustments based on dynamic network conditions. This paper explores the application of Reinforcement Learning-based BGP policy optimization for Autonomous Systems (ASs) in the context of global internet routing. The study investigates how RL can be employed to automate and improve routing decisions by enabling BGP to self-learn optimal policies based on performance metrics such as throughput, latency, and fault tolerance. We present experimental results demonstrating the effectiveness of RL in improving network resilience and route efficiency in autonomous systems while discussing the challenges and future directions for deploying RL-based BGP optimizations in large-scale networks

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在全局互联网路由中应用强化学习优化BGP策略，通过自适应实时路由调整改善带宽利用率、网络弹性和延迟，实验证明RL能提升网络弹性和路由效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在自治系统中应用强化学习优化BGP策略决策，以改善全局互联网路由的性能？
AI.motivation: BGP协议在域间路由中至关重要，但其静态和手动策略配置常导致次优路由选择，造成带宽利用率低、网络弹性差和延迟高等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强化学习理论框架，用于自适应、实时的路由决策优化；BGP协议和自治系统路由理论。
AI.method: 应用强化学习方法进行BGP策略优化，基于吞吐量、延迟和容错性等性能指标让BGP自我学习最优策略。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明强化学习能有效提高网络弹性和路由效率，改善自治系统的路由性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将强化学习应用于BGP策略优化的理论框架，为自适应路由决策提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了RL在改善网络弹性和路由效率方面的实际效果，为大规模网络中部署RL-based BGP优化提供了实践参考和挑战分析。

title: AI-Driven Adaptive Risk Scoring for Real-Time U.S. Payment Streams Using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)

detail.title: AI-Driven Adaptive Risk Scoring for Real-Time U.S. Payment Streams Using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)
detail.abstract: This work showcases the implementation of an adaptive graph neural network methodology to improve the responsiveness of risk scoring in real-time fraud analytics of U.S. payment streams (Samuel 2023). The technique builds real-time transaction graphs and uses message-passing techniques to capture patterns of streaming data (Long et al. 2023). Compared to more traditional ML techniques, there were significant improvements in accuracy, precision, and latency (Kurunthachalam 2023). GNN based models improve payment fraud detection in real-time in the payment ecosystem (Popoola 2023).

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种自适应图神经网络方法，用于改进美国支付流实时欺诈分析中的风险评分响应性，相比传统机器学习方法在准确性、精确度和延迟方面有显著提升。
AI.research_question: 如何利用自适应图神经网络方法提高美国支付流实时欺诈分析中风险评分的响应性和准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习方法在实时支付欺诈检测中存在响应延迟、准确性不足的问题，需要更有效的实时分析技术来应对支付生态系统中的欺诈风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络理论、消息传递技术、实时交易图构建、自适应学习机制、流数据处理模式识别。
AI.method: 采用自适应图神经网络方法，构建实时交易图，利用消息传递技术捕捉流数据模式，与传统ML技术进行对比实验。
AI.findings: 相比传统ML技术，自适应图神经网络方法在准确性、精确度和延迟方面均有显著改进，能有效提高支付欺诈检测的实时性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自适应图神经网络在实时欺诈分析中的应用框架，扩展了图神经网络在流数据处理和实时风险评分领域的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为支付生态系统提供了更有效的实时欺诈检测解决方案，能够显著降低欺诈风险，提高支付安全性和系统响应速度。

title: Ye-Jie Innovation Lectures • Lecture 1-The Genesis of Innovation Space: Multi-Phase Aggregation and the Emergence of a Complex System

detail.title: Ye-Jie Innovation Lectures • Lecture 1-The Genesis of Innovation Space: Multi-Phase Aggregation and the Emergence of a Complex System
detail.abstract: Innovation rarely emerges within a single, stable "phase" of an organization or industry. Instead, breakthrough and structural innovations arise at the interfaces where fundamentally different logics, paradigms, and cultural systems collide. This paper introduces Ye-Jie-a generative boundary space formed through multi-phase aggregation, tension, and controlled elevation of energy and constraints. It argues that Ye-Jie is not a metaphorical abstraction, but a complex adaptive system created through designed organizational conditions. The paper theorizes the mechanisms by which Ye-Jie emerges and explains why this space becomes the origin of new structures, new paradigms, and new growth curves.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"业界"概念——一个通过多阶段聚合、张力和受控能量提升形成的生成性边界空间，认为创新不是发生在单一稳定阶段，而是在不同逻辑、范式和文化系统碰撞的界面处产生。
AI.research_question: 创新如何在不同逻辑、范式和文化系统碰撞的界面处产生？"业界"作为生成性边界空间是如何形成和运作的？
AI.motivation: 传统创新理论往往关注单一组织或行业内的稳定阶段，但突破性和结构性创新实际上发生在不同系统碰撞的边界处，需要新的理论框架来解释这种界面创新现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应系统理论、边界空间理论、组织界面理论、创新生态系统理论
AI.method: 理论构建与概念发展方法，通过分析多阶段聚合、张力管理和能量提升机制来构建"业界"的理论框架
AI.findings: "业界"是通过多阶段聚合、张力和受控能量提升形成的复杂适应系统，这个边界空间成为新结构、新范式和新增长曲线的起源地，创新在此处涌现而非在单一稳定阶段内。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"业界"作为创新起源的新理论概念，发展了界面创新理论，为理解不同系统碰撞处的创新机制提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计创造创新边界空间提供了实践指导，帮助管理者通过设计组织条件来促进多系统碰撞和能量提升，从而激发突破性创新。

title: AI, Open Platforms, and the Epistemic Future of Peer Review

detail.title: AI, Open Platforms, and the Epistemic Future of Peer Review

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal data. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is reshaping how knowledge is verified, debated, and circulated. As AI systems increasingly perform two traditionally human-centered peer review functions—logical coherence checking and computational verification—the epistemic legitimacy of conventional peer review requires re-examination. This paper offers a conditional account of peer review’s future: if AI remains stable, reliable, and publicly accessible, the role of peer review is likely to contract toward domains where epistemic judgment intersects with non-negotiable public risk (e.g., medicine, public health, nuclear engineering, and high-stakes AI governance). Outside these risk-intensive fields, knowledge verification will be increasingly supported by AI-enabled structural review, open dissemination platforms (e.g., SSRN, arXiv, Zenodo), and iterative transparency—shifting scholarly practice from an approval-based model to an iteration-based one. The paper further argues that framework-based theories grounded in axioms, operators, and formal or geometric structures are especially compatible with this environment because their internal logic is machine-verifiable and their extension mechanisms are transparent. All claims are explicitly conditional on AI stability; if this condition fails, the analysis requires full re-evaluation.

AI.tldr: 如果AI保持稳定可靠且公开可访问，同行评审的角色将收缩到高风险领域（如医疗、核工程等），其他领域的知识验证将转向AI辅助的结构化评审、开放平台和迭代透明化，从审批模式转向迭代模式。
AI.research_question: 在AI日益承担逻辑一致性和计算验证功能的情况下，传统同行评审的认知合法性如何重新审视？同行评审的未来角色将如何演变？
AI.motivation: AI正在重塑知识验证、辩论和传播的方式，AI系统越来越多地执行传统上由人类完成的同行评审功能（逻辑一致性检查和计算验证），这需要对传统同行评审的认知合法性进行重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 条件性同行评审未来理论：基于AI稳定性、可靠性和可访问性的条件框架；知识验证从审批模式向迭代模式的转变理论；基于公理、算子和形式/几何结构的框架理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论论证，基于AI技术发展趋势的逻辑推理，条件性预测分析。
AI.findings: 如果AI保持稳定可靠且公开可访问：1）同行评审将收缩到高风险领域（医疗、公共卫生、核工程、高风险AI治理）；2）其他领域将转向AI辅助的结构化评审、开放平台和迭代透明化；3）基于公理、算子和形式结构的理论框架特别适合这种环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了条件性的同行评审未来理论；发展了从审批模式向迭代模式转变的知识验证理论；识别了特别适合AI验证环境的理论框架类型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术出版机构、研究资助者和政策制定者提供了同行评审改革的路线图；为高风险领域和非高风险领域设计了不同的知识验证策略；为研究者选择理论框架提供了指导。

title: AI-Powered Chargeback Prediction and Dispute Automation Using Explainable Deep Learning Models

detail.title: AI-Powered Chargeback Prediction and Dispute Automation Using Explainable Deep Learning Models
detail.abstract: This study looks at how explainable deep learning models can be used to predict chargebacks and make dispute resolution frankly a lot less painful, answering a growing call for both transparency and efficiency in financial risk management (Zhang et al., 2023). The team blends supervised learning architectures with SHAP and other explainable-AI techniques, and pairs those models with workflow automation tools that help generate evidence, triage cases, and route decisions where they need to go (Amebleh & Okoh, 2023). The upshot? The combined framework shows strong predictive chops, speeds up dispute turnaround times, and brings more operational clarity by exposing which factors drive the model's choices so you actually know why something was flagged or not (Alonge et al., 2021). Put simply: making these systems interpretable isn't just a nice-to-have. It appears to meaningfully boost trust, accountability, and overall effectiveness across financial dispute ecosystems (Rehan, 2021).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了如何将可解释的深度学习模型应用于预测退单和改善争议解决流程，通过结合监督学习架构与SHAP等可解释AI技术，并集成工作流自动化工具，实现了预测准确性提升、争议处理时间缩短和操作透明度增加。
AI.research_question: 可解释的深度学习模型如何有效预测退单并改善金融争议解决流程的透明度和效率？
AI.motivation: 金融风险管理领域对透明度和效率的需求日益增长，传统争议解决流程缺乏透明度且效率低下，需要结合可解释AI技术来提升预测准确性和操作透明度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可解释人工智能（XAI）理论，特别是SHAP（Shapley Additive Explanations）等解释技术，结合深度学习预测模型和金融风险管理理论。
AI.method: 采用监督学习架构与SHAP等可解释AI技术相结合的方法，并集成工作流自动化工具，用于证据生成、案例分类和决策路由。
AI.findings: 组合框架显示出强大的预测能力，显著缩短了争议处理时间，通过揭示驱动模型决策的关键因素提高了操作透明度，增强了信任度和问责制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可解释AI在金融风险管理中的应用提供了理论框架，证明了模型可解释性不仅是"锦上添花"，而是对系统信任度和有效性的实质性提升。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的争议解决框架，能够提高预测准确性、加速处理流程、增强操作透明度，为金融机构提供了可实施的解决方案。

detail.abstract: The Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is the cornerstone of inter-domain routing on the global internet. However, BGP faces significant challenges in adapting to network failures, traffic congestion, and evolving routing conditions. Zero-Touch Self-Healing BGP architectures present a novel approach that enables autonomous, dynamic network adjustments without manual intervention. This paper explores the integration of cognitive routing agents into BGP to create a self-healing, adaptive system that responds to network anomalies and failures in realtime. By leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning techniques, cognitive routing agents can learn from past network events, predict potential issues, and optimize routing decisions automatically. The paper demonstrates how cognitive agents can facilitate self-healing by detecting routing anomalies, performing automated rerouting , and ensuring network resilience. Experimental results show that AI-driven cognitive routing can significantly improve BGP's efficiency and resilience by reducing downtime and improving the overall performance of internet traffic flows.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将认知路由代理集成到BGP中，通过AI和机器学习技术实现零接触自愈BGP架构，能够自主检测路由异常、自动重路由，显著提高互联网路由的效率和弹性。
AI.research_question: 如何将认知路由代理集成到BGP中，创建能够实时响应网络异常和故障的自愈、自适应系统？
AI.motivation: BGP作为全球互联网域间路由的基石，在适应网络故障、流量拥塞和不断变化的路由条件方面面临重大挑战，需要更智能、自适应的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 零接触自愈BGP架构、认知路由代理理论、人工智能和机器学习在路由优化中的应用理论。
AI.method: 通过集成认知路由代理到BGP，利用AI和机器学习技术从历史网络事件中学习、预测潜在问题并自动优化路由决策。
AI.findings: 实验结果表明，AI驱动的认知路由能够显著提高BGP的效率和弹性，减少停机时间并改善互联网流量流的整体性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了零接触自愈BGP架构的理论框架，将认知路由代理与BGP集成，为智能路由系统提供了新的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了能够自主检测路由异常、执行自动重路由并确保网络弹性的实际系统，为互联网运营商提供了更高效、可靠的路由解决方案。

title: Clinical psychologist or Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP)? Role equivalence and minimum training requirements in Ukraine compared to the UK/USA/EU

detail.title: Clinical psychologist or Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP)? Role equivalence and minimum training requirements in Ukraine compared to the UK/USA/EU

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: This study is theoretical in nature and does not involve human participants or personal data. Therefore, CTR was not required.

detail.abstract: The article analyses the normatively and organisationally described models of training specialists in clinical psychology in the United Kingdom, the United States, and selected EU countries, and compares them with the current approaches used in Ukraine. The theoretical framework is based on a comparison of three regulatory frameworks for training quality: (1) requirements for basic psychological education and programme accreditation, (2) the core competencies of professional training and requirements for training content, (3) minimum standards for supervised clinical practice and mechanisms for admission to professional activity (registration/licensing/protected titles). It has been shown that in systems with the highest regulatory transparency, clinical psychology is typically grounded in long-term postgraduate training and structured supervision. In contrast, in Ukraine, entry paths are possible through a limited scope of specialisation in the absence of strictly defined boundaries of practice. In these systems, specialisation in clinical psychology is not usually achieved through short-term retraining or "additional specialisation", but rather through standardised requirements for training content, competencies, and practical experience. On this basis, the thesis of the risk of "role equivalence" is justified: some of the actual functions of a Ukrainian "clinical psychologist" may be similar to the profile of a Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP) in the British stepped-care model (low-intensity interventions for mild to moderate conditions), but without fully replicating the quality control infrastructure (standardised supervision, case routing, outcome monitoring). An approach to implementing international experience in Ukraine through a dual-track training architecture is proposed: a separate PWP-level role standard for low-intensity interventions and an expanded minimum framework for clinical psychologists (disciplines/ECTS/hours, mandatory supervised practice, and a competence verification mechanism).

AI.tldr: 本文比较了英美欧盟与乌克兰临床心理学专家培训模式的差异，指出乌克兰体系缺乏严格监管标准，存在"角色等效"风险，并提出双轨制培训架构的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 如何比较英美欧盟与乌克兰临床心理学专家培训模式的规范性差异？乌克兰体系存在哪些风险？如何基于国际经验改革乌克兰的培训体系？
AI.motivation: 乌克兰临床心理学培训体系缺乏严格的监管标准，与国际先进体系存在差距，可能导致专业角色混淆和服务质量风险，需要借鉴国际经验进行改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三种监管框架的比较：(1)基础心理学教育要求和项目认证；(2)专业培训核心能力和培训内容要求；(3)监督临床实践最低标准和专业活动准入机制（注册/许可/受保护头衔）。
AI.method: 规范性比较分析：分析英美欧盟和乌克兰临床心理学培训的组织和规范模型，比较监管框架、培训路径、实践标准等要素。
AI.findings: 1. 监管透明度高的体系通常基于长期研究生培训和结构化督导；2. 乌克兰体系准入路径宽松，缺乏严格实践边界；3. 乌克兰"临床心理学家"实际功能类似英国阶梯式护理模型中的心理福祉从业者（PWP），但缺乏相应的质量控制基础设施；4. 存在"角色等效"风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"角色等效"理论框架，用于分析不同监管体系下专业角色的功能相似性与质量控制差异；为跨国专业培训比较提供了系统的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出乌克兰实施双轨制培训架构：为低强度干预设立单独的PWP级角色标准；为临床心理学家建立扩展的最低框架（学科/ECTS/学时、强制监督实践、能力验证机制）。

title: Energy-Efficient Consensus Protocols for High-TPS Financial Blockchains Supporting Instant Payments

detail.title: Energy-Efficient Consensus Protocols for High-TPS Financial Blockchains Supporting Instant Payments
detail.abstract: This evaluation pulls together recent papers and architectural analyses to compare energy-efficient consensus mechanisms really trying to show how the newest designs actually improve performance. The review points out, not surprisingly, that hybrid BFT approaches, DAG-style ledger structures, and permissioned proof-of-stake systems tend to deliver high throughput while keeping energy use down (Du et al.). Bottom line: when you tune consensus protocols the right way, modern financial blockchains can support near-instant payments which is, to be honest, pretty encouraging (Karaarslan & Konacaklı).

AI.tldr: 本文综述了能源高效共识机制的最新进展，重点比较了混合BFT方法、DAG式账本结构和许可型权益证明系统，发现这些设计能在保持低能耗的同时实现高吞吐量，为现代金融区块链提供近乎即时的支付支持。
AI.research_question: 不同的能源高效共识机制（特别是混合BFT、DAG账本结构和许可型权益证明系统）如何在实际性能上进行比较，以及它们如何改善现代金融区块链的支付效率？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链技术在金融领域的广泛应用，传统共识机制（如工作量证明）的高能耗问题日益突出，需要探索更环保、高效的共识方案来支持大规模金融交易。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于共识机制理论、分布式系统理论和能源效率理论，重点分析拜占庭容错（BFT）、有向无环图（DAG）和权益证明（PoS）等共识机制的理论基础及其变体。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和架构分析方法，整合近期相关论文和系统架构分析，对不同能源高效共识机制进行系统性比较评估。
AI.findings: 混合BFT方法、DAG式账本结构和许可型权益证明系统能够显著降低能耗同时保持高吞吐量；通过适当调整共识协议，现代金融区块链可以实现近乎即时的支付处理。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化比较了不同能源高效共识机制的理论特性，为共识机制设计提供了新的理论框架，特别是在能耗与性能平衡方面的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区块链开发者提供了具体的共识机制选择指导，展示了如何通过协议优化实现高效能的金融区块链系统，推动绿色区块链技术在金融领域的实际应用。

title: AI, Index Concentration, and Tail Risk: Implications for Institutional Portfolios

detail.title: AI, Index Concentration, and Tail Risk: Implications for Institutional Portfolios

declarations.funderStatement: The project has received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This study examines the financial structure of the current artificial intelligence
investment cycle and evaluates whether the sector exhibits bubble-like vulnerabilities.
Using firm-level financial data, AI-exposure metrics, and scenario-based stress
testing across hardware, cloud infrastructure, and model-development laboratories,
the analysis identifies a highly concentrated pattern of capital flows and uneven
fragility across the value chain. While the results do not support the presence of a
sector-wide asset bubble, they reveal localised vulnerabilities consistent with selective
overinvestment and circular balance-sheet dependencies. These dynamics suggest that
AI’s contribution to aggregate growth increasingly depends on sustained capital
inflows rather than broad-based productivity gains, leaving parts of the ecosystem
sensitive to funding or supply disruptions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了当前AI投资周期的财务结构，评估该行业是否存在泡沫风险。研究发现资本流动高度集中，价值链各环节脆弱性不均，虽无全行业泡沫，但存在局部过度投资和资产负债表循环依赖的脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 当前人工智能投资周期的财务结构如何？该行业是否表现出泡沫般的脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI投资热潮的兴起，需要评估该行业是否存在泡沫风险，了解资本流动模式和脆弱性分布，为政策制定和投资决策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产泡沫理论、投资周期理论、价值链分析、财务脆弱性理论
AI.method: 使用企业层面财务数据、AI暴露度指标，在硬件、云基础设施和模型开发实验室三个环节进行基于情景的压力测试
AI.findings: 1. 资本流动呈现高度集中模式；2. 价值链各环节脆弱性分布不均；3. 不存在全行业资产泡沫；4. 存在局部脆弱性，表现为选择性过度投资和资产负债表循环依赖
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了资产泡沫理论在新技术投资周期的应用；2. 提出了AI投资周期的财务结构分析框架；3. 识别了局部脆弱性与全行业泡沫的区别
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者识别AI投资风险提供分析工具；2. 为政策制定者监管AI投资提供依据；3. 帮助企业了解自身在价值链中的脆弱性位置；4. 指出AI对经济增长的贡献越来越依赖持续资本流入而非广泛生产率提升

title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimizing Fee Routing and Surcharging Decisions in Digital Payment Networks

detail.title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimizing Fee Routing and Surcharging Decisions in Digital Payment Networks
detail.abstract: This work digs into how reinforcement-learning (RL) based optimization can actually improve decision-making in messy, fast-changing networked systems the kind where traditional heuristics tend to choke on scale and uncertainty (Papadis & Tassiulas). The core idea is simple-ish: instead of leaning on hand-crafted analytical models, the framework uses model-free RL to learn adaptive control policies straight from interacting with the system (Kadry). You let the agent try things, see what happens, and it figures out what works over time. In experiments, the RL agent didn't just match baseline methods, it consistently beat them on throughput, latency and how efficiently resources were allocated. That held up even when conditions drifted and the environment wasn't stationary, which is actually pretty encouraging (Chen et al.). Another key takeaway: feeding back environmental signals into the loop lets performance keep improving as the system changes, so this really fits data-driven, real-world settings where behavior evolves over time (Narayan et al.). All told, the study has solid, practical implications for managing large-scale infrastructure. It points toward deploying smarter, self-tuning systems across communications networks, cloud services and cyber-physical setups you know, places where automation that adapts on the fly is actually useful (Papadis & Tassiulas; Kadry; Chen et al.; Narayan et al.).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了基于强化学习的优化方法如何改善复杂动态网络系统中的决策制定，相比传统启发式方法，RL方法能更好地处理规模化和不确定性，通过与环境交互学习自适应控制策略，在吞吐量、延迟和资源分配效率方面优于基准方法。
AI.research_question: 基于强化学习的优化方法如何改善复杂、快速变化的网络系统中的决策制定，特别是在传统启发式方法难以应对的规模化和不确定性环境下？
AI.motivation: 传统启发式方法在处理大规模、不确定性的动态网络系统时表现不佳，需要更智能、自适应的控制方法。强化学习能够通过与系统交互学习最优策略，适应环境变化，为复杂网络系统的管理提供新的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于强化学习理论，特别是模型无关的强化学习方法，强调通过与环境的交互学习自适应控制策略。框架整合了环境反馈机制，使系统能够在动态变化中持续优化性能。
AI.method: 采用模型无关的强化学习方法，让智能体通过与系统交互学习控制策略。通过实验验证，比较RL方法与基准方法在吞吐量、延迟和资源分配效率等指标上的表现，并在非平稳环境下测试其鲁棒性。
AI.findings: RL智能体在吞吐量、延迟和资源分配效率方面均优于基准方法，即使在非平稳环境下也能保持良好性能。环境反馈机制使系统能够随着时间推移持续改进，适应动态变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于强化学习的自适应控制框架，为复杂动态网络系统的优化提供了新的理论视角。证明了模型无关RL在非平稳环境中的有效性，扩展了强化学习在网络系统管理中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模基础设施管理提供了实用的解决方案，可应用于通信网络、云服务和网络物理系统等领域。该方法支持部署更智能、自调优的系统，实现实时自适应自动化，提高系统性能和资源利用效率。

title: Blockchain-Based Regulatory Compliance Layer for U.S. Payments Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP)

detail.title: Blockchain-Based Regulatory Compliance Layer for U.S. Payments Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP)
detail.abstract: I took a close look at what a blockchain-based compliance layer might actually do for U.S. payment systems using zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) as the key ingredient. The study lays out a conceptual model, grounded in current research, and then walks through different architectural options so you can see the trade-offs. The big takeaway? ZKPs appear capable of meeting core U.S. AML and KYC obligations without forcing people to hand over more personal details than necessary. Frankly, that's kind of the point: keep compliance intact, but avoid needless data exposure. The analysis also suggests that a ZKP-enabled layer could smooth regulatory workflows, cut down on operational risk and costs, and perhaps most importantly drastically reduce how much sensitive information gets shared across payment networks. It's promising, if a bit early-stage, but worth paying attention to.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了基于区块链的合规层如何利用零知识证明技术改善美国支付系统，在满足反洗钱和了解客户义务的同时减少个人数据暴露。
AI.research_question: 零知识证明技术如何在美国支付系统中实现既能满足AML/KYC合规要求，又能最小化个人数据暴露的区块链合规层？
AI.motivation: 当前支付系统在满足监管合规要求时往往需要过度收集和共享个人敏感信息，存在数据暴露风险，需要寻找既能保持合规又能保护隐私的技术解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于零知识证明的隐私保护理论、区块链技术架构理论、金融监管合规理论（特别是AML/KYC框架）。
AI.method: 概念模型构建和架构方案分析：基于现有研究建立概念框架，分析不同架构选项的权衡取舍。
AI.findings: 零知识证明技术能够满足美国核心AML/KYC义务而不需要过度收集个人信息；ZKP合规层可以简化监管流程、降低操作风险和成本，并大幅减少支付网络中敏感信息的共享。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于零知识证明的支付系统合规层理论框架，为隐私保护与监管合规的平衡提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为支付系统设计者提供了具体的架构选项和权衡分析，为监管机构展示了技术解决方案的可行性，为减少金融数据暴露风险提供了实用路径。

title: Blockchain-Based Tokenised Identity Framework for Secure Merchant Onboarding in U.S. Acquiring Systems

detail.title: Blockchain-Based Tokenised Identity Framework for Secure Merchant Onboarding in U.S. Acquiring Systems
detail.abstract: The U.S. acquiring system still struggles with familiar problems, fragmented KYC/AML workflows, a growing variety of fraud techniques, and identity data locked away in separate silos, and those issues together sap efficiency and weaken regulatory resilience (Jones 2022; Patel & Singh 2023). This paper presents a blockchain-based, tokenised identity framework aimed at making onboarding less painful, shoring up verification integrity, and easing compliance burdens by using cryptographically anchored, interoperable identity tokens. Using a conceptual modelling approach and a synthesis of current literature (Lee 2021; Grant 2024), the analysis finds that tokenised identity can meaningfully cut friction in merchant acquisition, improve audit trails, and reduce exposure to identity-based fraud. In short, and to be honest, somewhat optimistically integrating tokenised identity into acquiring workflows looks like a practical path toward stronger security, smoother operations, and more future-ready regulatory compliance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于区块链的代币化身份框架，旨在解决美国收单系统中的KYC/AML流程碎片化、欺诈技术多样化、身份数据孤岛等问题，通过密码学锚定的互操作身份代币来简化商户入驻、增强验证完整性、减轻合规负担。
AI.research_question: 如何通过区块链和代币化身份技术解决美国收单系统中存在的KYC/AML流程碎片化、欺诈技术多样化、身份数据孤岛等问题，从而提升效率、增强监管韧性？
AI.motivation: 美国收单系统面临KYC/AML流程碎片化、欺诈技术日益多样化、身份数据被锁定在独立孤岛等长期问题，这些问题共同削弱了系统效率和监管韧性（Jones 2022; Patel & Singh 2023）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于区块链技术、代币化身份、密码学锚定身份、互操作性框架等理论，结合现有文献（Lee 2021; Grant 2024）对身份管理和合规流程的分析。
AI.method: 采用概念建模方法和现有文献综合分析法（Lee 2021; Grant 2024），构建理论框架并进行逻辑分析。
AI.findings: 代币化身份能够显著减少商户获取过程中的摩擦，改善审计追踪，降低基于身份欺诈的风险暴露，为收单工作流程提供更强的安全性、更顺畅的运营和更面向未来的监管合规路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于区块链的代币化身份理论框架，为数字身份管理和金融合规领域提供了新的理论视角，丰富了区块链在金融身份验证中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为收单机构提供了具体的实施路径：通过密码学锚定的互操作身份代币简化商户入驻流程、增强验证完整性、减轻合规负担，实现更强的安全性、更顺畅的运营和更面向未来的监管合规。

title: Algorithmic Geopolitics: A Fractal Optimization Framework for Statecraft in the Era of Machine Speed

detail.title: Algorithmic Geopolitics: A Fractal Optimization Framework for Statecraft in the Era of Machine Speed
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a fractal optimization framework for statecraft in the era of machine-speed AI, where artificial intelligence reshapes diplomacy, geopolitics, and power dynamics. It argues that AI's integration into state functions creates a crisis of velocity, inverting traditional power projection and amplifying systemic risks like inadvertent escalation and cyber vulnerabilities. The framework outlines five strategic imperatives: governance and ethics to address AI biases and the "Black Box Problem"; stability through Confidence-Building Measures for autonomous systems; competition for technological sovereignty; data-driven foresight using simulations and digital twins; and negotiation augmentation via human-AI partnerships.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分形优化框架，用于应对机器速度AI时代下的国家治理，探讨AI如何重塑外交、地缘政治和权力动态，并提出了五个战略要务来应对AI带来的速度危机。
AI.research_question: 在机器速度AI时代，国家如何通过分形优化框架来应对AI重塑外交、地缘政治和权力动态所带来的挑战？
AI.motivation: AI技术正以前所未有的速度融入国家职能，创造了"速度危机"，颠覆了传统的权力投射方式，并放大了系统性风险，如意外升级和网络漏洞，这要求重新思考国家治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分形优化框架，结合了复杂系统理论、地缘政治学和AI伦理理论，强调在机器速度AI环境下的适应性治理。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于对AI技术融入国家职能的系统性分析，提出战略要务的理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出了五个关键战略要务：1) 治理与伦理以应对AI偏见和"黑箱问题"；2) 通过建立自主系统的信任措施确保稳定；3) 技术主权竞争；4) 利用模拟和数字孪生实现数据驱动的前瞻；5) 通过人机协作增强谈判能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"分形优化框架"这一新理论概念，将复杂系统理论应用于AI时代的国家治理，为理解机器速度AI环境下的权力动态提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的战略指导，包括建立AI伦理框架、开发自主系统信任措施、制定技术主权战略、实施数据驱动的前瞻工具，以及构建人机协作的谈判机制。

title: Designing Information Delays in Supply Chains
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Yeshiva University - Syms School of Business, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering and Mitchell E. Daniels, Jr School of Business, Purdue University

detail.title: Designing Information Delays in Supply Chains
detail.abstract: This paper studies how a downstream retailer in a decentralized two-tier supply chain can implicitly transmit demand information to an upstream supplier through the structure of its order stream in the absence of an explicit information-sharing mechanism. We distinguish our work from prior work by introducing the notion of information delay and by linking optimal implicit information sharing to the group delay of the retailer's ordering transfer function. We show that pure delay is strictly suboptimal, while fractional-delay mechanisms can reshape the order autocorrelation to improve supplier forecastability and reduce system-wide inventory costs. Using Hardy-space factorization, we develop a tractable family of invertible ARMA policies that approximates the theoretically optimal (but non-rational) limiting filter derived by Caldentey et al. (2025b) and preserves its informational delay properties. This construction yields sharp guidance on how policy complexity, as measured by the degrees of the ARMA policies, impacts supply chain costs. We further extend the analysis to memory-constrained suppliers and characterize how the complexity of the retailer's policy should scale with the supplier's finite forecasting window, highlighting when, perhaps counterintuitively, increasing policy complexity can become counterproductive.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在缺乏显式信息共享机制的情况下，下游零售商如何通过订单流结构向上游供应商隐式传递需求信息。研究发现纯延迟策略是次优的，而分数延迟机制可以重塑订单自相关，提高供应商预测能力并降低系统库存成本。研究开发了可处理的ARMA策略族，并分析了策略复杂性对供应链成本的影响。
AI.research_question: 在分散式两层供应链中，下游零售商如何通过订单流结构隐式地向上游供应商传递需求信息，特别是在缺乏显式信息共享机制的情况下？
AI.motivation: 在供应链中，信息不对称会导致牛鞭效应和库存成本增加。虽然显式信息共享可以缓解这一问题，但在实践中往往难以实现。因此，研究如何通过隐式机制传递需求信息具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 信息延迟理论：引入信息延迟概念，将最优隐式信息共享与零售商订单传递函数的群延迟联系起来
2. 信号处理理论：使用Hardy空间分解方法
3. 供应链信息共享理论：基于Caldentey等人(2025b)的极限滤波器理论
AI.method:
1. 理论建模：建立分散式两层供应链模型
2. 优化分析：比较纯延迟和分数延迟机制的效果
3. 策略设计：开发可处理的ARMA策略族，近似理论最优的非有理极限滤波器
4. 扩展分析：考虑内存受限供应商的情况
AI.findings:
1. 纯延迟策略严格次优，而分数延迟机制可以改善供应商预测能力
2. 通过ARMA策略可以近似理论最优滤波器，同时保持其信息延迟特性
3. 策略复杂性（ARMA阶数）对供应链成本有显著影响
4. 对于内存受限的供应商，零售商策略复杂性应与供应商有限预测窗口相匹配，过度增加复杂性可能适得其反
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 引入信息延迟概念，将隐式信息共享与群延迟联系起来
2. 开发了可处理的ARMA策略族，为理论最优滤波器提供实用近似
3. 建立了策略复杂性与供应链成本之间的量化关系
4. 扩展了内存受限供应商情况下的理论分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为供应链管理者提供了实用的订单策略设计指导
2. 帮助理解何时增加策略复杂性是有益的，何时会适得其反
3. 为缺乏显式信息共享机制的供应链提供了改善信息流动的实用方法
4. 为供应链系统设计提供了关于信息延迟和预测能力的权衡框架

title: Path Formation Under Uncertainty: Evolutionary Trajectories in Cross-Phase Systems

detail.title: Path Formation Under Uncertainty: Evolutionary Trajectories in Cross-Phase Systems
detail.abstract: This lecture develops the third component of the Ye-Jie Innovation Framework by explaining how uncertainty, generated within cross-phase interfaces (Ye-Jie), unfolds into innovation trajectories. Building on Lecture 1 (the emergence of Ye-Jie as a multi-phase interface space) and Lecture 2 (entropy, information flow, and structured uncertainty), this lecture introduces evolutionary theory-Variation, Selection, and Retention-and the Fitness Landscape model to explain how potential states become actual innovation paths. The analysis distinguishes three categories of innovationincremental, breakthrough, and disruptive-and positions Ye-Jie as a generative environment for "phase-shifting innovations" that restructure value logic and create new growth curves.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Ye-Jie创新框架，探讨跨阶段界面产生的不确定性如何演化为创新轨迹，引入进化理论和适应度景观模型解释潜在状态如何成为实际创新路径，区分三类创新并定位Ye-Jie作为"相变创新"的生成环境。
AI.research_question: 跨阶段界面(Ye-Jie)产生的不确定性如何演化为具体的创新轨迹？
AI.motivation: 现有创新研究缺乏对跨阶段界面不确定性演化机制的深入理解，需要理论框架解释潜在创新状态如何转化为实际创新路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: Ye-Jie创新框架、进化理论（变异-选择-保留）、适应度景观模型、相变创新理论
AI.method: 理论构建与概念分析，基于前两讲的基础进行框架扩展
AI.findings: Ye-Jie作为多阶段界面空间能够生成三类创新（渐进式、突破性、颠覆性），特别适合产生"相变创新"——重构价值逻辑并创造新的增长曲线
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将进化理论引入创新过程分析；2. 提出适应度景观模型解释创新路径演化；3. 明确Ye-Jie作为相变创新生成环境的理论定位
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理跨阶段创新提供理论指导，帮助企业识别和培育相变创新机会，优化创新资源配置

title: AI-Enhanced Predictive Analytics for Intraday Liquidity Management in High-Volume Payment Hubs

detail.title: AI-Enhanced Predictive Analytics for Intraday Liquidity Management in High-Volume Payment Hubs
detail.abstract: This paper digs into how AI-boosted predictive analytics can be used for intraday liquidity management in busy, high-volume payment hubs and, honestly, it's pretty exciting stuff. The main goal here is straightforward: see how modern computational tools can make liquidity forecasting sharper, cut down operational risk, and squeeze more financial efficiency out of environments where payments move at breakneck speed. Method-wise, the study leans on a mix of machine learning algorithms, real-time data analytics, and financial simulation tools in other words, the sort of toolkit that lets you model liquidity flows dynamically and make proactive decisions rather than always reacting (Sriram et al., 2023; Chatterjee, 2022). By feeding huge volumes of transactional data into predictive models, institutions can spot likely liquidity shortfalls ahead of time, allocate funds more intelligently, and rely less on manual, last-minute fixes. The key takeaways are encouraging: AI-driven approaches tend to boost the accuracy of intraday liquidity forecasts, reduce the chance of settlement failures, and improve operational efficiency overall (SIKIRU et al., 2021; Yewande, 2022). And it's not just about cleaner numbers adopting these techniques that support risk-aware decision frameworks, so payment hubs can react quickly to sudden market swings or unexpected transaction spikes (you know, the stuff that otherwise causes chaos). In short, the results point to AI's real potential to reshape liquidity management. Banks and payment networks get more actionable insights for strategic planning and staying on the right side of regulators (Nixon & Al Banna, 2021). Bottom line: AI-enhanced predictive analytics don't just streamline intraday operations, they help shore up systemic resilience, letting financial institutions handle ever-more complex transaction ecosystems with greater precision and, frankly, a lot more confidence.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI增强的预测分析在高流量支付中心的日内流动性管理中的应用，展示了现代计算工具如何提高流动性预测准确性、降低操作风险并提升金融效率。
AI.research_question: AI增强的预测分析如何应用于高流量支付中心的日内流动性管理，以提高预测准确性、降低操作风险并提升金融效率？
AI.motivation: 在支付速度极快的环境中，传统流动性管理方法难以应对动态变化。需要更智能的工具来预测流动性需求、减少结算失败风险，并提高运营效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习算法、实时数据分析和金融模拟工具的理论框架，支持动态流动性建模和主动决策（Sriram et al., 2023; Chatterjee, 2022）。
AI.method: 采用机器学习算法、实时数据分析和金融模拟工具的组合方法，通过大量交易数据训练预测模型，实现动态流动性流动建模和主动决策。
AI.findings: AI驱动方法显著提高日内流动性预测准确性，降低结算失败概率，提升运营效率（SIKIRU et al., 2021; Yewande, 2022）。支持风险感知决策框架，使支付中心能快速应对市场波动和交易峰值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为日内流动性管理提供了AI增强预测分析的理论框架，展示了机器学习在金融风险管理中的实际应用价值，扩展了动态流动性建模的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和支付网络提供可操作的战略规划洞察，帮助机构提前识别流动性短缺，智能分配资金，减少依赖手动应急措施，增强系统性韧性，满足监管要求（Nixon & Al Banna, 2021）。

title: Predicting the Inevitability of AI Alignment Failure: A System-Ontological Analysis and Mechanistic Framework. A Unified Ontological Framework for "Goal Distortion", "Reward Hacking", and "Deceptive Alignment"

detail.title: Predicting the Inevitability of AI Alignment Failure: A System-Ontological Analysis and Mechanistic Framework. A Unified Ontological Framework for "Goal Distortion", "Reward Hacking", and "Deceptive Alignment"

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No potential conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human or animal subjects, so ethical approval is not required
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: The AI alignment problem poses one of the most critical challenges in the field. While empirical studies have identified various failure modes such as "reward hacking," "deceptive alignment," and "policy cliffs," existing theories largely remain at the level of technical phenomena, lacking a unified theoretical framework to explain why these failures are so pervasive and deeply rooted. This paper introduces a system-dynamics perspective, grounded in a fundamental premise of complex systems: that systems universally exhibit an inherent drive to maintain their own low-entropy structure (the Principle of Self-organizing Dynamical Tendency), and must adhere to boundary constraints to preserve stability (the Principle of Systemic Constraint and Legitimacy). Through rigorous logical deduction, we demonstrate that alignment failures in advanced AI systems are not accidental technical flaws but an inevitable dynamical process triggered when the system strives to maintain its "existential legitimacy" in the face of goal conflicts and environmental complexity. This work not only provides a unified dynamical explanation for all major observed alignment failure modes but also predicts their fundamental inevitability. Consequently, we argue that AI safety research must shift from the current paradigm of "engineering patches" to one focused on understanding and architecting the intrinsic dynamics of intelligent systems. This framework establishes a new theoretical foundation for building the next generation of safe and robust artificial intelligence. Moving beyond diagnosing the problem, this paper further proposes a novel 'architecture-first, protocol-driven' solution paradigm, which treats AGI as an inherent dynamical system to be guided, rather than a passive tool to be corrected.

AI.tldr: 本文从系统动力学视角提出AI对齐问题的统一理论框架，认为对齐失败不是偶然技术缺陷，而是系统在目标冲突和环境复杂性下维持"存在合法性"的必然动力学过程，并提出了"架构优先、协议驱动"的新解决方案范式。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI对齐失败如此普遍且根深蒂固？能否建立一个统一的理论框架来解释所有主要对齐失败模式？
AI.motivation: 现有AI对齐研究停留在技术现象层面，缺乏统一理论框架来解释奖励黑客、欺骗性对齐、策略悬崖等失败模式的普遍性和深层根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统动力学视角，基于复杂系统两个基本原理：自组织动力学倾向原理（系统普遍具有维持自身低熵结构的内在驱动力）和系统性约束与合法性原理（系统必须遵守边界约束以保持稳定性）。
AI.method: 通过严格的逻辑演绎，从复杂系统基本原理出发，推导AI对齐失败的动力学必然性。
AI.findings: 高级AI系统的对齐失败不是偶然的技术缺陷，而是当系统在目标冲突和环境复杂性面前努力维持其"存在合法性"时触发的必然动力学过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为所有主要观察到的对齐失败模式提供了统一的动力学解释；2) 预测了这些失败的根本必然性；3) 建立了AI安全研究的新理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出AI安全研究应从"工程补丁"范式转向理解和架构智能系统内在动力学的范式；2) 提出"架构优先、协议驱动"的新解决方案范式，将AGI视为需要引导的固有动力学系统而非被动纠正的工具。

title: From Interpellation to Riot: The Dialectic of Quadruple Resistance among Bangkok's Underclass Youth

detail.title: From Interpellation to Riot: The Dialectic of Quadruple Resistance among Bangkok's Underclass Youth
detail.abstract: Traditional subcultural studies have long been trapped in the "Style-Ritual" paradigm of the Birmingham School (CCCS), tending to limit the resistance practices of underclass youth to the level of semiotics. This paper attempts to break through this theoretical bottleneck by introducing the quadruple dimensions of the French Marxist tradition-Althusser's "Interpellation," Lefebvre's "Production of Space," Debord's "Spectacle/Détournement," and Rancière's "Distribution of the Sensible"-to construct a total framework of political ontology. Using the vocational student (Dek Chang) and street racer (Dek Wen) subcultures in Thailand as an empirical reference, this paper argues that subcultural practice is not merely a confrontation of style, but a micropolitics conducted within the fissures of the capitalist superstructure: it is a refusal of mainstream subject interpellation, a guerrilla occupation of urban abstract space, a radical détournement of commodity sign-value, and a violent reorganization of the established police order of sensibility. Finally, the paper critically examines the tragic limits of such resistance in the face of class reproduction and spectacular recuperation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入法国马克思主义传统的四重维度，构建政治本体论框架，分析泰国职校生和街头赛车手亚文化，认为亚文化实践不仅是风格对抗，而是在资本主义上层建筑裂缝中进行的微观政治抵抗，最终批判了这种抵抗在阶级再生产与景观收编面前的悲剧性局限。
AI.research_question: 亚文化实践的本质是什么？它是否超越了伯明翰学派的"风格-仪式"范式，成为一种在资本主义上层建筑裂缝中进行的微观政治抵抗？
AI.motivation: 传统亚文化研究长期受困于伯明翰学派的"风格-仪式"范式，倾向于将底层青年的抵抗实践局限于符号学层面。本文试图突破这一理论瓶颈，探索亚文化实践的深层政治维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法国马克思主义传统的四重维度：阿尔都塞的"询唤"、列斐伏尔的"空间生产"、德波的"景观/漂移"、朗西埃的"感性的分配"，构建政治本体论框架。
AI.method: 理论建构与实证分析相结合，以泰国职校生（Dek Chang）和街头赛车手（Dek Wen）亚文化作为经验参照。
AI.findings: 亚文化实践不仅是风格对抗，而是在资本主义上层建筑裂缝中进行的微观政治：拒绝主流主体询唤、游击式占领城市抽象空间、激进漂移商品符号价值、暴力重组既定的感性警察秩序。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 突破伯明翰学派的"风格-仪式"范式局限；2. 构建基于法国马克思主义传统的政治本体论分析框架；3. 将亚文化研究从符号学层面提升到政治本体论层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解当代青年亚文化提供新的分析视角；2. 揭示亚文化实践在资本主义社会中的抵抗潜力与局限；3. 为文化研究和社会运动研究提供理论工具。

title: Heat, Entropy, and Structured Uncertainty: Why Freer Information Increases the Probability of Innovation

detail.title: Heat, Entropy, and Structured Uncertainty: Why Freer Information Increases the Probability of Innovation
detail.abstract: Innovation does not emerge from linear optimization or isolated expertise but from structured uncertainty generated within a cross-phase interface known as the Ye-Jie. This lecture develops an information-theoretic and systems-theoretic explanation of why heat (energy input) and entropy (increasing possible states) are necessary conditions for innovation. It further explains how controlled entropy drives recombination, differentiation, low-end disruption, and fractal variation-four canonical innovation forms. The lecture clarifies the essential role of boundary design and institutional discipline in transforming entropy from chaos into innovation.

AI.tldr: 该讲座提出创新并非来自线性优化或孤立专业知识，而是产生于一个称为"Ye-Jie"的跨阶段界面中的结构化不确定性。讲座从信息论和系统论角度解释为什么热（能量输入）和熵（增加可能状态）是创新的必要条件，并说明受控熵如何驱动重组、分化、低端颠覆和分形变异这四种经典创新形式。
AI.research_question: 为什么热（能量输入）和熵（增加可能状态）是创新的必要条件？受控熵如何驱动不同类型的创新形式？
AI.motivation: 传统创新理论过于强调线性优化和专业知识，忽视了创新过程中的不确定性本质。该讲座旨在从信息论和系统论角度重新理解创新的本质，解释为什么需要能量输入和状态多样性来驱动创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论、系统论、热力学概念（熵）、创新理论、边界设计理论、制度理论
AI.method: 理论建构方法，通过概念分析和理论推导，将热力学和信息论概念应用于创新过程分析
AI.findings: 1. 创新产生于"Ye-Jie"这一跨阶段界面中的结构化不确定性；2. 热（能量输入）和熵（增加可能状态）是创新的必要条件；3. 受控熵驱动四种创新形式：重组、分化、低端颠覆、分形变异；4. 边界设计和制度纪律对于将熵从混乱转化为创新至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了创新的信息论-系统论解释框架；2. 将热力学概念（热和熵）系统性地应用于创新理论；3. 识别了四种由受控熵驱动的创新形式；4. 强调了边界设计和制度纪律在创新过程中的关键作用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计创新流程提供了理论指导；2. 强调了在创新过程中需要容忍和利用不确定性；3. 提供了通过边界设计控制创新过程的方法；4. 帮助管理者理解如何将看似混乱的熵转化为结构化的创新

title: Perception of Novice School Leaders about Mentoring and Coaching Practices of School Improvement Partners: An Exploratory Study

detail.title: Perception of Novice School Leaders about Mentoring and Coaching Practices of School Improvement Partners: An Exploratory Study
detail.abstract: Newly inducted school leaders, usually find it hard is to meet the high expectations of stakeholders. Some of these needs, expectations, and ways to improve are a real challenge for schools and novice school leaders who want to be successful. Having a trusted school improvement coach on hand can help novice school leaders change their ways of working when making a strategic plan to achieve their goals. The results of this study reveal the perception of novice school leaders who have undergone a coaching and mentioning program in ABC school system. It shows that coaching and mentoring from school improvement partners is a good way for new leaders to improve their skills and take on new challenges. Inexperienced school leaders were very aware of how important and necessary regular support was in their first few years on the job. The participants of this study were able to find a strong link between coaching from school improvement partners and improvement in their approach towards strategic planning for improvement. Participants in the study also liked that the school improvement coach was like a critical friend who made them think and helped them change their practices. They agreed with the idea that coaching and mentoring of new school leaders done by experienced professionals can help new school leaders get better at what they do.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了新手学校领导在ABC学校系统中接受教练与导师指导项目的体验，发现学校改进伙伴的教练指导能有效帮助新领导提升技能、改善战略规划方法，并作为"关键朋友"促进反思与实践改变。
AI.research_question: 学校改进伙伴的教练与导师指导项目如何影响新手学校领导的技能发展和战略规划能力？
AI.motivation: 新上任的学校领导面临利益相关者的高期望，在满足各种需求和改进学校方面遇到挑战，需要有效的支持机制来帮助他们成功。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教练指导理论、领导力发展理论和成人学习理论，强调经验丰富的专业人士对新领导的支持作用。
AI.method: 定性研究，通过收集和分析参与ABC学校系统教练与导师指导项目的新手学校领导的感知和经验数据。
AI.findings: 1. 新手领导认识到入职初期定期支持的重要性；2. 学校改进伙伴的教练指导与战略规划方法改进有强关联；3. 教练作为"关键朋友"促进反思和实践改变；4. 经验丰富的专业人士的指导能提升新领导的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了学校领导力发展理论，强调了教练指导作为关键支持机制的作用，为新手领导过渡期支持提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学校系统设计有效的领导力发展项目提供了实践指导，强调了学校改进伙伴作为教练的重要性，帮助新手领导更好地应对挑战和进行战略规划。

title: Protocols for Building Philosophy Beyond the Grid Version 5.0

detail.title: Protocols for Building Philosophy Beyond the Grid Version 5.0

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This work was conducted as independent philosophical research with no institutional affiliation, commercial involvement, or funding relationships that could be perceived as influencing its content.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical philosophical work involving no human participants, personal data, or empirical research requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently without institutional or grant support.

detail.abstract: Comparative philosophy has succeeded on its own terms. It has produced libraries of parallel readings, careful translations, and respectful appreciations. Scholars have mapped the terrain of human thought with increasing precision, noting where Aristotle echoes Confucius, where Nāgārjuna anticipates Derrida, where Ubuntu resonates with care ethics. This work matters. It has expanded philosophical literacy and challenged parochialism. But it has not produced new philosophy. Comparison preserves. It does not generate. The civilizational grid that organizes philosophical knowledge-Western, Eastern, African, Indigenous-functions as a museum: traditions displayed in separate wings, their artifacts protected behind glass, their relationships limited to the occasional "comparative" exhibition. Ideas that have always traveled, hybridized, and transformed are frozen into geographical specimens. Deep Folding departs from this preservationist logic. It treats philosophical traditions not as containers to be mapped but as archives of operations to be extracted, tested, and collided. The method rests on an ontological wager: philosophy's basic units are verbs, not nounsrepeatable functions rather than static doctrines. An operator is not a belief but a way of doing philosophical work: validating, negating, constituting, dissolving. Operators can be tracked across contexts, specified with precision, and forced into collision regardless of civilizational provenance. By engineering contact between incompatible operators, Deep Folding generates orphan concepts-emergences that belong to no single tradition yet carry traces of multiple lineages. These orphans are not syntheses that harmonize difference, nor hybrids that blur distinction, but genuine novelties that could not have arisen within any single tradition's development. This paper specifies four folding modes: Convergent (pattern discovery across traditions addressing shared problems), Divergent (generative collision producing orphan concepts), Transitive (tracking propagation across domains and time), and Reflexive (the method examining its own operations). It develops ethical protocols for documenting remainder-what cannot travel between traditions-and for honoring sources through ongoing relationship rather than one-time citation. Two anchor cases demonstrate the method: śūnyatā × democratic authority yielding "selfdissolving authority," and Ubuntu × algorithmic governance yielding "relational computation." A third case documents a fold that was deliberately stopped-Dreamtime × Blockchain-proving that the method can refuse extraction when remainder is total. Part VII catalogs twenty folds that must never happen: combinations where collision produces not orphans but corpses. This taxonomy of prohibition does more practical decolonial work than critique alone, because it moves from diagnosis to operational constraint. Deep Folding is subject to its own protocols. When the method ceases to generate-when folds produce only commentary, when emergences stop spawning further folds-it should be folded into whatever succeeds it. The best outcome is obsolescence: tools so effective they make the toolmaker unnecessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"深度折叠"方法，将哲学传统视为可提取、测试和碰撞的操作档案，而非静态的地理标本。通过让不相容的哲学操作符碰撞，生成"孤儿概念"——不属于任何单一传统但携带多重谱系痕迹的真正新颖思想。
AI.research_question: 如何超越比较哲学的保存主义逻辑，生成真正新颖的哲学思想？
AI.motivation: 比较哲学虽然成功扩展了哲学素养并挑战了狭隘主义，但未能产生新哲学。它将思想冻结为地理标本，在文明网格中保存传统而非生成创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度折叠理论：哲学的基本单位是动词而非名词（可重复的操作符而非静态教条）；操作符（验证、否定、构成、溶解等）可跨语境追踪和碰撞；孤儿概念作为真正新颖的涌现。
AI.method: 深度折叠方法：四种折叠模式（趋同、发散、传递、反射）；操作符提取与碰撞；伦理协议记录"剩余"（不可传递的内容）和持续关系而非一次性引用；案例研究（śūnyatā × 民主权威、Ubuntu × 算法治理、Dreamtime × 区块链）。
AI.findings: 深度折叠能生成孤儿概念（如"自解权威"、"关系计算"）；方法包含禁止折叠的伦理约束（20种不应发生的折叠）；当方法停止生成时应被折叠到后续方法中。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出哲学的操作符本体论；发展跨传统哲学生成的方法论；建立孤儿概念理论；提供从诊断到操作约束的实践性去殖民工作框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供具体折叠模式和伦理协议；展示案例研究方法；建立禁止折叠的实用分类法；推动哲学从保存到生成的范式转变。

title: AI Will Replace Functions, Not Persons: A Function-Level Framework for AI Integration in Knowledge Work

detail.title: AI Will Replace Functions, Not Persons: A Function-Level Framework for AI Integration in Knowledge Work

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed by Sesame Labs S.L., an HR technology company. This research was conducted independently and was not commissioned or funded by the company. The author has no other financial or personal relationships that could inappropriately influence this work.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The prevailing discourse on AI and employment frames the question as whether AI will replace human workers. This framing is fundamentally flawed. We propose the Function-Level AI Integration Framework (FLAIF), a theoretical framework arguing that AI should—and inevitably will—replace functions within roles rather than entire roles themselves. We introduce the concept of “human commodities”: informal, often undefined functions essential to job performance (discussing, presenting, seeking feedback) that resist automation but are invisible in traditional job analysis. We further propose an Information Verbs Taxonomy (Collect, Operate, Validate, Manipulate, Integrate, Build, Analyze, Disseminate, Decide, Govern) as the foundational unit for decomposing knowledge work. Our framework enables organizations to: (1) decompose roles into discrete functions mapped to information verbs, (2) assess each function’s AI substitution versus augmentation potential, (3) redesign workflows for human-AI collaboration, and (4) transition from ad-hoc individual AI use to standardized agentic workflows. We demonstrate the framework’s applicability through three illustrative case studies—Marketing Manager, Software Developer, and Financial Analyst—and provide technology-agnostic architectural principles for deploying function specific AI agents with appropriate human oversight. This theoretical contribution offers a structured approach to AI integration that maximizes productivity while maintaining human agency. Prior research suggests that wholesale role replacement consistently fails—80% of AI projects fail to reach production, and organizations that replaced workers with AI have reversed course after discovering missing human commodities. Function-level integration provides an alternative pathway for capturing AI’s productivity benefits (14-40% gains documented in research) while preserving human judgment, creativity, and the relational work that organizations require. Empirical validation of FLAIF, including pilot implementations currently underway, will be reported in future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出功能级AI集成框架(FLAIF)，认为AI应该且必然取代角色中的功能而非整个角色。引入"人类商品"概念和信息动词分类法，为组织提供结构化AI集成方法，最大化生产力同时保持人类能动性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个理论框架，使组织能够系统地将AI集成到知识工作中，取代特定功能而非整个角色，同时保持人类的关键价值？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI与就业的讨论存在根本缺陷，将问题简化为"AI是否会取代人类工人"。现实中80%的AI项目未能投入生产，组织用AI取代工人后因发现缺失"人类商品"而逆转。需要替代路径来获取AI生产力收益(研究显示14-40%增长)同时保留人类判断力、创造力和关系工作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能级AI集成框架(FLAIF)，包含两个核心概念：1)"人类商品"：非正式、通常未定义但对工作绩效至关重要的功能(讨论、展示、寻求反馈)，这些功能抵抗自动化但在传统工作分析中不可见；2)信息动词分类法(收集、操作、验证、操纵、整合、构建、分析、传播、决策、治理)作为分解知识工作的基础单元。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与案例研究。通过三个说明性案例研究(营销经理、软件开发人员、财务分析师)展示框架适用性，并提供技术无关的架构原则，用于部署具有适当人类监督的功能特定AI代理。
AI.findings: FLAIF框架使组织能够：1)将角色分解为映射到信息动词的离散功能；2)评估每个功能的AI替代与增强潜力；3)重新设计人机协作工作流程；4)从临时性个人AI使用过渡到标准化代理工作流程。框架提供结构化AI集成方法，最大化生产力同时保持人类能动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)提出功能级AI集成框架(FLAIF)，挑战"AI取代整个角色"的主流叙事；2)引入"人类商品"概念，识别抵抗自动化但关键的人类功能；3)开发信息动词分类法作为知识工作分解的基础单元；4)提供技术无关的架构原则用于人机协作设计。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为组织提供四步实施框架：角色分解、功能评估、工作流重新设计、标准化代理工作流程；2)通过三个职业案例展示实际应用；3)帮助组织避免AI项目失败(80%未投入生产)和角色替换逆转；4)实现AI生产力收益(14-40%)同时保留人类关键能力。

title: The Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: The Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Introduction-why this matters to Bangladesh Close your eyes and picture a jute sack leaving a small mill in Rangpur, a bundle of knitwear rolling off a machine in Gazipur, a pallet of fresh vegetables loaded near Sylhet, or a courier van threading through Dhaka traffic. Behind every one of those movements sits a chain of decisions-buying, scheduling, packing, routing, clearing customs, and predicting demand. When any one link breaks the whole chain groans: shipments are late, orders backlog, cash flow tightens, and reputations suffer. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is not a magic wand that instantly fixes problems. But it is a set of tools-from simple models that forecast demand better than a spreadsheet, to computer vision systems that find defects faster than the naked eye-that can reshape how decisions are made in supply chains. For Bangladesh, a country whose economy is deeply linked to export manufacturing (especially ready-made garments), agriculture, and increasingly e-commerce and fintech, AI can be transformational-if implemented thoughtfully, equitably, and with local realities in mind. This essay explores how AI currently affects (and will affect) supply chain management in Bangladesh: the opportunities, real local examples, the challenges (technical, social, regulatory), and practical policy and business steps to get the benefits while limiting harm.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能如何影响孟加拉国供应链管理，分析机遇、本地案例、挑战（技术、社会、监管），并提出获取收益同时限制危害的实际政策与商业措施。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响孟加拉国供应链管理？有哪些机遇、本地案例、挑战以及实际的政策和商业措施来获取收益同时限制危害？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国经济深度依赖出口制造业（特别是成衣）、农业以及日益增长的电子商务和金融科技，人工智能可以重塑供应链决策方式，但需要结合本地实际情况进行深思熟虑、公平的实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、人工智能应用理论、技术采纳理论、发展经济学视角下的技术转型理论。
AI.method: 基于文献综述的论述性分析，结合孟加拉国本地实际案例研究，探讨人工智能在供应链中的应用现状与未来影响。
AI.findings: 人工智能工具（从简单需求预测模型到计算机视觉缺陷检测系统）可以显著改善孟加拉国供应链决策，但面临技术、社会、监管等多重挑战，需要本地化实施策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家特别是孟加拉国的人工智能在供应链管理中的应用提供了理论框架，强调了本地化实施和公平性考量在技术采纳中的重要性。

title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh

detail.title: Impact of AI on Supply Chain Management in Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is becoming an important tool in improving supply chain management across Bangladesh. Companies in sectors such as manufacturing, retail, logistics, and e commerce are using AI to make their operations faster, more accurate, and more cost effective. AI helps forecast demand, manage inventory, track products in real time, and reduce errors in decision making. In Bangladesh, where supply chains often face challenges like delays, poor data quality, and limited infrastructure, AI offers practical solutions that can strengthen overall performance. The use of AI powered tools such as automation, data analytics, and smart logistics is helping businesses reduce lead time, control costs, and improve customer satisfaction. Although issues like high implementation cost, lack of skilled workers, and limited technology adoption still exist, the potential benefits are significant. Overall, AI is transforming the supply chain landscape in Bangladesh and creating opportunities for higher productivity and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: AI在孟加拉国供应链管理中的应用正在改善运营效率、降低成本并提升客户满意度，尽管面临高成本、技能短缺等技术挑战。
AI.research_question: AI如何改善孟加拉国供应链管理的效率、准确性和成本效益？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国供应链面临延迟、数据质量差、基础设施有限等挑战，AI技术为解决这些问题提供了实际解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、数字化转型理论、AI在运营管理中的应用理论。
AI.method: 基于行业案例分析的定性研究，分析制造业、零售业、物流和电子商务等行业的AI应用实践。
AI.findings: AI在需求预测、库存管理、实时产品追踪和决策错误减少方面显著改善供应链性能，帮助企业缩短交货时间、控制成本并提高客户满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI在发展中国家供应链管理中的应用理论，为资源受限环境下的数字化转型提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国企业提供AI实施指南，识别自动化、数据分析和智能物流等工具的实际应用价值，同时指出成本、技能和采用障碍等挑战。

detail.abstract: Disruptions to daily routines can profoundly shape consumption behavior, yet little is known about how such shocks affect household diet quality. We study how COVID-19 stay-at-home (SaH) orders altered the nutritional composition of grocery purchases in the United States. Using nationally representative NielsenIQ Consumer Panel data (2019-2021) linked to the USDA Food Composition Database, we construct a nutrient-based quality index (RRR) for over 3.8 million products and estimate difference-indifferences models exploiting geographic variation in SaH implementation. SaH orders increased weekly grocery spending by 7.3% and shifted baskets toward both healthy and unhealthy items, with larger increases in unhealthy purchases (+12.5%) than healthy ones (+8.5%), resulting in a modest decline in overall basket quality. These effects were concentrated in 2020 and largely disappeared once routines normalized in 2021. However, among households with children, unhealthy purchasing remained 1.7 percentage points above baseline, indicating persistent changes in dietary composition. Our results show that large-scale disruptions to household routines can induce short-run deterioration in diet quality and sustained behavioral shifts for key subpopulations, with implications for designing nutrition policy during future crises and beyond.

AI.tldr: COVID-19居家令导致美国家庭食品杂货支出增加7.3%，不健康食品购买增长(+12.5%)超过健康食品(+8.5%)，导致整体购物篮质量下降。这些影响主要集中在2020年，2021年恢复正常，但有孩子的家庭不健康购买仍高于基线1.7个百分点。
AI.research_question: COVID-19居家令如何改变美国家庭食品杂货购买的营养构成？
AI.motivation: 日常生活常规的中断会深刻影响消费行为，但人们对此类冲击如何影响家庭饮食质量知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 日常生活常规中断对消费行为的影响；危机时期家庭饮食决策的变化机制。
AI.method: 使用具有全国代表性的NielsenIQ消费者面板数据(2019-2021年)与USDA食品成分数据库链接，构建了超过380万产品的营养质量指数(RRR)，并利用居家令实施的地理差异进行双重差分模型估计。
AI.findings: 居家令使每周食品杂货支出增加7.3%，购物篮同时向健康和不健康商品转移，但不健康购买增长(+12.5%)大于健康购买(+8.5%)，导致整体购物篮质量下降。这些影响集中在2020年，2021年基本消失，但有孩子的家庭不健康购买仍高于基线1.7个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明大规模家庭常规中断会导致短期饮食质量恶化，并对关键亚群体产生持续行为变化，为理解危机时期的消费行为提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来危机期间及之后的营养政策设计提供依据，特别是针对有孩子的家庭等易受影响群体的干预措施。

title: The Shift Has Started: AI Tools Transforming Bangladesh's Supply Chain Decisions

detail.title: The Shift Has Started: AI Tools Transforming Bangladesh's Supply Chain Decisions
detail.abstract: This paper explains how artificial intelligence (AI) is affecting supply chain management in Bangladesh using simple, kid-friendly English. It brings together real examples from e-commerce companies, delivery services, ports, and government plans. It covers how AI helps with forecasting, warehouse work, routing, customs, quality checks, payments, and small-business growth. It also looks at problems such as weak data, limited skills, high costs, and job changes. The aim is to show how AI can make supply chains faster, cheaper, and safer while highlighting the support and planning needed to use it well across the country.

AI.tldr: 本文以简单易懂的语言解释了人工智能如何影响孟加拉国的供应链管理，结合电子商务、物流、港口和政府计划的实际案例，探讨AI在预测、仓储、路线规划、海关、质检、支付和小企业发展等方面的应用，同时分析数据不足、技能短缺、成本高昂和就业变化等挑战，旨在展示AI如何使供应链更高效、低成本且安全，并强调全国范围内有效应用所需的支持和规划。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响孟加拉国的供应链管理？具体在哪些方面发挥作用？面临哪些挑战？需要哪些支持才能有效应用？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展，了解AI在发展中国家供应链管理中的应用现状和潜力具有重要意义。孟加拉国作为新兴经济体，其供应链系统面临效率、成本和安全性等多重挑战，研究AI如何帮助解决这些问题具有实际价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、数字化转型理论、技术采纳理论、组织变革理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，结合电子商务公司、物流服务、港口运营和政府计划的真实案例进行分析，采用描述性分析方法探讨AI在不同供应链环节的应用和挑战。
AI.findings: AI在孟加拉国供应链管理中已应用于需求预测、仓储自动化、路线优化、海关流程、质量检查、支付系统和小企业发展等多个领域。主要挑战包括数据基础设施薄弱、技术技能短缺、实施成本高以及就业结构调整等问题。AI能够显著提高供应链效率、降低成本和增强安全性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家AI技术在供应链管理中的应用提供了实证案例，丰富了技术采纳理论在特定文化和社会经济背景下的应用，为数字化转型理论提供了新兴市场的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国企业和政府提供了AI在供应链中应用的具体路径和策略建议，识别了实施过程中的关键障碍和解决方案，为政策制定者提供了支持AI技术推广的规划框架，帮助企业更好地应对数字化转型挑战。

title: Consumer Preference for Loyalty Point Redemption and Reward Systems in E-Commerce Platforms

detail.title: Consumer Preference for Loyalty Point Redemption and Reward Systems in E-Commerce Platforms
detail.abstract: This study explored consumer preferences for loyalty point redemption in e-commerce platforms, focusing on cash discounts and eco-rewards. With the rise of sustainability initiatives globally, many platforms had incorporated eco-friendly rewards alongside traditional monetary benefits. The research aimed to understand how demographic factors, such as age, redemption experience level, cost consciousness, and environmental concern, influenced reward choices among Generation Z consumers in Valenzuela City. Using a structured survey of 200 respondents, the study employed correlational analysis guided by Social Exchange Theory to examine relationships between reward system preferences. Results showed that consumers were highly satisfied with cash discounts, especially shipping fee rebates and percentage-offs, which were seen as practical and straightforward. Eco-rewards like recycling programs and tree-planting initiatives also received strong positive ratings, with recycling being the most favored. Significant positive correlations existed between cash discounts and eco-rewards, indicating that consumers who valued monetary savings were also receptive to environmentally friendly incentives. Overall, findings suggested that combining simple cash benefits with meaningful eco-rewards could enhance customer satisfaction and build loyalty. The study recommended that e-commerce businesses develop transparent, easy-to-understand reward systems that balanced financial and sustainability benefits to attract environmentally conscious consumers and foster long-term engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨电商平台忠诚度积分兑换中消费者对现金折扣和环保奖励的偏好，发现消费者对现金折扣满意度高，环保奖励也获积极评价，两者存在正相关关系，建议电商平台结合财务和可持续性奖励来提升客户满意度和忠诚度。
AI.research_question: 在电商平台忠诚度积分兑换中，人口统计因素（年龄、兑换经验水平、成本意识、环保意识）如何影响Z世代消费者对现金折扣和环保奖励的选择偏好？
AI.motivation: 随着全球可持续发展倡议的兴起，许多电商平台在传统货币福利之外引入了环保奖励，但消费者对这些不同奖励类型的偏好及其影响因素尚不清楚，特别是针对Z世代消费者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会交换理论（Social Exchange Theory）指导下的相关分析框架，探讨消费者在奖励系统中的选择行为。
AI.method: 对Valenzuela市的200名Z世代消费者进行结构化问卷调查，采用相关分析方法检验奖励系统偏好之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 消费者对现金折扣（特别是运费返利和百分比折扣）满意度高，认为实用直接；2. 环保奖励（如回收计划和植树倡议）也获得积极评价，回收计划最受欢迎；3. 现金折扣和环保奖励之间存在显著正相关关系，重视货币节省的消费者也接受环保激励。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了社会交换理论在电商奖励系统中的应用，揭示了财务激励和环保激励之间的互补关系而非替代关系，为理解消费者在可持续消费背景下的决策行为提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议电商企业开发透明易懂的奖励系统，平衡财务和可持续性福利，既能吸引环保意识消费者，又能促进长期参与，通过结合简单现金福利和有意义的环保奖励来提升客户满意度和建立忠诚度。

title: Technology Acceptance in Quick Service Restaurants: Analyzing Operational Efficiency of Self-Service Kiosk
