title: Voice Assistants in the Tourism Customer Journey: From Knowledge and Decision-Making to Ecotourism Loyalty in Family Vacations
affiliations: “Dunarea de Jos” University of Galati, University Dunarea De Jos Galati, “Dunarea de Jos” University of Galati and “Dunarea de Jos” University of Galati

detail.title: Voice Assistants in the Tourism Customer Journey: From Knowledge and Decision-Making to Ecotourism Loyalty in Family Vacations

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Innovation & Knowledge, volume 10, issue 6, 2025[10.1016/j.jik.2025.100833]

detail.abstract: Research on consumer interactions with artificial intelligence (AI)-powered voice assistants (VAs) in ecotourism is limited. Grounded in expectation confirmation theory and the post-acceptance model of information systems (IS) continuance, this study explores how VAs influence family ecotourism behavior throughout the tourism customer journey, from decision-making to ecotourism loyalty. The conceptual model introduces the novel concept of family ecotourism engagement, which is tested as a mediator of the relationship between family ecotourism satisfaction and loyalty. For the data, 205 parents who traveled with children to Romanian ecotourism destinations completed online surveys in a three-stage data collection process, pre-, in-, and postvisit. Partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) and fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA) were combined in a mixed-methods approach. A key symmetric finding is that VA-driven family ecotourism engagement is likely to mediate the relationship between family ecotourism satisfaction and loyalty. This finding extends research on ecotourism behavior. Asymmetric findings reveal that VA expectations are the most important predictor of family ecotourism loyalty. The study provides practical insights for potential partnerships between key stakeholders to design VAs tailored to ecotourism destinations.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于期望确认理论和信息系统持续使用模型，探讨AI语音助手如何影响家庭生态旅游行为。研究发现语音助手驱动的家庭生态旅游参与在满意度与忠诚度之间起中介作用，且语音助手期望是忠诚度的最重要预测因子。
AI.research_question: AI语音助手如何影响家庭生态旅游行为，特别是在旅游客户旅程（从决策到生态旅游忠诚度）中的作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 目前关于消费者与AI语音助手在生态旅游中互动的研究有限，需要探索语音助手如何影响家庭生态旅游行为，特别是在完整的旅游客户旅程中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期望确认理论（Expectation Confirmation Theory）和信息系统持续使用后接受模型（Post-acceptance Model of IS Continuance）
AI.method: 混合方法：采用三阶段数据收集过程（旅游前、中、后），对205名带孩子前往罗马尼亚生态旅游目的地的父母进行在线调查。数据分析结合偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）和模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）。
AI.findings: 1. 对称性发现：语音助手驱动的家庭生态旅游参与在家庭生态旅游满意度与忠诚度之间起中介作用；2. 非对称性发现：语音助手期望是家庭生态旅游忠诚度的最重要预测因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 引入"家庭生态旅游参与"这一新概念；2. 扩展了生态旅游行为研究；3. 结合对称和非对称分析方法，提供更全面的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关键利益相关者设计针对生态旅游目的地的语音助手提供实践指导，促进潜在合作伙伴关系，优化生态旅游体验。

title: Pension Reforms, Longevity, and Late-Life Employment: Evidence from Sixteen Countries
affiliations: University of Southern California - Department of Finance and Business Economics and Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge

detail.title: Pension Reforms, Longevity, and Late-Life Employment: Evidence from Sixteen Countries
detail.abstract: Employment rates for workers aged 55-64 increased by an average of 28.5 percentage points across sixteen countries between 2004 and 2019, with Austria, Italy, and the Netherlands experiencing increases larger than their entire 2004 employment rate. We examine what explains these dramatic gains and their substantial heterogeneity across countries and demographic groups.Using harmonized Health and Retirement Study data, we document three key empirical patterns. First, employment increases concentrated among women, healthier individuals, and more educated workers. Second, contrary to prior research, changes in weekly hours per worker are mixed rather than uniformly negative, with gains occurring primarily at the extensive margin. Third, employment growth accelerated during 2013-2019 compared to 2007-2013.While existing research examines longevity and pension reforms as separate channels, we show their interaction is quantitatively important. Longevity improvements amplify pension reform effects: when survival probabilities increase, actuarial adjustments for delayed claiming provide higher benefits collected over longer periods, strengthening work incentives. We formalize this mechanism in a lifecycle framework yielding testable predictions about margins of adjustment and demographic heterogeneity.Countries experiencing both pension reforms and substantial longevity gains show employment increases 15-20 percentage points larger than countries with reforms alone. This interaction helps explain why responses were exceptionally large in some countries, why growth accelerated after 2013, and why effects concentrate among healthier and more educated workers. Our findings suggest pension reform effectiveness depends critically on demographic context. Because effects concentrate at the extensive margin, policies raising retirement ages are more effective than hours flexibility policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，2004-2019年间16个国家55-64岁工人就业率平均增长28.5个百分点，这种戏剧性增长及其异质性主要源于养老金改革与寿命延长的交互作用，而非单一因素。
AI.research_question: 什么因素解释了2004-2019年间16个国家55-64岁工人就业率的戏剧性增长及其在国家和人口群体间的显著异质性？
AI.motivation: 2004-2019年间，16个国家55-64岁工人就业率平均增长28.5个百分点，其中奥地利、意大利和荷兰的增长甚至超过了其2004年的整体就业率。这种戏剧性增长及其在国家和人口群体间的显著异质性需要解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期理论框架，强调养老金改革与寿命延长之间的交互作用机制：寿命改善会放大养老金改革的效果，因为当生存概率增加时，延迟申领的养老金精算调整会提供更高的福利，并在更长的时期内领取，从而加强了工作激励。
AI.method: 使用协调的健康与退休研究数据，进行实证分析，并构建生命周期理论框架来形式化养老金改革与寿命延长交互作用的机制，产生可检验的预测。
AI.findings: 1. 就业增长集中在女性、更健康个体和更高教育程度的工人中；2. 每周工作时间变化是混合的而非统一的负向变化，增长主要发生在广泛边际；3. 2013-2019年就业增长比2007-2013年加速；4. 同时经历养老金改革和显著寿命增长的国家比仅有改革的国家就业增长高15-20个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了养老金改革与寿命延长之间的交互作用机制，而非单独作用；2. 形式化了这一机制的生命周期理论框架；3. 解释了为什么某些国家的反应特别大、为什么增长在2013年后加速、以及为什么效应集中在更健康和更高教育程度的工人中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 表明养老金改革的有效性关键取决于人口背景；2. 由于效应集中在广泛边际，提高退休年龄的政策比工作时间灵活性政策更有效；3. 为政策制定者提供了关于如何设计更有效的退休政策的见解。

title: Integration of a Cost-Efficient Graphic Design Software among Student Entrepreneurs in Valenzuela City: A Digital Marketing Tool for Enhancing Marketing Effectiveness
affiliations: , , , , , , , , , Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Valenzuela and

detail.title: Integration of a Cost-Efficient Graphic Design Software among Student Entrepreneurs in Valenzuela City: A Digital Marketing Tool for Enhancing Marketing Effectiveness
detail.abstract: Digital marketing is one of the essential common grounds where consumers and businesses meet, technological adoption, particularly the use of Canva Graphic Design Software, plays an increasingly important role. Although Canva is widely recognized in educational settings, its potential in business applications, especially for student entrepreneurs, warrants deeper examination. To address this, this paper aims to explore the perceptions and experiences of student entrepreneurs regarding the integration of cost-efficient graphic design software as a digital marketing tool for enhancing marketing effectiveness in Valenzuela City. The study employs the variables of TAM for Technological Adoption and RBV Model for Marketing Effectiveness as a guide for the framework of this study. Using Narrative-Descriptive research design, incorporating online focus group discussion with chosen 8 student-entrepreneurs from the Department of Marketing Management who utilized Canva as their Marketing tool for their own business. Research reveals that student entrepreneurs perceive cost-efficient graphic design software as a valuable and practical digital marketing tool. In terms of technology adoption, they find the software highly useful, easy to use, and cost-effective, which fosters positive attitudes and strong intentions for continued use. It enhances marketing effectiveness by improving brand value, supporting unique and customizable content, and strengthening inimitability and non-substitutability of their designs. Technology adoption is shown to positively influence marketing performance by elevating visual quality, customer engagement, and brand consistency. However, entrepreneurs also face challenges such as limited access to premium features, time constraints, and varying design skills, requiring additional creativity, effort, and effective time management to maintain high-quality outputs. The study recommends that student entrepreneurs maximize the features of cost-efficient graphic design software to enhance productivity, creativity, and marketing output. They are encouraged to fully explores templates, tools, tutorials, and software updates to improve design skills, strengthen brand identity, and produce consistent, professional marketing materials. Entrepreneurs should personalize their designs to stay competitive and address challenges through continuous learning and effective time management. Hence, the study proposes the “Click & Create” workshop to further develop their design and marketing skills.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨学生创业者对Canva等成本效益图形设计软件作为数字营销工具的认知与体验，发现这些工具能有效提升营销效果，但也面临高级功能限制、时间约束等挑战。
AI.research_question: 学生创业者如何看待和体验将成本效益图形设计软件作为数字营销工具来提升营销效果？
AI.motivation: 虽然Canva在教育领域广为人知，但其在商业应用中的潜力，特别是对学生创业者的价值，需要更深入的探讨。数字营销是消费者与企业相遇的重要平台，技术采用对提升营销效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）用于分析技术采用，资源基础观（RBV）模型用于评估营销效果。
AI.method: 采用叙事-描述性研究设计，通过在线焦点小组讨论，选取8名来自营销管理系、使用Canva作为营销工具的学生创业者进行数据收集。
AI.findings: 学生创业者认为成本效益图形设计软件是有价值且实用的数字营销工具。在技术采用方面，他们认为软件高度有用、易于使用且成本效益高，这培养了积极态度和持续使用的强烈意愿。软件通过提升品牌价值、支持独特可定制内容、增强设计的不可模仿性和不可替代性来提高营销效果。技术采用对营销绩效有积极影响，能提升视觉质量、客户参与度和品牌一致性。但也面临高级功能访问限制、时间约束和设计技能差异等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 将TAM和RBV模型结合应用于学生创业者使用图形设计软件的情境，扩展了技术采用理论在创业营销领域的应用，为理解成本效益数字工具如何影响营销效果提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议学生创业者充分利用成本效益图形设计软件的功能来提升生产力、创造力和营销产出；推荐探索模板、工具、教程和软件更新；提出"Click & Create"工作坊来进一步发展设计和营销技能；强调个性化设计、持续学习和有效时间管理的重要性。

title: Structural Duality in Emerging Markets: A Data Science Analysis of the Kyrgyz Republic's Trade Balance (2019-2024)
affiliations: Ala-Too International University and Ala-Too International University

detail.title: Structural Duality in Emerging Markets: A Data Science Analysis of the Kyrgyz Republic's Trade Balance (2019-2024)
detail.abstract:
This research investigates the structural dynamics of the Kyrgyz Republic's foreign trade from 2019 to 2024. Using open official statistics and Python-based machine learning, we move beyond aggregate totals to identify sectoral and partnerspecific dependencies. We engineer features by mapping Harmonized System (HS) codes to macro-sectors and apply K-Means clustering on partner-level panels after Yeo-Johnson normalization. The evidence points to a pronounced structural duality: (i) a critical import dependency in manufactured goods dominated by China and (ii) a narrow, high-efficiency export engine in Gold & Precious Stones with sales concentrated in the United Kingdom (and, earlier in the period, Switzerland). Stylized facts are triangulated from the National Statistical Committee (NSC), the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic (NBKR), UN Comtrade/WITS, IMF, World Bank, and EBRD publications (2019–2024). A reproducible code notebook (Colab)
accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用机器学习方法分析吉尔吉斯斯坦2019-2024年外贸结构，发现明显的二元结构：对中国制造业产品的关键进口依赖，以及集中在英国（早期为瑞士）的黄金和宝石高效出口引擎。
AI.research_question: 吉尔吉斯共和国2019-2024年外贸结构动态特征是什么？其部门层面和贸易伙伴层面的依赖关系如何？
AI.motivation: 超越总量分析，深入理解吉尔吉斯斯坦外贸的部门结构和伙伴依赖关系，为政策制定提供更精细的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易结构分析理论，经济地理学中的贸易依赖理论，以及结构转型理论。
AI.method: 使用官方统计数据，基于Python的机器学习方法，将HS编码映射到宏观部门，对伙伴层面数据进行Yeo-Johnson标准化后应用K-Means聚类分析。
AI.findings: 发现明显的结构二元性：1）对中国制造业产品的关键进口依赖；2）集中在英国（早期为瑞士）的黄金和宝石高效出口引擎。
AI.theory_contributions: 为小国开放经济体的贸易结构分析提供了新的方法论框架，丰富了发展中国家贸易依赖理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为吉尔吉斯斯坦贸易政策制定提供实证依据，帮助识别关键依赖关系和风险，促进贸易结构多元化。

title: Innovation Policies and Inventors' Productivity: Evidence from Global AI Initiatives
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney (UTS), Institute of Global Finance, UNSW Business School, University of Texas at Dallas - School of Management - Department of Finance & Managerial Economics and

detail.title: Innovation Policies and Inventors' Productivity: Evidence from Global AI Initiatives
detail.abstract: Governments have developed policies and increased investment in AI technology, recognizing its potential as a future engine of economic growth. In this study, we construct two novel datasets of global AI patents and AI innovation policies across 42 countries, to examine, for the first time, the effect of these policies on the productivity of AI scientists. We find that these "mission-oriented" innovation policies are effective in incentivizing scientists to pursue more risky and exploratory AI inventions that the private sector may be unwilling to undertake. While such projects are essential for successful breakthroughs, we find that short-term productivity (measured by the quantity and average quality of innovations) decreases in the post-policy period. This pattern is consistent with the J-curve dynamics commonly observed during the transition to a new innovation paradigm. Our results highlight the transitional risks associated with targeted government support for innovation, as well as evidence that it incentivizes more novel projects with long-run technological potential.

AI.tldr: 政府AI创新政策激励科学家从事高风险探索性研究，但短期内创新数量和质量下降，呈现J曲线动态，长期看有利于突破性技术发展。
AI.research_question: 政府AI创新政策如何影响AI科学家的生产力？这些政策是否有效激励科学家从事高风险探索性研究？
AI.motivation: 各国政府认识到AI作为未来经济增长引擎的潜力，制定政策并增加投资，但缺乏对这些政策效果的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使命导向型创新政策理论、J曲线动态理论、创新范式转换理论
AI.method: 构建两个新颖数据集：全球AI专利数据集和42个国家AI创新政策数据集，进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1. 使命导向型创新政策有效激励科学家从事高风险探索性AI发明；2. 政策后短期内生产力（创新数量和质量）下降；3. 符合向新创新范式过渡的J曲线动态
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证检验政府AI政策对科学家生产力的影响；2. 验证使命导向型政策在激励高风险研究中的作用；3. 揭示创新范式转换中的J曲线动态
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供AI创新政策效果的实证证据；2. 揭示政府支持创新过程中的过渡性风险；3. 表明政策激励长期技术潜力项目的重要性

title: Evaluation of Land-Use and Crop-Conversion Policies to Mitigate Human–Wildlife Conflicts
affiliations: Tohoku Gakuin University, Tohoku University and Tohoku University

detail.title: Evaluation of Land-Use and Crop-Conversion Policies to Mitigate Human–Wildlife Conflicts
detail.abstract: Human–wildlife conflicts are increasingly common in residential areas, causing injuries and the spread of zoonotic diseases. Governments have implemented measures such as extermination, land-use regulation, and deterrent fencing. In this process, because some wildlife has high ecological value, we should take account of trade-offs between conservation and human safety. We assess the welfare effects of several urban policies, using an ecosystem–urban economics model factoring in the spatial interactions between land use and wildlife foraging behavior. We introduce a novel policy: converting some farmland to crops preferred by wildlife to redirect animals away from residential zones. Our simulations show that the crop conversion consistently yields the highest welfare, improving outcomes by around 6% even compared to ideal fencing that entirely prevents animal intrusions into urban areas. In contrast, the widely-adopted extermination policy is relatively ineffective.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了城市野生动物冲突政策，提出将农田转为野生动物偏好作物的新政策，模拟显示该政策比理想围栏提高约6%福利，而广泛采用的扑杀政策效果相对较差。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理城市野生动物冲突，在保护生态价值与保障人类安全之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 城市野生动物冲突日益增多，导致伤害和人畜共患病传播，现有政策如扑杀、土地利用管制和围栏存在局限性，需要在保护具有高生态价值的野生动物与人类安全之间进行权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统-城市经济学模型，考虑土地利用与野生动物觅食行为之间的空间相互作用。
AI.method: 使用生态系统-城市经济学模型进行政策模拟，评估不同城市政策的福利效应。
AI.findings: 将农田转为野生动物偏好作物的政策始终产生最高福利，即使与完全防止动物侵入城市的理想围栏相比，也能提高约6%的福利结果；而广泛采用的扑杀政策相对无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合生态系统与城市经济学的空间交互模型，为野生动物冲突管理提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出将农田转为野生动物偏好作物的创新政策，为城市野生动物管理提供了更有效的解决方案，比传统围栏和扑杀政策具有更好的福利效果。

title: The Implications of Labor Antitrust for Merger Enforcement

detail.title: The Implications of Labor Antitrust for Merger Enforcement
detail.abstract: Courts and agencies can no longer afford to ignore the role of labor markets in evaluating mergers. In this paper, I show that understanding the economics of monopsony and the facts of labor markets should make us much more skeptical of the economic benefits of mergers generally. Mergers frequently harm the market for labor. That understanding also helps us to identify mergers that cause particular harm to workers. And it gives the agencies tools to try to mitigate those harms – not merely by banning the mergers, but by protecting labor unions and banning noncompetes, nonsolicitation clauses, and other barriers to exit.

AI.tldr: 本文主张法院和监管机构在评估并购时应更多考虑劳动力市场影响，指出并购常损害劳动力市场，并提供了识别和缓解这些损害的工具。
AI.research_question: 并购如何影响劳动力市场？如何识别和缓解并购对工人的损害？
AI.motivation: 法院和监管机构在评估并购时忽视了劳动力市场的影响，而理解买方垄断经济学和劳动力市场事实表明并购经常损害劳动力市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 买方垄断理论、劳动力市场经济学、并购评估框架
AI.method: 理论分析、经济学推理、政策分析
AI.findings: 1. 并购经常损害劳动力市场；2. 理解买方垄断有助于识别对工人特别有害的并购；3. 监管机构可以通过保护工会、禁止竞业禁止条款等方式缓解损害
AI.theory_contributions: 将买方垄断理论系统应用于并购评估，扩展了传统并购分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供具体工具来识别和缓解并购对劳动力的损害，包括保护工会、禁止竞业禁止条款等政策建议

title: House Prices, Fertility Rates, and Homeownership: Evidence from The UK
affiliations: University of Cambridge - Department of Land Economy, University of Cambridge - Department of Land Economy and University of Cambridge - Department of Land Economy

detail.title: House Prices, Fertility Rates, and Homeownership: Evidence from The UK
detail.abstract: This paper presents the results of a first quantitative study into the relationship between house prices and fertility rates at the local authority district spatial scale in the United Kingdom (UK). The study focuses on London Boroughs, from 2001-2020, and empirically examines the connection between fertility rates and house prices and interacts house prices with a baseline measure of home ownership. The core OLS estimates indicate that when borough-level home ownership rates are low (i.e., when there are lots of renters in the borough), a 1% increase in house prices is associated with a small decrease in fertility rates. However, when borough-level home ownership rates increase beyond 44.4%, this marginal effect turns positive, and increases in house prices are found to increase fertility rates, due to positive wealth effects that accrue to existing home owners. These findings are robust to a number of alternate model specifications, including the use of different independent variables and alternative lag effects. Additionally, the instrumental variable approach is employed to address potential endogeneity concerns, further strengthening the validity of our results. Finally, the results are in line with the predictions of qualitative evidence from London and of existing literature (Dettling and Kearney, 2014; Aksoy, 2016), and illustrate the importance of tenure patterns in shaping the relationship between housing and fertility.

AI.tldr: 本文通过英国地方行政区层面的首次定量研究，发现房价与生育率的关系取决于住房拥有率：当住房拥有率低于44.4%时，房价上涨会轻微降低生育率；当住房拥有率高于此阈值时，房价上涨反而会提高生育率，这归因于现有房主的财富效应。
AI.research_question: 在英国地方行政区层面，房价与生育率之间存在怎样的关系？这种关系如何受到住房拥有率的影响？
AI.motivation: 这是英国首次在地方行政区层面进行房价与生育率关系的定量研究，特别关注伦敦行政区（2001-2020年），旨在填补现有文献中关于住房市场如何影响生育决策的实证研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于住房经济学和人口经济学的理论框架，特别是Dettling和Kearney（2014）以及Aksoy（2016）的研究，强调住房拥有状况在调节房价对生育率影响中的关键作用。
AI.method: 采用OLS回归分析伦敦行政区层面数据（2001-2020年），将房价与住房拥有率交互作用纳入模型，并使用工具变量法解决潜在的内生性问题，进行多种稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 核心发现：当行政区住房拥有率较低（即租房者较多）时，房价上涨1%会导致生育率轻微下降；但当住房拥有率超过44.4%时，房价上涨反而会提高生育率，这归因于现有房主的财富效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：首次在英国地方层面实证验证了住房拥有率在调节房价对生育率影响中的阈值效应（44.4%），为住房市场与生育决策的关系提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：为政策制定者提供了重要启示，表明住房政策（特别是促进住房拥有率的政策）可能通过财富效应间接影响生育率，有助于设计更有效的住房和人口政策。

title: Life Year Economics: Life-Years per Capita (LYPC) as a Framework for Evaluating Redistribution and National Well-Being

detail.title: Life Year Economics: Life-Years per Capita (LYPC) as a Framework for Evaluating Redistribution and National Well-Being

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or non-financial interests related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, human data, or human biological materials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not report the results of a clinical trial.

detail.abstract: Public debates about redistribution typically frame taxation and social spending in monetary terms rather than in their ultimate consequence: human survival and quality of life. This paper proposes a new evaluative metric, Life-Years per Capita (LYPC), defined as the average number of expected lifetime years generated per citizen under a given economic and social policy regime. LYPC reframes redistribution not as a transfer from the rich to the poor, but as a mechanism for increasing a nation’s total life-year production. The metric mathematically internalizes the well-being of marginalized populations such as the homeless, uninsured, food-insecure, and working poor by incorporating their gains and losses into a single national average. This shifts policy evaluation from abstract moral discourse to visceral, self-relevant outcomes. Because wealth exhibits sharply diminishing marginal returns to life-years, even modest redistributions typically increase total national life-years. Expressing LYPC differences in concrete time units such as years, months, weeks, days, or hours allows citizens to understand policy impacts in a more intuitive and meaningful way. LYPC integrates insights from economics, public health, and psychology to offer a universal, non-ideological metric for comparing policy regimes and evaluating national well-being.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的政策评估指标——人均生命年数(LYPC)，将再分配政策重新定义为增加国家总生命年产出的机制，而非简单的财富转移。该指标通过将边缘人群的福祉纳入国家平均值，使政策评估从抽象的道德讨论转向具体、切身相关的生命时间结果。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种能够直观衡量再分配政策对人类生存和生活质量影响的评估指标？
AI.motivation: 当前关于再分配的公共辩论通常以货币术语讨论税收和社会支出，而非关注其最终后果——人类的生存和生活质量。需要一种能够将政策影响转化为更直观、更有意义的时间单位的新评估指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合经济学（财富的边际效用递减）、公共卫生（预期寿命与政策关系）和心理学（时间感知与决策）的跨学科理论框架，强调财富对生命年数的边际回报急剧递减。
AI.method: 提出概念性指标LYPC（人均生命年数），定义为在特定经济和社会政策制度下，每个公民产生的平均预期寿命年数。该指标通过数学方法将边缘人群的福祉纳入国家平均值。
AI.findings: 由于财富对生命年数的边际回报急剧递减，即使是适度的再分配通常也能增加国家总生命年数。将LYPC差异表达为具体的时间单位（年、月、周、日、小时）能使公民更直观地理解政策影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个跨学科的政策评估框架；2）将再分配重新概念化为生命年生产机制；3）开发了将边缘人群福祉内部化的数学方法；4）提供了非意识形态的、普遍适用的国家福祉比较指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供了直观的评估工具；2）帮助公民更好地理解政策对自身生命时间的影响；3）促进基于实证而非意识形态的政策辩论；4）可用于比较不同政策制度和国家福祉水平。

title: The Impact of Syringe Service Programs (SSPs) on Bloodborne Diseases and Opioid Mortality: Evidence from States' Legalization of SSPs between 2008-2023
affiliations: University of Memphis and University of Memphis

detail.title: The Impact of Syringe Service Programs (SSPs) on Bloodborne Diseases and Opioid Mortality: Evidence from States' Legalization of SSPs between 2008-2023

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the conduct or outcomes of this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without any external financial support.

detail.abstract: The United States has experienced a dramatic increase in drug-related deaths since 2014, along with rising hepatitis C (HCV) infections linked to injection drug use. Meanwhile, HIV transmission among people who inject drugs (PWID) has remained stable over the last few decades. To address these issues, several states have legalized Syringe Service Programs (SSPs) as a harm reduction strategy, but causal evidence on their effectiveness remains limited. This study evaluates the impact of the legalization of SSPs on opioid-related mortality, illicit drug overdose deaths, and HIV and HCV diagnoses using state-level data from 2008 to 2023. Applying an imputation-based staggered difference-indifferences design and dynamic event study methods, we find that SSPs reduce opioid and illicit opioid-related deaths by about 3 per 100,000 adults, with stronger effects among men and African American populations. While the primary estimates for HCV and HIV diagnoses show no impact of SSPs, alternative specifications suggest a decrease in HIV diagnoses among PWID. Robustness checks confirm these findings. Evidence indicates that increased naloxone distribution and improved access to substance use disorder treatment for PWID are likely mechanisms behind the mortality reductions. The findings of the study suggest that the legalization of SSPs can be an effective tool for states to reduce overdose mortality and prevent HIV transmission amidst the opioid crisis.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了美国各州合法化注射器服务项目（SSPs）对阿片类药物相关死亡率、非法药物过量死亡以及HIV和HCV诊断的影响。研究发现SSPs能显著降低阿片类药物相关死亡，但对HCV和HIV诊断影响有限，其中HIV诊断在特定人群中有所减少。机制分析表明纳洛酮分发增加和药物使用障碍治疗可及性改善是死亡率降低的主要原因。
AI.research_question: 注射器服务项目（SSPs）的合法化如何影响阿片类药物相关死亡率、非法药物过量死亡以及HIV和HCV诊断？
AI.motivation: 自2014年以来，美国药物相关死亡人数急剧增加，与注射药物使用相关的丙型肝炎（HCV）感染也在上升。虽然注射药物使用者（PWID）中的HIV传播在过去几十年保持稳定，但多个州已合法化SSPs作为减少伤害的策略，然而关于其有效性的因果证据仍然有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于减少伤害理论框架，SSPs通过提供清洁注射器、纳洛酮分发和药物使用障碍治疗转介等服务，旨在降低药物过量死亡和血液传播疾病感染风险。
AI.method: 使用2008-2023年州级数据，采用基于插补的渐进双重差分设计和动态事件研究方法，评估SSPs合法化对健康结果的影响。
AI.findings: SSPs使阿片类药物和非法阿片类药物相关死亡减少约每10万成年人3例，对男性和非裔美国人群体影响更强。主要估计显示SSPs对HCV和HIV诊断无影响，但替代规范表明PWID中的HIV诊断有所减少。稳健性检验证实了这些发现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为减少伤害理论提供了因果证据，证实SSPs在降低药物过量死亡率方面的有效性，并阐明了纳洛酮分发和治疗可及性作为中介机制的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明SSPs合法化是各州在阿片类药物危机中减少过量死亡和预防HIV传播的有效工具，为政策制定者提供了实证支持，建议扩大SSPs实施范围并加强相关配套服务。

title: The Rentier-Asset Impossibility Theorem and the Asset-Pricing Constraint on Essential Supply

detail.title: The Rentier-Asset Impossibility Theorem and the Asset-Pricing Constraint on Essential Supply
detail.abstract:
This paper documents a knife-edge structural break in 1973 after which the cost of life’s essentials—housing, healthcare, food, and energy—began rising 4.3 percentage points faster per year than U.S. median real wages, a wedge that is positive in 48 of the subsequent 52 years and has compounded into a cumulative +732% affordability loss by 2024. Chow tests reject
parameter stability at p < 10⁻⁸; the post-1973 regime exhibits strong negative sensitivity to long-term real interest rates (R² = 0.46) and remarkable half-century stability. Standard explanations—globalization, technology, demographics, union decline, Baumol effects, monetary policy, and zoning—all fail multiple tight empirical tests (timing, magnitude, sector selectivity, rate sensitivity, persistence). This is not a paper about asset-price bubbles or financial cycles. It shows that when the basic
necessities of life become governed by the return requirements of capital rather than the purchasing power of labour—through asset valuation or debt-service constraints—those return requirements become embedded in consumer prices. The Rentier–Asset Impossibility Theorem proves that, under conditions observed continuously since 1973, essential-goods price growth must structurally exceed wage growth every period, and no internal monetary, fiscal, supply side, or redistributive policy can restore affordability without terminating the capital-return constraint itself. Restoring middle-class viability therefore requires regime change: de-financializing essentials or accepting the indefinite widening of the wedge.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现1973年后生活必需品（住房、医疗、食品、能源）价格开始以每年4.3个百分点的速度超过美国中位数实际工资增长，形成持续52年的结构性断裂，导致累计732%的可负担性损失。
AI.research_question: 为什么1973年后美国生活必需品的价格增长持续超过工资增长？这种结构性断裂的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 自1973年以来，美国中产阶级面临生活必需品（住房、医疗、食品、能源）价格持续超过工资增长的结构性问题，导致可负担性严重恶化，需要探究其根本原因。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 食利者-资产不可能定理：当生活必需品由资本回报要求而非劳动力购买力决定时，资本回报要求会嵌入消费者价格；2. 结构性断裂理论；3. 资本回报约束理论。
AI.method: 使用Chow检验检测1973年的结构性断裂（p<10⁻⁸），分析价格与工资增长差距的时间序列数据，检验长期实际利率敏感性（R²=0.46），并通过多重实证检验排除传统解释因素。
AI.findings: 1. 1973年后生活必需品价格每年比工资增长快4.3个百分点；2. 52年中有48年存在正向差距；3. 累计可负担性损失达732%；4. 后1973年体制对长期实际利率有强负敏感性；5. 传统解释（全球化、技术、人口等）均无法解释这一现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"食利者-资产不可能定理"，证明在资本回报约束条件下，必需品价格增长必须结构性超过工资增长，且内部政策无法恢复可负担性，除非终止资本回报约束本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 揭示恢复中产阶级生存能力需要体制变革；2. 提出两条路径：必需品去金融化或接受差距持续扩大；3. 为政策制定者提供结构性改革的理论基础。

title: Two-Stage Calibration Method: A Simplified Dual-Weighting Framework for Election Survey Accuracy

detail.title: Two-Stage Calibration Method: A Simplified Dual-Weighting Framework for Election Survey Accuracy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author works in the field of political data analytics; however, this research and the development of the Two-Stage Calibration Method (TCM) were conducted independently and without sponsorship or influence from any political party, campaign, or organization. The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that may affect the integrity of the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research uses anonymized survey datasets and publicly available election results. No personal identifiers or sensitive data were collected or analyzed. Therefore, institutional ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Survey datasets in political research frequently contain demographic and partisan imbalances that distort analytical outcomes and reduce forecast accuracy. This paper introduces the Two-Stage Calibration Method (TCM), a simplified dual-weighting framework designed to correct sampling bias in a transparent and replicable way. Stage 1 calibrates survey samples according to true demographic proportions, while Stage 2 aligns the weighted samples with past election vote-share outcomes. The combined effect significantly improves the reliability of estimates in multi-party political systems. The method is mathematically simple, operationally efficient, and easily implementable in tools such as Excel, Power BI, Python, and R. Results demonstrate substantial accuracy improvements when compared with raw survey samples. This paper positions TCM as a practical alternative to complex weighting models such as raking and iterative proportional fitting (IPF), offering a streamlined solution for political consultants, survey firms, and social science researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段校准方法（TCM），通过两个简单的加权步骤来纠正政治调查中的抽样偏差，提高预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种简单、透明且可复制的校准方法来纠正政治调查数据中的人口统计和党派不平衡问题，以提高分析结果和预测准确性？

title: Workplace Influence on Union Membership

detail.title: Workplace Influence on Union Membership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Im am a Phd Student at Uppsala university in Sweden. No other declaration of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Study has past ethical approval to gain access to data.
declarations.funderStatement: Uppsala University and Handelsbanken

detail.abstract:
Why do workers join trade unions? This paper uses detailed Swedish register data to investigate the role of the workplace in shaping workers' union membership decisions. I track individuals as they switch employers and exploit variation in workplace union density to test whether workers are more likely to unionize when entering workplaces with higher shares of unionized employees. I find that the workplace strongly influences unionization: workers who move to more union-dense workplaces are substantially more likely to join, while those who enter less union-dense workplaces are less likely to do so — even when considering movers who stay within the same occupation, industry, firm, and municipality. This shows that Swedish trade unions succeed in inducing membership with clear private benefits to overcome the public-goods nature of the collective bargaining system. While union membership and unemployment insurance fund membership are partially intertwined, they are not jointly determined for most movers. I find no evidence that workplace instability or union wage premiums drive workplace influence on membership. Ruling out these factors and showing that workers are more responsive to the union density among their peers than non-peers, the evidence points to local social customs as the key determinant of workplace influence.
My findings highlight the importance of the workplace context—and, in particular, unions’ ability to foster strong local membership norms—for understanding the high levels of union density in the Nordic countries.

AI.findings: 1. 工作场所对工会化有强烈影响：进入工会密度更高工作场所的工人更可能加入工会，反之亦然；2. 这种影响在控制多种因素后仍然存在；3. 本地社会习俗是关键机制，而非工作不稳定或工会工资溢价；4. 工人对同伴工会密度比非同伴更敏感；5. 工会成员和失业保险基金成员并非完全共同决定。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为工会组织策略提供指导：应重点培养工作场所的会员规范；2. 解释了北欧国家高工会密度的原因；3. 为政策制定者理解工会动态提供依据；4. 为企业管理提供关于工作场所文化影响的见解。

title: The Expected Return of Bonds: A Deep Dive into Yield to Maturity as a Predictive Tool

detail.title: The Expected Return of Bonds: A Deep Dive into Yield to Maturity as a Predictive Tool
detail.abstract: Under some unrealistic assumptions, a bond's yield to maturity is equal to the bond's mean return through maturity. In fact, under those assumptions, because the former is observable, then the latter is certain. Obviously, in practice, bond returns are not certain and need to be forecasted. To do so, investors often use a bond's yield to maturity as a proxy for the bond's expected return over a holding period of ten or so years. This article explores the rationale behind this approach, the conditions under which it may be more or less accurate, and some evidence that strongly supports it.

title: The Great Pyramids of Egypt – Tombs or Primarily a Socio-Economic Development Project?

detail.title: The Great Pyramids of Egypt – Tombs or Primarily a Socio-Economic Development Project?
detail.abstract:
The Great Pyramids of Giza have long been recognized as the tombs of pharaohs with deep religious significance. Egyptologists acknowledge that their construction also had an impact on the economic and social life of the state; however, these aspects are generally considered secondary to the primary religious purpose.

Meanwhile, Polish economist and entrepreneur Jacek Krzysztoń proposes a reversal of this hierarchy. According to his theory, presented in the book Egyptian Pyramids: Big Tombs or Big Business?, it was precisely the process of building the pyramids—long-term, costly, and engaging the entire economy—that constituted the actual, fundamental goal of the undertaking. The pyramid functioned as a tool for economic development and social integration, while the tomb served as a kind of pretext, legitimizing this collective effort in the eyes of society. This symbolic function was an indispensable part of the broader strategy—without it, the pyramid projects could not have succeeded.

These conclusions are also presented in the documentary film The Pyramids – Tools of Power (available on YouTube), which portrays the pyramids as state-driven megaprojects—constructed not only for eternity, but above all for the here and now.

AI.research_question: 金字塔建造的真正主要目的是什么？是宗教墓葬功能还是经济发展和社会整合的工具？
AI.motivation: 传统埃及学将金字塔视为法老墓葬，经济和社会影响被视为次要。但波兰经济学家Jacek Krzysztoń提出需要重新审视这一等级关系，探讨金字塔建造是否具有更根本的经济和社会目的。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 经济发展理论：金字塔作为长期、高成本的国家项目如何促进经济增长
2. 社会整合理论：大型公共工程如何增强社会凝聚力和国家认同
3. 象征合法性理论：宗教象征如何为经济项目提供社会接受度
AI.method:

AI.findings:

AI.practical_contributions:

This is mostly due to increases in computing power, big data, and machine learning.  Starting with the use and importance of AI in global finance, this research is based on a solid literature review to explore these applications, and not only that, but also get deeper to explore the challenges of its applications presented by the risks, as well as research more into strategies for promoting the deep, healthy, and sustainable growth of AI in financial markets, based on the reality of global financial development while taking into account the risks and practical challenges that exist in the AI development process.
